zh.tag: 523 节课、20 阶段的 AI 工程从零到上线开源课程
zh.what: 这是一套系统性的 AI 工程学习课程，覆盖从基础原理到实际部署的完整链路，强调「学它、造它、交付它」。每节课都产出一个可复用产物，如提示词、技能、智能体或 MCP 服务器。
zh.content: 仓库包含 523 节课、20 个阶段、约 342 小时内容，配有网站、路线图、多语言 README 与 i18n 翻译分支，以及 assets 中的横幅等资源。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，课程同时覆盖 TypeScript、Rust 和 Julia，采用 MIT 许可证，配套静态网站与构建脚本。
zh.hot: 凭借 53694 颗星、今日新增 343 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 11 名，它切中了「84% 学生用 AI 但仅 18% 自认能专业使用」的痛点。
uses: 想系统入门 AI 工程的学生与转行者，按阶段循序渐进学习
需要把 AI 能力落地到产品的开发者，直接复用课程产出的提示词与智能体
团队技术负责人，用课程作为内部培训与工程规范参考
希望用多语言材料教学的教师，可借助 i18n 分支与翻译页面

en.tag: A 523-lesson, 20-phase open-source curriculum for AI engineering from scratch
en.what: A systematic AI engineering curriculum covering the full path from fundamentals to deployment, built around the motto 'Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.' Every lesson ships a reusable artifact such as a prompt, skill, agent, or MCP server.
en.content: The repo holds 523 lessons across 20 phases (~342 hours), plus a website, roadmap, multilingual READMEs, an i18n translations branch, and assets like the banner.
en.stack: Primarily Python, with lessons also covering TypeScript, Rust, and Julia; MIT-licensed with a companion static site and build scripts.
en.hot: With 53,694 stars, +343 today, and #11 on GitHub Trending daily, it hits the gap that '84% of students use AI tools but only 18% feel prepared to use them professionally.'
uses: Students and career switchers wanting a structured, phase-by-phase intro to AI engineering
Developers shipping AI features who can reuse the prompts, skills, and agents each lesson produces
Tech leads using it as an internal training and engineering-standards reference
Instructors teaching in multiple languages via the i18n branch and translated pages

zh.tag: 让智能体真正学会学习的长期记忆系统
zh.what: Hindsight 是一个面向 AI 智能体的记忆系统，目标不是简单回放对话历史，而是让智能体随时间积累经验、持续学习。它声称克服了 RAG 和知识图谱在长期记忆任务上的缺陷，并在相关基准上达到领先水平。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 服务端与客户端 SDK、NPM 客户端包、文档站点（hindsight-docs）、集成示例与 Cookbook，并提供 MCP 服务器、LLM Wrapper 及编码智能体接入方式。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，发布到 PyPI（hindsight-api、hindsight-client）与 NPM（@vectorize-io/hindsight-client），采用 MIT 许可，支持独立服务器、嵌入式运行及多种平台集成。
zh.hot: 上线即获 27785 颗星、单日新增 1668 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 2，说明智能体长期记忆正是当下最受关注的痛点方向。
uses: 构建需要跨会话记住用户偏好并持续进化的 AI 智能体开发者
希望替代 RAG 或知识图谱方案、提升长期记忆准确率的团队
为编码助手、客服机器人等产品接入记忆能力的工程团队
想通过 MCP 或 LLM Wrapper 快速试水智能体记忆的研究者

en.tag: Agent memory system that makes agents learn, not just remember
en.what: Hindsight is an agent memory system designed to make agents learn over time rather than merely recall conversation history. It claims to overcome the shortcomings of RAG and knowledge graphs, delivering state-of-the-art results on long-term memory benchmarks.
en.content: The repo ships a Python server and client SDK, an NPM client package, a docs site (hindsight-docs), integration examples and a cookbook, plus an MCP server, an LLM wrapper, and coding-agent integrations.
en.stack: Primarily Python, published on PyPI (hindsight-api, hindsight-client) and NPM (@vectorize-io/hindsight-client) under MIT license, supporting standalone server, embedded mode, and multi-platform integrations.
en.hot: With 27,785 stars and 1,668 added in a single day, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending daily, it shows agent long-term memory is one of today's hottest pain points.
uses: Developers building AI agents that must remember user preferences across sessions and keep improving
Teams looking to replace RAG or knowledge-graph approaches with higher long-term memory accuracy
Engineering teams adding memory to coding assistants, support bots, and similar products
Researchers wanting to try agent memory quickly via MCP or the LLM wrapper

zh.tag: 面向 AI 代理的一体化 Office 运行时 SDK
zh.what: Univer 是一个开源 Office SDK，让开发者把电子表格、文档、演示、看板、关系表与 PDF 等办公能力嵌入到自己的产品中。它定位为「AI 代理的 Office 载体」，为智能体提供可编程的办公文档运行时。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 包形式组织，包含核心引擎、插件模块、公式引擎、Canvas 渲染层与统一 Facade API，并配有 docs 文档、示例与多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，基于 Canvas 渲染与插件化架构，提供浏览器与 Node.js 通用的 Facade API，依赖 pnpm 工作区与 CI/CD 工具链。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1082 star、总数 17654，冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 3，AI 代理与办公自动化结合是当前热点，Univer 正好卡住这一需求。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为智能体提供可读写电子表格与文档的运行时
SaaS 产品团队：在自有应用中嵌入表格、文档与演示编辑能力
低代码/协作平台：基于插件架构定制办公组件
研究者与学习者：研究 Canvas 渲染、公式引擎与 Office 文档模型

en.tag: The Office Harness for AI Agents — one runtime for docs, sheets, slides
en.what: Univer is an open-source Office SDK that lets developers embed spreadsheet, document, presentation, board, relational-table and PDF experiences directly into their own products. Positioned as the Office Harness for AI Agents, it gives agents a programmable runtime for office documents.
en.content: The repo is organized as TypeScript packages: a core engine, plugin modules, a formula engine, a Canvas rendering layer and a unified Facade API, plus docs, examples and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript with Canvas-based rendering and a plugin architecture, exposing one Facade API for both browser and Node.js, managed via pnpm workspaces and CI/CD tooling.
en.hot: With 1,082 stars added today and 17,654 total, it hit #3 on GitHub Trending daily — riding the hot intersection of AI agents and office automation.
uses: AI agent developers: give agents a runtime to read and write spreadsheets and docs
SaaS product teams: embed spreadsheet, document and presentation editing in their apps
Low-code/collaboration platforms: customize office components via the plugin architecture
Researchers and learners: study Canvas rendering, formula engines and office document models

zh.tag: Google 开源的高吞吐量声明式 AI 代理编排运行时
zh.what: AX 是一个声明式编排器，用于在集群中运行数十亿个自主代理工作负载。它通过 Task、Workspace 和 Model 三个原语，提供沙箱隔离、工作区预配置和模型配置，让代理任务像 Kubernetes 一样被管理。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 和控制平面，以及示例 YAML 清单（如 task.yaml）。核心组件包括 Task、Workspace、Model 等自定义资源定义，以及 ax apply/watch/ssh 等命令。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes 集群、Redis 和 Agent Substrate 进行沙箱执行。使用 ko 构建和部署容器镜像。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 开源的代理编排项目，AX 在 GitHub 上迅速获得 10451 颗星，今日新增 1373 星，登上日榜第 4 名。其声明式方法和可扩展性吸引了大量关注 AI 代理基础设施的开发者。
uses: AI 平台工程师：需要大规模运行和管理自主代理工作负载的团队。
DevOps 和 SRE：希望以声明式方式编排代理任务，类似 Kubernetes 管理应用。
AI 研究者：需要安全沙箱环境来测试和调试代理行为。
企业开发者：构建基于代理的自动化流程，要求隔离和资源控制。

en.tag: Google's open-source high-throughput declarative agent orchestration runtime
en.what: AX is a declarative orchestrator for running billions of autonomous agent workloads in a cluster. It provides sandboxed execution, pre-wired workspaces, and model configuration through three primitives: Task, Workspace, and Model, making agent tasks manageable like Kubernetes.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based CLI and control plane, along with example YAML manifests (e.g., task.yaml). Core components include custom resource definitions like Task, Workspace, and Model, plus commands such as ax apply/watch/ssh.
en.stack: Primarily built in Go, it depends on a Kubernetes cluster, Redis, and Agent Substrate for sandboxed execution. It uses ko for building and deploying container images.
en.hot: As Google's open-source agent orchestration project, AX quickly gained 10,451 stars on GitHub, with 1,373 added today, ranking 4th on the daily trending list. Its declarative approach and scalability attract many developers interested in AI agent infrastructure.
uses: AI platform engineers: teams needing to run and manage autonomous agent workloads at scale.
DevOps and SREs: those wanting to orchestrate agent tasks declaratively, similar to Kubernetes for apps.
AI researchers: requiring secure sandboxed environments to test and debug agent behavior.
Enterprise developers: building agent-based automation flows with isolation and resource control.

zh.tag: NVIDIA 官方模型压缩与推理加速统一库
zh.what: NVIDIA Model Optimizer 是一个模型优化技术统一库，集成了量化、剪枝、神经架构搜索、蒸馏、投机解码和稀疏化等 SOTA 方法。它接收 Hugging Face、PyTorch 或 ONNX 模型，输出优化后的量化 checkpoint，可直接部署到 TensorRT-LLM、TensorRT、vLLM、SGLang 等推理框架以提升推理速度。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python API、量化与蒸馏等优化算法实现、示例教程（如 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 NVFP4 W4A4 + QAD 端到端教程）、文档站点源码以及面向 Megatron-Bridge、Megatron-LM、Hugging Face Accelerate 的集成代码。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 PyTorch、Hugging Face Transformers/Accelerate、ONNX，并与 NVIDIA Megatron-Bridge、Megatron-LM、TensorRT-LLM、TensorRT、vLLM、SGLang 等生态深度集成。
zh.hot: 作为 NVIDIA 官方出品的模型优化统一库，它直接打通从训练到 TensorRT-LLM/vLLM 部署的量化链路，契合大模型推理降本增效的刚需，今日新增 44 star 登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 5，累计约 4081 star。
uses: 大模型推理部署工程师，需要将模型量化后接入 TensorRT-LLM、vLLM 等框架
模型压缩与优化研究者，想复现量化、蒸馏、剪枝、NAS 等 SOTA 技术
使用 NVIDIA GPU 生态的团队，希望在 Megatron 或 Hugging Face 流程中加入量化训练
需要降低显存占用与推理成本、同时尽量保持精度的应用开发者

en.tag: NVIDIA's unified library for model compression and inference acceleration
en.what: NVIDIA Model Optimizer is a unified library of state-of-the-art model optimization techniques including quantization, pruning, neural architecture search, distillation, speculative decoding, and sparsity. It takes Hugging Face, PyTorch, or ONNX models and exports optimized quantized checkpoints ready for deployment in inference frameworks like TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT, vLLM, and SGLang to speed up inference.
en.content: The repo contains Python APIs, implementations of optimization algorithms such as quantization and distillation, example tutorials (e.g., an end-to-end NVFP4 W4A4 + QAD tutorial for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B), documentation source, and integrations for Megatron-Bridge, Megatron-LM, and Hugging Face Accelerate.
en.stack: Primarily Python, depending on PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers/Accelerate, and ONNX, with deep integration into the NVIDIA ecosystem including Megatron-Bridge, Megatron-LM, TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT, vLLM, and SGLang.
en.hot: As an official NVIDIA library, it bridges training and deployment quantization pipelines for TensorRT-LLM/vLLM, meeting the pressing need to cut LLM inference costs. It gained 44 stars today to rank #5 on GitHub Trending, with about 4,081 stars total.
uses: LLM inference deployment engineers who need to quantize models for TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, and similar frameworks
Model compression and optimization researchers reproducing SOTA quantization, distillation, pruning, and NAS techniques
Teams in the NVIDIA GPU ecosystem adding quantization-aware training to Megatron or Hugging Face pipelines
Application developers aiming to reduce memory footprint and inference cost while preserving accuracy

zh.tag: 修复 X/Twitter 与 Bluesky 链接预览的嵌入服务
zh.what: FxEmbed 通过在链接前加前缀（如 fixup、fx）把 X/Twitter 和 Bluesky 的帖子转换成富媒体嵌入，让 Discord、Telegram 等平台能显示多图、视频、投票、引用和翻译。它同时提供 FxTwitter、FixupX 和 FxBluesky 三个域名服务。
zh.content: 仓库是 TypeScript 编写的 Cloudflare Worker 项目，包含 API 路由、各域名 realm 处理、品牌与本地化配置，以及 Docker/Wrangler 自托管文件和测试工作流。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 与 Cloudflare Workers，使用 esbuild 构建，通过 Wrangler 部署，支持 Docker Compose 自托管，并接入 Crowdin 做多语言翻译。
zh.hot: 它解决了社交平台链接预览长期残缺的痛点，已获 5367 星，今日新增 182 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 6 名。
uses: Discord 与 Telegram 社区管理员，希望频道内 X/Bluesky 链接能完整显示媒体内容
普通用户想在不离开聊天软件的情况下查看推文的多图、视频和投票
开发者可基于其公开 API 或自托管方案，把嵌入能力集成进自己的应用
关注链接预览与社交数据抓取的技术爱好者，可参考其 Worker 架构与多域名路由设计

en.tag: Embed fixer for X/Twitter and Bluesky link previews
en.what: FxEmbed rewrites X/Twitter and Bluesky links with prefixes like fixup and fx to produce rich embeds, so Discord, Telegram and others can show multiple images, videos, polls, quotes and translations. It powers the FxTwitter, FixupX and FxBluesky domains.
en.content: The repo is a TypeScript Cloudflare Worker project with API routes, per-domain realm handling, branding and localization configs, plus Docker/Wrangler self-hosting files and test workflows.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Cloudflare Workers, bundled with esbuild, deployed via Wrangler, self-hostable with Docker Compose, and localized through Crowdin.
en.hot: It solves the long-standing pain of broken social link previews, with 5,367 stars, 182 added today, ranking 6th on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Discord and Telegram community admins who want X/Bluesky links to show full media in channels
Everyday users who want to view tweet images, videos and polls without leaving their chat app
Developers who can integrate embed capabilities into their own apps via the public API or self-hosting
Link-preview and social-scraping enthusiasts interested in its Worker architecture and multi-domain routing

zh.tag: 面向投行、研究与财富管理的金融工作流 AI 代理与技能库
zh.what: 这是 Anthropic 官方开源的金融行业 AI 代理参考实现，覆盖投行、股票研究、私募股权和财富管理等场景。它把同一套系统提示词和技能以两种方式交付：作为 Claude Cowork 插件安装，或通过 Claude Managed Agents API 部署到自有工作流引擎中。
zh.content: 仓库包含两类内容：一是具名端到端代理（Pitch Agent、Market Researcher、GL Reconciler、Month-End Closer 等），每个都自带技能并同时提供 Cowork 插件和 Managed Agent 模板；二是按金融垂直领域打包的底层技能、斜杠命令和数据连接器（如 /comps、/dcf、/earnings）。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，依赖 Claude Cowork 插件体系与 Claude Managed Agents API（/v1/agents）进行部署。
zh.hot: 作为 Anthropic 官方发布的金融垂直代理库，它把大模型代理直接落到投行、PE 等高价值工作流，上线即冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 5，今日新增 260 star，总 star 已达 35370。
uses: 投行、PE、股票研究与财富管理从业者，用于加速建模、备忘录与研究报告草拟
金融机构的 AI/平台工程团队，希望基于官方模板搭建自有代理工作流
需要 /comps、/dcf、/earnings 等金融技能与数据连接器的开发者
关注合规与人工复核流程、想评估 LLM 代理在金融场景落地边界的研究者

en.tag: Reference agents, skills, and data connectors for financial-services workflows
en.what: Anthropic's open-source reference implementation of AI agents for financial services, covering investment banking, equity research, private equity, and wealth management. The same system prompts and skills ship two ways: as a Claude Cowork plugin, or deployed via the Claude Managed Agents API behind your own workflow engine.
en.content: It contains two layers: named end-to-end agents (Pitch Agent, Market Researcher, GL Reconciler, Month-End Closer, etc.), each self-contained with bundled skills and shipped both as a Cowork plugin and a Managed Agent template; and vertical plugins bundling underlying skills, slash commands, and data connectors such as /comps, /dcf, and /earnings.
en.stack: Primary language is Python, built around the Claude Cowork plugin system and the Claude Managed Agents API (/v1/agents) for deployment.
en.hot: As Anthropic's official vertical agent library for finance, it lands LLM agents directly in high-value workflows like investment banking and PE, debuting at #5 on GitHub Trending with 260 stars added today and 35,370 total.
uses: Investment banking, PE, equity research, and wealth management professionals drafting models, memos, and research notes
Financial-institution AI/platform teams building custom agent workflows on official templates
Developers needing finance skills and data connectors like /comps, /dcf, and /earnings
Researchers assessing compliance and human-in-the-loop boundaries for LLM agents in finance

zh.tag: 把一切软件变成 AI 代理可调用的 CLI 工具层
zh.what: CLI-Anything 为各类软件生成命令行封装（CLI harness），让 AI 代理能直接调用原本只面向人类的图形界面软件。它提供 CLI-Hub 让用户浏览、安装和管理社区构建的 CLI，并支持预览、实时预览与轨迹循环来产出真实成果。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI-Hub 安装器（pip install cli-anything-hub）、各软件的 CLI harness 集合、18 个应用的演示（CAD、3D 场景、图表、游戏、字幕等），以及 2461+ 项测试结果与贡献者/需求模板。
zh.stack: 主语言 Python，通过 pip 分发（cli-anything-hub），依赖各目标软件自身的命令行或脚本接口，并配套 GitHub Pages 上的 CLI-Hub 站点。
zh.hot: 项目已积累 50,334 颗星，今日新增 413 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 8，切中「代理成为软件新用户」这一热门叙事。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理接入原本没有 API 的桌面软件
工具链工程师：快速生成并维护软件的 CLI 封装
自动化爱好者：用 CLI-Hub 安装社区 CLI 做批量任务
软件厂商/贡献者：提交自己的 CLI harness 接入生态

en.tag: Making all software agent-native via generated CLI harnesses
en.what: CLI-Anything generates CLI harnesses for all kinds of software so AI agents can drive tools that were originally built only for humans. It ships CLI-Hub for browsing, installing and managing community-built CLIs, plus preview, live preview and trajectory loops that produce real artifacts.
en.content: It contains the CLI-Hub installer (pip install cli-anything-hub), a collection of per-software CLI harnesses, demos across 18 apps (CAD, 3D scenes, diagrams, gameplay, subtitles), plus 2,461+ test results and contributor/wishlist templates.
en.stack: Primarily Python, distributed via pip (cli-anything-hub), relying on each target software's own CLI or scripting interface, with a CLI-Hub site hosted on GitHub Pages.
en.hot: With 50,334 stars and 413 added today, ranking 8th on GitHub Trending daily, it rides the hot narrative that agents are becoming software's new users.
uses: AI agent developers wiring agents into desktop software that lacks APIs
Tooling engineers generating and maintaining CLI wrappers for software
Automation enthusiasts installing community CLIs via CLI-Hub for batch tasks
Vendors and contributors submitting their own CLI harness to the ecosystem

zh.tag: 移动设备取证工具，用于检测 iOS/Android 是否被间谍软件入侵
zh.what: MVT（Mobile Verification Toolkit）是一套用于移动设备取证的命令行工具集，可自动化采集并分析 Android 与 iOS 设备中的取证痕迹，帮助判断设备是否遭到入侵。它由国际特赦组织安全实验室于 2021 年 7 月随 Pegasus 项目发布，至今仍由该组织及社区维护。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 包形式发布，包含针对 iOS 与 Android 的多个取证模块（如备份解析、文件系统提取、IOC 扫描等），并配有完整文档、测试与 CI 配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，可通过 PyPI 或源码安装，依赖若干解析库并支持命令行调用，文档托管在 Read the Docs。
zh.hot: 凭借 Amnesty 与 Pegasus 项目的背景，MVT 一直是数字取证领域的标杆工具；目前累计 13594 颗星，今日新增 169 星并登上 GitHub 日榜第 8 名，说明隐私与间谍软件检测话题持续受到关注。
uses: 安全研究人员与数字取证分析师，用于调查设备是否被间谍软件感染
记者、人权工作者等高风险人群，在专家协助下进行设备安全评估
移动安全爱好者与开发者，学习 iOS/Android 取证方法与 IOC 扫描流程

en.tag: Mobile forensics toolkit for detecting spyware compromise on iOS and Android devices
en.what: MVT (Mobile Verification Toolkit) is a collection of command-line utilities that automate the gathering and analysis of forensic traces from Android and iOS devices to identify signs of compromise. It was released by Amnesty International's Security Lab in July 2021 alongside the Pegasus Project and is still maintained by Amnesty and contributors.
en.content: The repo ships as a Python package with separate forensic modules for iOS and Android (backup parsing, filesystem extraction, IOC scanning, etc.), plus full documentation, tests, and CI configuration.
en.stack: Written primarily in Python, installable via PyPI or from source, relies on several parsing libraries and exposes a CLI; documentation is hosted on Read the Docs.
en.hot: Backed by Amnesty and the Pegasus Project, MVT remains a benchmark tool in digital forensics; with 13,594 stars and 169 added today, ranking 8th on GitHub Trending, it reflects sustained interest in privacy and spyware detection.
uses: Security researchers and digital forensics analysts investigating potential spyware infections
Journalists, human rights defenders, and high-risk individuals conducting device assessments with expert help
Mobile security enthusiasts and developers learning iOS/Android forensics and IOC scanning workflows

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的技能框架与完整软件开发方法论
zh.what: Superpowers 是一套面向编码代理的完整软件开发方法论，建立在可组合的 skills 和初始指令之上。它让代理在动手写代码前先追问真实需求、产出规格与实现计划，再以子代理驱动开发的方式逐项完成任务并自我审查。
zh.content: 仓库以 Shell 脚本和技能定义为主，包含安装说明、基础工作流、故障处理、哲学理念等文档，并针对 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Copilot CLI 等十余种代理工具提供分平台安装指引。
zh.stack: 以 Shell 为主要语言，核心是可组合的 skills 定义与初始指令，依赖各编码代理平台自身的插件或 CLI 机制，无重型外部依赖。
zh.hot: 它切中了“代理写代码不靠谱”的痛点，用 TDD、YAGNI、DRY 和子代理审查把代理变成有纪律的工程流程，已获约 29.1 万 star，今日新增 611，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜第 10。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等编码代理的开发者，希望代理按规范流程工作
团队想为 AI 辅助开发引入可复用的技能与工程纪律
对代理驱动开发、TDD 与子代理协作模式感兴趣的研究者
需要跨多个代理平台统一开发方法论的工程组织

en.tag: An agentic skills framework and complete software development methodology for coding agents
en.what: Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for coding agents, built on composable skills plus initial instructions that ensure the agent actually uses them. Instead of jumping straight into code, the agent teases out a spec, presents it in digestible chunks, builds an implementation plan, then runs a subagent-driven development process that inspects and reviews each task.
en.content: The repo is mostly Shell scripts and skill definitions, with docs covering installation, the basic workflow, troubleshooting, philosophy, and per-harness setup guides for a dozen-plus agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and Copilot CLI.
en.stack: Primarily Shell, centered on composable skill definitions and initial instructions; it relies on each coding agent's own plugin or CLI mechanism rather than heavy external dependencies.
en.hot: It targets the pain of unreliable agent-written code by enforcing TDD, YAGNI, DRY, and subagent review as a disciplined engineering process, drawing ~291k stars with 611 added today and ranking #10 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Developers using coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor who want disciplined workflows
Teams seeking reusable skills and engineering discipline for AI-assisted development
Researchers interested in agent-driven development, TDD, and subagent collaboration
Engineering orgs wanting one methodology across multiple agent platforms

zh.tag: 面向生产环境的开源 AI Agent 框架，Python 与 TypeScript 双语言支持
zh.what: Strands Agents 是一个用于构建和运行 AI Agent 的开源 SDK，支持 Python 和 TypeScript。它采用模型驱动的方式，让开发者用几行代码就能搭建 Agent，并覆盖手写 Agent 循环最终会演化出的各种能力。

需要生命周期控制、工具调用与结构化输出的生产级 AI 应用团队
希望跨模型、跨云部署 Agent 并集成 MCP 工具的工程师
想快速上手 Agent 开发的学习者与原型验证者

en.tag: Open-source SDK for production AI agents in Python & TypeScript, any model, any cloud
en.what: Strands Agents is an open-source SDK for building and running AI agents in Python and TypeScript. It takes a model-driven approach, letting you build agents in just a few lines of code while covering the jobs a hand-rolled agent loop grows into.

Photography enthusiasts wanting local AI search, faces, and smart tags instead of cloud albums

zh.tag: 面向 AI 代理的工具版 OpenRouter，一个令牌调用 3000+ 工具端点
zh.what: Treg 是给 AI 代理用的工具聚合网关，类似 OpenRouter 但对象是工具而非模型。代理只需一个 base URL 和一个令牌，就能调用 60+ 供应商的 3000+ 端点，按次计费、低至一分钱，无需向各供应商注册。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 实现的代理服务、CLI 安装脚本与工具目录，支持 endpoint、CLI、skill/bundle 三类注册形式，并提供托管版 treg.to 与自托管方案。
zh.stack: 主语言 Python，通过 HTTP 代理转发上游请求并在服务端注入凭证，CLI 以 shell 脚本安装，托管于 Render。

en.tag: OpenRouter for agent tools — one token, 3,000+ tool endpoints
en.what: Treg is a tool aggregation gateway for AI agents — OpenRouter, but for tools instead of models. Point an agent at one base URL with one token and it can call 3,000+ endpoints across 60+ providers, priced per call from a cent, with no provider signup.
en.content: The repo contains a Python proxy service, a CLI installer, and the tool catalog, supporting endpoints, CLIs, and skill/bundle registrations, with both a hosted treg.to and self-hosting.
en.stack: Written mainly in Python; it proxies upstream requests over HTTP and injects credentials server-side, with a shell-installed CLI, hosted on Render.
en.hot: It quickly reached 3,164 stars with 468 added today, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending daily, hitting the pain of fragmented, expensive agent tool access.
uses: AI agent developers who want agents to call search, scraping, and social tools without integrating each vendor
Indie developers and small teams unwilling to buy pricey Semrush or Apollo subscriptions for a single run

zh.hot: 凭借 7246 星、日增 36 星登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 14 名，其持续 Day-0/Day-1 跟进 Qwen-Image、Flux、Wan 等新模型，让本地低配设备也能跑扩散模型，是热度主因。

en.tag: Pure C/C++ diffusion inference engine for many model families
en.what: stable-diffusion.cpp implements diffusion model inference in pure C/C++, covering Stable Diffusion, Flux, Wan, Qwen Image, Z-Image and more image/video generation models. Built on ggml and modeled after llama.cpp, it aims for lightweight, dependency-free local deployment.
en.content: The repo contains the C/C++ inference core, a CLI tool, an embedded web UI, plus per-model docs (sd.md, flux.md, qwen_image.md, etc.) and assets.
en.stack: Tech stack is C/C++ with the ggml tensor library, no external dependencies, compilable into a standalone binary; supports CPU and multiple acceleration backends.

Engineers integrating image/video generation into C/C++ projects

Hobbyists deploying AI generation on low-end or edge hardware

zh.tag: 输入主题或关键词，一键生成高清短视频的 AI 工具

zh.tag: 配置与监控 Claude Code 的 CLI 工具
zh.what: 这是一个用于配置和监控 Claude Code 的命令行工具，帮助用户管理 Claude Code 的模板、设置和运行状态。它提供了便捷的安装、配置和监控功能，提升 Claude Code 的使用体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 工具源码、模板文件、配置示例和文档，主要使用 Python 编写。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 开发，通过 npm 分发，依赖 Node.js 环境。
zh.hot: 凭借近 3.1 万星标和日增 33 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 Python 第 13 名，反映出 Claude Code 生态的高关注度。
uses: Claude Code 用户 —— 快速配置和监控 Claude Code 运行状态
开发者 —— 集成 Claude Code 到开发工作流中
团队 —— 统一管理 Claude Code 模板和设置

en.tag: CLI tool for configuring and monitoring Claude Code
en.what: A CLI tool for configuring and monitoring Claude Code, helping users manage templates, settings, and runtime status. It provides convenient installation, configuration, and monitoring to enhance the Claude Code experience.
en.content: The repository contains CLI tool source code, template files, configuration examples, and documentation, primarily written in Python.
en.stack: Built with Python and distributed via npm, requiring a Node.js environment.
en.hot: With nearly 31k stars and 33 daily additions, it ranks 13th on GitHub Trending (Python), reflecting the high interest in the Claude Code ecosystem.
uses: Claude Code users — quickly configure and monitor Claude Code runtime
Developers — integrate Claude Code into development workflows
Teams — uniformly manage Claude Code templates and settings

zh.tag: 每日更新的2027夏季技术实习岗位清单，覆盖多方向
zh.what: 这是一个由 Pitt CSC 与 Simplify 共同维护的 Summer 2027 技术实习岗位汇总仓库，涵盖软件工程、数据科学、AI/ML、量化金融、产品管理和硬件工程等方向。岗位列表每天更新，方便学生集中查找和跟踪实习机会。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 README 中的分类岗位表格，按方向列出 2000 多个职位，并配有赞助、公民身份、关闭状态等图例；另有非活跃岗位、非旺季实习和往届归档等辅助 README。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主，用于抓取、整理和更新岗位数据，最终以 Markdown 表格形式呈现；依赖 GitHub 协作流程和社区 issue 提交。
zh.hot: 作为求职季刚需资源，它已获得 47,667 颗星，今日新增 27 星并登上 Python 日榜第 14 名，说明实习信息聚合在学生群体中持续高需求。
uses: 正在寻找 2027 年夏季技术实习的本科生和研究生
想按方向快速筛选软件、数据、AI、量化或硬件岗位的求职者
希望每天获取最新实习开放信息并避免重复投递的学生
想通过社区贡献或 issue 补充岗位信息的开发者

en.tag: A daily-updated list of Summer 2027 tech internships across many fields
en.what: This repo, maintained by Pitt CSC and Simplify, aggregates Summer 2027 tech internship postings across software engineering, data science, AI/ML, quant finance, product management, and hardware. The list is updated daily so students can track openings in one place.
en.content: The repo is mainly README tables listing 2,000+ roles by category, with legends for sponsorship, citizenship, closed status, and more; separate READMEs cover inactive, off-season, and archived internships.
en.stack: Primarily Python for scraping, organizing, and updating job data, rendered as Markdown tables; relies on GitHub workflows and community issue submissions.
en.hot: As a must-have job-hunting resource, it has 47,667 stars, gained 27 today, and ranks 14th on the Python daily trending list, showing sustained demand for internship aggregation among students.
uses: Undergrad and grad students seeking Summer 2027 tech internships
Job seekers who want to filter roles by software, data, AI, quant, or hardware
Students who want daily updates on new openings and avoid duplicate applications
Developers who want to contribute or add postings via community issues

zh.tag: 完全本地运行的 Manus 替代品，自主浏览网页并写代码
zh.what: AgenticSeek 是一个 100% 本地运行的语音 AI 助手，可自主浏览网页、编写与调试代码、规划并执行复杂任务。它专为本地推理模型设计，所有数据留在用户设备上，无需任何云端 API。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 代码为主，包含多智能体调度、网页浏览、代码执行等模块，并提供多语言 README、Logo 素材与演示视频。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 构建，依赖本地推理模型（如 Ollama 等）运行，无需外部 API；采用 GPL-3.0 许可。
zh.hot: 凭借“零 API 费用、完全本地隐私”的卖点，已收获 27312 颗星，今日再增 16 星，稳居 GitHub Python 日榜第 15 名。
uses: 注重隐私、不想把数据交给云端的个人用户与开发者
想零成本体验自主 AI 代理、替代 Manus 等付费服务的人
需要在本地硬件上运行多智能体任务编排的技术爱好者
希望研究本地推理模型与代理工具链的 AI 工程师

en.tag: A fully local Manus alternative that browses the web and codes autonomously
en.what: AgenticSeek is a 100% local, voice-enabled AI assistant that autonomously browses the web, writes and debugs code, and plans complex tasks. Tailored for local reasoning models, it keeps all data on your device with zero cloud dependency.
en.content: The repo is primarily Python code with modules for multi-agent routing, web browsing, and code execution, plus multilingual READMEs, logo assets, and a demo video.
en.stack: Built in Python and powered by local reasoning models (e.g. Ollama) with no external APIs; licensed under GPL-3.0.
en.hot: With its pitch of zero API costs and full local privacy, it has earned 27,312 stars, adding 16 today and ranking 15th on GitHub's daily Python trending list.
uses: Privacy-conscious individuals and developers who don't want data in the cloud
People seeking a zero-cost autonomous AI agent to replace paid services like Manus
Tech enthusiasts wanting to run multi-agent task orchestration on local hardware
AI engineers researching local reasoning models and agent toolchains

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 通知指挥中心，聚合多平台消息并预生成待批动作卡
zh.what: Laya 把 Slack、Gmail、GitHub、Jira、Notion、Outlook、日历等职业工具的通知统一拦截，用本地 LLM（Ollama/LM Studio）或自带 API Key 的云端模型做分类、调研与动作预演，在你打开通知前就生成可直接批准的 Action Cards。它通过 n8n 归一化事件、Python 引擎编排、Tauri 界面呈现，并支持批准后回写执行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 引擎、Tauri + Svelte 前端、n8n 工作流配置，以及多角色大脑（工程/沟通/运营/销售/HR/财务）、Card Workspaces、Card Research、Spaces、跨平台记忆与每日简报等模块，附演示 GIF。
zh.stack: Python 后端 + Tauri/Svelte 桌面端 + 本地 n8n（Node.js）做事件归一化；LLM 层通过 LiteLLM 统一接入 Ollama、LM Studio、Claude、GPT、Gemini 及任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，支持 agent/<id>/<model> 走 CLI 代理配额。
zh.hot: 282 星、今日 +58 并冲上 GitHub Trending Python 日榜第 16，说明开发者对「本地优先 + 通知过载治理 + 代理预演」这一组合需求强烈，且 BYOK 与本地 LLM 降低了隐私与成本顾虑。
uses: 被 Slack、Jira、GitHub 通知淹没的工程师与团队负责人
重视数据隐私、希望用本地 LLM 处理工作消息的个人或小团队
想用代理自动预演回复、建 PR、写工单的 DevOps/运营人员
需要跨平台上下文关联与每日简报的知识工作者

en.tag: Local-first AI notification command center that aggregates multi-platform alerts into pre-staged action cards
en.what: Laya intercepts notifications from Slack, Gmail, GitHub, Jira, Notion, Outlook, Calendar and more, then uses local LLMs (Ollama/LM Studio) or BYOK cloud models to classify, research and stage actions, presenting ready-to-approve Action Cards before you even open the alert. n8n normalizes events, a Python engine orchestrates, and a Tauri UI lets you approve or dismiss actions that get executed back into your tools.
en.content: The repo ships a Python engine, a Tauri + Svelte frontend, n8n workflow configs, plus multi-persona brains (Engineer, Comms, Ops, Sales, HR, Finance), Card Workspaces, Card Research, Spaces, cross-platform memory and a daily briefing, with a demo GIF.
en.stack: Python backend, Tauri/Svelte desktop UI, and local n8n (Node.js) for event normalization; LiteLLM unifies Ollama, LM Studio, Claude, GPT, Gemini and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with agent/<id>/<model> routing to CLI agent quotas.
en.hot: With 282 stars and +58 today, ranking #16 on GitHub Trending (Python daily), it hits a nerve: local-first, notification-overload relief, and agent pre-staging, while BYOK and local LLMs ease privacy and cost worries.
uses: Engineers and team leads drowning in Slack, Jira and GitHub notifications
Privacy-conscious individuals or small teams wanting local LLMs for work messages
DevOps/ops folks who want agents to pre-stage replies, PRs and tickets
Knowledge workers needing cross-platform context linking and a daily briefing

zh.tag: 面向13款AI编程工具的388个Claude技能与插件库
zh.what: 这是一个面向 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor 等 13 款 AI 编程工具的模块化技能库，把工程、营销、合规、C 级顾问、科研等领域的专业知识打包成可复用的 SKILL.md 指令包。每个技能都配有结构化工作流、决策框架和可直接调用的 Python 脚本，让 AI 代理开箱即具备原本没有的领域能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含 388 个技能、118 个 Agent、7 个 Persona 和 150 条命令，覆盖工程、DevOps、营销、安全、合规、C 级顾问、生产力与学术研究等模块，并附带 706 个仅依赖标准库的 Python CLI 脚本和可定制引用文件。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主语言，技能遵循 agentskills.io 的 SKILL.md 标准，脚本零第三方依赖、仅用标准库；通过同步脚本可安装到 Hermes、Mistral Vibe 等工具的本地技能目录。
zh.hot: 已积累约 2.64 万 Star，今日再增 96 并登上 GitHub Trending Python 日榜第 17 名，说明在 AI 编程代理生态爆发期，开发者对跨工具、开箱即用的技能包需求极为旺盛。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 AI 编程工具的开发者，想快速扩展代理的领域能力
需要营销、合规、财务等非工程专业知识的独立开发者或小团队
希望为团队统一 AI 代理工作流与命令规范的工程负责人
从事学术研究、临床研究或研究运营、需要文献与资助流程自动化的研究者

en.tag: 388 Claude Code skills & plugins for 13 AI coding tools
en.what: A modular skill library for 13 AI coding tools including Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Cursor, packaging domain expertise in engineering, marketing, compliance, C-level advisory and research into reusable SKILL.md instruction packs. Each skill ships structured workflows, decision frameworks and callable Python scripts so agents gain domain abilities they lack out of the box.
en.content: It contains 388 skills, 118 agents, 7 personas and 150 commands spanning engineering, DevOps, marketing, security, compliance, C-level advisory, productivity and academic research, plus 706 stdlib-only Python CLI scripts and customizable reference files.
en.stack: Python-first, with skills following the agentskills.io SKILL.md standard; scripts are zero-dependency and stdlib-only, and sync scripts install them into local skill directories for tools like Hermes and Mistral Vibe.
en.hot: With roughly 26.4k stars and 96 added today, ranking 17th on GitHub Trending (Python), it shows intense demand for cross-tool, ready-to-use skill packs amid the AI coding agent boom.
uses: Developers using Claude Code, Codex or Cursor who want to extend their agent's domain abilities fast
Solo developers or small teams needing non-engineering expertise like marketing, compliance or finance
Engineering leads standardizing AI agent workflows and command conventions across a team
Researchers in academic, clinical or research operations needing literature and grant workflow automation

zh.tag: 面向微型设备的 2-bit 自动化基础模型，主打工具调用与结构化抽取
zh.what: Needle 是一个专为手机、可穿戴设备、机器人、智能家居、汽车和微控制器设计的基础模型，整模型仅 8-29 MB 单文件二进制。它牺牲通用聊天能力，换取在移动端工具调用上超越 10 倍大小模型、在结构化抽取上匹敌 2-3 倍大模型的表现。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型权重与各平台推理引擎（托管在 Hugging Face）、Python 包 cactus-needle、架构与基准测试图表，以及工具设计、微调等使用指南。
zh.stack: 主语言 Python，通过 pip install cactus-needle 安装；模型基于 Laddered Simple Attention Network，采用 Monarch Hadamard MLP、GQA 注意力、engram n-gram 记忆与字节级语法约束解码。
zh.hot: 上线即获 12540 stars、今日新增 141，登上 GitHub Trending Python 日榜第 18 名，凭借「端侧小模型 + 精准工具调用」的差异化定位吸引大量关注。
uses: 移动/可穿戴/机器人等端侧应用的开发者，需要在本地做工具调用与意图路由
智能家居、汽车、微控制器等资源受限场景的嵌入式与 IoT 工程师
需要把杂乱文本抽取为结构化字段（发票、预订、通知、表单）的后端与数据团队
希望在本地做语义搜索、匹配与路由，而不依赖云端大模型的产品团队

en.tag: A 2-bit automation foundation model for tiny devices, built for tool calls and structured extraction
en.what: Needle is a foundation model designed for phones, wearables, robots, smart homes, cars and microcontrollers, shipped as a single 8-29 MB binary. It trades general chat capacity to beat models 10x its size on mobile tool calls and match 2-3x bigger models on structured extraction.
en.content: The repo ships model weights and per-platform inference engines (hosted on Hugging Face), the cactus-needle Python package, architecture and benchmark diagrams, plus guides on tool design and fine-tuning.
en.stack: Primarily Python, installed via pip install cactus-needle; the model is a Laddered Simple Attention Network using a Monarch Hadamard MLP, GQA attention, engram n-gram memory and byte-level grammar-constrained decoding.
en.hot: It has quickly reached 12,540 stars with 141 added today, ranking 18th on GitHub Trending's Python daily list, drawing attention for its differentiated on-device small-model plus precise tool-calling positioning.
uses: Developers of mobile, wearable and robotics apps needing on-device tool calling and intent routing
Embedded and IoT engineers working on resource-constrained smart home, automotive and microcontroller scenarios
Backend and data teams extracting messy text into typed fields such as invoices, bookings, notifications and forms
Product teams wanting local semantic search, matching and routing without relying on cloud LLMs

zh.tag: 开源零加价 LLM 网关，统一路由 BYOK 与 1000+ 模型
zh.what: Experiential 是一个面向 Agent 工作流的开源网关与路由器，用一套 OpenAI 兼容 API 统一接入托管、BYOK 和本地模型。它还能基于你的真实流量学习，推荐更优模型、压缩成本，并训练出你专属的路由器或模型。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 Python 实现的网关服务，含首次运行设置向导、身份与预算控制、用量仪表盘，以及面向 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等编码 Agent 的 SETUP.md 接入提示。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主，提供 OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic Messages 接口，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Azure、Bedrock、Fireworks、OpenRouter 等多家供应商密钥。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4288 星、总数 4647，几乎全部热度来自最近一个月，说明「零加价 + 自带密钥 + 可训练专属模型」的定位精准击中了团队对 LLM 成本与治理的痛点。
uses: 需要统一管理多家 LLM 供应商密钥与预算的工程团队
想用自有流量训练专属路由或模型的 AI 平台团队
希望把 Claude Code、Cursor 等编码 Agent 指向自建网关的开发者
关注 LLM 成本优化与用量可观测性的技术负责人

en.tag: Open-source zero-markup LLM gateway routing BYOK and 1000+ models
en.what: Experiential is an open-source gateway and router for agent workflows that unifies hosted, BYOK, and local models behind one OpenAI-compatible API. It also learns from your production traffic to cut costs, recommend better models, and train a specialized router or model you own.
en.content: The repo centers on a Python gateway service with a first-run setup wizard, identity and budget controls, a usage dashboard, and SETUP.md prompts for wiring in coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
en.stack: Primarily Python, exposing OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic Messages APIs, with support for provider keys from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Azure, Bedrock, Fireworks, and OpenRouter.
en.hot: It gained 4,288 of its 4,647 stars this month, meaning nearly all traction is recent — its zero-markup, BYOK, train-your-own-model pitch clearly hits teams' LLM cost and governance pain points.
uses: Engineering teams needing unified key and budget management across LLM providers
AI platform teams wanting to train custom routers or models from their own traffic
Developers pointing coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor at a self-hosted gateway
Tech leads focused on LLM cost optimization and usage observability

zh.tag: Anthropic 官方 Agent Skills 示例与规范仓库
zh.what: 这是 Anthropic 为 Claude 打造的 Agent Skills 官方实现仓库，用文件夹形式封装指令、脚本与资源，让 Claude 能动态加载并稳定完成特定任务。它同时给出 Agent Skills 规范与模板，是理解该机制的标准参考。
zh.content: 仓库分为 skills（创意设计、开发技术、企业通信、文档处理等示例）、spec（Agent Skills 规范）和 template（技能模板）三部分，每个技能自包含一个 SKILL.md 文件。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主语言，技能由 Markdown 指令、脚本和资源文件组成，可注册为 Claude Code 插件并在 Claude.ai 与 API 中使用。
zh.hot: 作为 Anthropic 官方仓库，它公开了驱动 Claude 文档能力的 docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx 技能，叠加 Agent Skills 标准热度，已累积约 17.8 万 star，今日仍新增 155 星。
uses: 想为 Claude 或自研 Agent 编写自定义技能包的开发者
需要参考官方规范与模板来设计 Agent Skills 的团队
研究 Claude 文档生成与编辑能力实现细节的工程师
希望把企业品牌、通信或数据工作流封装成可复用技能的组织

en.tag: Anthropic's official Agent Skills examples and specification repo
en.what: This is Anthropic's official implementation of Agent Skills for Claude, packaging instructions, scripts, and resources into folders that Claude loads dynamically to reliably perform specialized tasks. It also ships the Agent Skills specification and a template, serving as the canonical reference for the mechanism.
en.content: It contains skills (examples for creative & design, development & technical, enterprise & communication, and document skills), spec (the Agent Skills specification), and template (a skill template), with each skill self-contained in a folder with a SKILL.md file.
en.stack: Python is the primary language; skills consist of Markdown instructions, scripts, and resource files, and can be registered as a Claude Code plugin and used in Claude.ai and the API.
en.hot: As an official Anthropic repo, it open-sources the docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx skills powering Claude's document capabilities, and with the Agent Skills standard hype it has reached about 178k stars, still adding 155 today.
uses: Developers who want to author custom skill packs for Claude or their own agents
Teams needing the official spec and template to design Agent Skills
Engineers studying how Claude's document generation and editing capabilities are implemented
Organizations wanting to package branding, communications, or data workflows into reusable skills

zh.tag: 把 IDE 深度接入的编码智能体，开箱即用
zh.what: oh-my-pi（omp）是一个编码智能体，把 IDE 能力直接接入代理工作流，让模型能像在编辑器里一样读写代码、跳转定义和调试。它由 Stencil Labs 打造，是 Pi 的 fork，主打「最完整的代理界面」，开箱即用且完全开放。
zh.content: 仓库以 monorepo 形式组织，核心是 packages/coding-agent 等包，包含约 8 万行 Rust 核心、31 个内置工具、14 个 LSP 操作和 28 个 DAP 操作，并提供安装脚本、Homebrew、Bun、Nix 等多种分发方式。
zh.stack: 主要用 TypeScript 编写，核心以 Rust 实现，运行时基于 Bun，支持 60+ 模型提供商，并通过 LSP/DAP 与 IDE 和调试器集成。
zh.hot: 项目已获 33194 颗星，今日新增 201，位列 GitHub Trending TypeScript 日榜第 3 名，说明「IDE 原生编码代理」这一方向正被大量开发者关注和试用。
uses: 希望让 AI 代理直接操作编辑器、跳转定义和调试的开发者
需要开箱即用、支持多模型提供商的编码代理团队
想研究 Rust 核心与 LSP/DAP 集成实现的工程师
偏好 Bun/Nix/Homebrew 等现代工具链的 macOS 与 Linux 用户

en.tag: A coding agent with the IDE wired in, complete out of the box
en.what: oh-my-pi (omp) is a coding agent that wires IDE capabilities directly into the agent loop, letting models read and write code, jump to definitions, and debug as if inside an editor. Built by Stencil Labs as a fork of Pi, it ships as the most complete agent surface out of the box and is open all the way down.
en.content: The repo is a monorepo centered on packages such as coding-agent, with roughly 80k lines of Rust core, 31 built-in tools, 14 LSP ops, and 28 DAP ops, plus install scripts and Homebrew, Bun, and Nix distribution paths.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript with a Rust core, running on Bun, supporting 60+ model providers and integrating with IDEs and debuggers via LSP/DAP.
en.hot: With 33,194 stars and 201 added today, it ranks 3rd on GitHub Trending for TypeScript, showing strong developer interest in IDE-native coding agents.
uses: Developers who want an AI agent to operate the editor, jump to definitions, and debug directly
Teams needing an out-of-the-box coding agent with multi-provider model support
Engineers curious about the Rust core and LSP/DAP integration
macOS and Linux users who prefer modern toolchains like Bun, Nix, or Homebrew

zh.tag: 开源 SEO 分析平台，支持 AI Agent 与 MCP 工具链集成
zh.what: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、外链审计与站点诊断等核心 SEO 工作流。它采用按量付费模式，用户只需接入自己的 DataForSEO API 密钥即可使用，无需订阅。同时，它内置 MCP 服务器和可复用的 Agent Skills，让 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等 AI 代理直接调用 SEO 数据完成自动化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的前后端应用代码与现代化 UI，支持 Docker 和 Cloudflare 自托管，内置 MCP 服务器以及预设的 Agent Skills（如 keyword-research、competitor-analysis、link-prospecting）。文档涵盖 API 密钥配置、Google Search Console 接入、SEO 成本参考及本地开发指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，前端采用现代 UI 框架，后端依赖 DataForSEO API 获取 SEO 数据，并通过 MCP 协议与外部 AI Agent 通信；支持 Docker 容器化部署与 Cloudflare 边缘托管。
zh.hot: 在 SEO 工具普遍昂贵且功能臃肿的背景下，它以开源、按量付费、可自托管的定位迅速获得关注；4,405 Stars 中本月新增 2,187 颗，登上 GitHub TypeScript 月榜第 17 名，其对 MCP 与 AI Agent 的原生集成进一步放大了开发者与增长团队的兴趣。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 无需订阅高价 SaaS，用自有 API 密钥低成本完成 SEO 监控与关键词研究。
AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。
隐私敏感企业 —— 支持 Docker/Cloudflare 自托管，完全掌控数据与成本。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.
en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

zh.tag: 用 React 代码以编程方式生成视频的框架
zh.what: Remotion 让你用 React 组件来定义视频画面、动画和音频，把代码当作视频的唯一真实来源。它支持通过编码代理、拖拽编辑器或纯代码三种方式创作，并能连接数据批量渲染视频。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心渲染引擎、Player 播放器、Lambda/Vercel 云端渲染方案、编辑器起步模板，以及 Elements、Effects、Transitions、Captions、Fonts 等大量可复用组件和 1000 多页文档。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 和 React 构建，通过 Node.js 运行，依赖 FFmpeg 等完成视频编码，并提供 NPM 包、Lambda 与 Vercel 沙箱等渲染后端。
zh.hot: 凭借 60311 颗星和今日新增 139 星登上 TypeScript 日榜第 5，Remotion 把 React 生态与视频自动化结合，正好契合当下 AI 代理生成视频的热潮。
uses: 前端开发者想用熟悉的 React 语法制作动画视频或动态图形
需要批量生成个性化视频的营销、电商或数据可视化团队
希望让 AI 编码代理自动产出视频内容的开发者
想构建在线视频编辑器或视频生成应用的产品团队

en.tag: A framework for making videos programmatically with React
en.what: Remotion lets you define video frames, animations, and audio with React components, treating code as the single source of truth. It supports creating videos agentically, interactively via drag-and-drop, or purely in code, and can connect to data for batch rendering.
en.content: The repo contains the core rendering engine, the Player, Lambda/Vercel cloud rendering options, an editor starter template, and a large set of reusable components like Elements, Effects, Transitions, Captions, and Fonts, plus 1000+ pages of docs.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and React, runs on Node.js, relies on FFmpeg and similar tools for video encoding, and offers NPM packages plus Lambda and Vercel sandbox rendering backends.
en.hot: With 60,311 stars and 139 added today, ranking 5th on the TypeScript daily trending list, Remotion bridges the React ecosystem with video automation, riding the current wave of AI agents generating videos.
uses: Frontend developers who want to create animated videos or motion graphics using familiar React syntax
Marketing, e-commerce, or data-viz teams needing to batch-generate personalized videos
Developers who want AI coding agents to automatically produce video content
Product teams building online video editors or video-generation applications

zh.tag: FastAPI 官方全栈模板：React + PostgreSQL + Docker 开箱即用
zh.what: 这是 FastAPI 作者维护的全栈 Web 应用脚手架，后端用 FastAPI + SQLModel + PostgreSQL，前端用 React + TypeScript + Vite，并内置 JWT 认证、密码找回、CI/CD 与 Docker Compose 部署。点击「Use this template」即可生成新仓库，直接开始写业务代码。
zh.content: 仓库分为 backend（FastAPI 应用、模型、API 路由、Pytest 测试）与 frontend（React 页面、自动生成的 API 客户端、shadcn/ui 组件）两大目录，另含 Docker Compose、Traefik 反代、GitHub Actions 工作流与多份部署/开发文档。
zh.stack: 后端 FastAPI + SQLModel + Pydantic + PostgreSQL，前端 React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui，测试用 Pytest 与 Playwright，部署依赖 Docker Compose、Traefik 与 FastAPI Cloud。
zh.hot: 作为 FastAPI 官方模板，它长期是 Python 全栈项目的首选起点，45.7k star 说明社区认可度极高；今日再登 TypeScript 日榜第 6，说明前端技术栈的更新持续吸引新用户。
uses: 想快速搭建生产级 FastAPI + React 全栈项目的独立开发者
需要标准 JWT 认证、邮件找回与 CI/CD 模板的初创团队
学习 FastAPI 与 React 前后端协作的进阶学习者
希望用 Docker Compose 自托管部署 Web 应用的运维人员

en.tag: Official FastAPI full-stack template: React + PostgreSQL + Docker, ready out of the box
en.what: This is the official full-stack web app scaffold maintained by the FastAPI author: a FastAPI + SQLModel + PostgreSQL backend paired with a React + TypeScript + Vite frontend, including JWT auth, password recovery, CI/CD and Docker Compose deployment. Click "Use this template" to spin up a new repo and start writing business logic immediately.
en.content: The repo splits into backend (FastAPI app, models, API routes, Pytest tests) and frontend (React pages, auto-generated API client, shadcn/ui components), plus Docker Compose, Traefik reverse proxy, GitHub Actions workflows and several deployment/development docs.
en.stack: Backend: FastAPI + SQLModel + Pydantic + PostgreSQL. Frontend: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui. Testing uses Pytest and Playwright, while deployment relies on Docker Compose, Traefik and FastAPI Cloud.
en.hot: As the official FastAPI template, it has long been the go-to starting point for Python full-stack projects, and 45.7k stars show strong community trust. Re-entering the TypeScript daily trending list at #6 today shows its modern frontend stack keeps drawing new users.
uses: Indie developers who want a production-ready FastAPI + React full-stack starting point
Startup teams needing standard JWT auth, email recovery and CI/CD scaffolding
Advanced learners studying FastAPI and React frontend-backend collaboration
Ops engineers who prefer self-hosting web apps via Docker Compose

zh.tag: 将原始资料编译为可引用互链 Wiki 的知识编译器
zh.what: llmwiki 是一个知识编译器，把论文、笔记、README、转录、PDF、图片或网页等原始资料一次性编译成持久化、可引用溯源的 Markdown Wiki。它实现了 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式，让知识在编译时结构化，而不是在查询时反复从原始文件中重新发现。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编译器核心、本地 Wiki 查看器、可配置的生命周期 Profile（如 AutoSci、Newsroom）、模板发布与安装机制，以及文档和主题（Scientific Clay、Minimal 等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，发布为 npm 包 llm-wiki-compiler，依赖 Node.js 生态，支持嵌入索引存储和本地查看器。
zh.hot: 该项目今日登上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 日榜第 7 名，共获得 2111 颗星，今日新增 10 颗，反映出开发者对持久化、可溯源 AI 知识库的强烈需求。
uses: 需要将论文、笔记、PDF 等原始资料编译成持久知识库的研究人员
希望为 AI 代理提供稳定、可引用上下文的开发者
需要构建领域特定 Wiki（如科研、新闻编辑室）的团队
想要浏览、查询、检查、导出和复用知识库的内容管理者

en.tag: A knowledge compiler that turns raw sources into an interlinked, citation-traceable wiki.
en.what: llmwiki is a knowledge compiler that turns raw sources such as papers, notes, READMEs, transcripts, PDFs, images, or web pages into a persistent, citation-traceable Markdown wiki. It implements Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern, structuring knowledge at compile time instead of re-discovering it from raw files at query time.
en.content: The repo contains a TypeScript compiler core, a local wiki viewer, configurable lifecycle profiles (such as AutoSci and Newsroom), template publishing and installation, plus documentation and themes (Scientific Clay, Minimal, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily built with TypeScript and published as the npm package llm-wiki-compiler, it relies on the Node.js ecosystem and supports embedding index storage and a local viewer.
en.hot: It ranks 7th on GitHub Trending's daily TypeScript list with 2,111 stars and 10 new stars today, reflecting strong demand for persistent, traceable AI knowledge bases.
uses: Researchers who need to compile papers, notes, PDFs, and other raw materials into a persistent knowledge base
Developers who want to give AI agents stable, citation-aware context
Teams building domain-specific wikis, such as for science or newsrooms
Content managers who want to browse, query, lint, export, and reuse a knowledge base

zh.tag: Cloudflare 开源的 AI 生产力工作台，让公司安全地用上智能体
zh.what: Cloudflare OS 是一个面向企业的 AI 生产力「操作系统」，最初在 Cloudflare 内部使用，覆盖工程、销售等大量员工。它提供智能体聊天界面、沙箱化应用开发和安全护栏框架，让非技术用户也能安全地让 AI 干活。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 TypeScript 应用：智能体聊天界面、用于生成幻灯片/白板等「gadgets」的蓝图与沙箱运行时，以及名为 Gatekeepers 的安全框架，并附带本地运行与部署脚本。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 与 Cloudflare Workers/wrangler/workerd 构建，使用 pnpm 管理依赖，可本地运行或一键部署到 Cloudflare 账户。
zh.hot: 作为 Cloudflare 官方开源的内部 AI 工作台，它把企业级智能体落地经验直接开放，今日新增 33 星、总星数破万，登上 TypeScript 日榜第 8。
uses: 企业 IT 与安全团队：想安全引入 AI 智能体并控制风险
内部工具开发者：希望快速搭建公司专属的 AI 工作台
非技术员工：通过聊天让 AI 生成文档、应用和幻灯片
AI 平台工程师：研究 Cloudflare Workers 上的智能体沙箱架构

en.tag: Cloudflare's open-source AI productivity workspace for safe enterprise agents
en.what: Cloudflare OS is an enterprise AI productivity "operating system", originally built for internal use across Cloudflare's engineering, sales, and other teams. It offers an agent chat UI, sandboxed app development, and a security guardrail framework so non-technical users can safely let AI do work.
en.content: The repo contains a full TypeScript app: an agent chat UI, blueprints and a sandbox runtime for building "gadgets" like slide decks and whiteboards, plus a security framework called Gatekeepers, along with local-run and deploy scripts.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers, wrangler, and workerd, managed via pnpm, and runnable locally or deployable to a Cloudflare account.
en.hot: As Cloudflare's official open-source internal AI workspace, it opens up real enterprise agent deployment experience; with 33 stars today and over 10k total, it ranks 8th on the TypeScript daily trending list.
uses: Enterprise IT and security teams wanting to adopt AI agents safely
Internal tool developers building a company-specific AI workspace
Non-technical staff using chat to generate docs, apps, and slides
AI platform engineers studying agent sandboxing on Cloudflare Workers

zh.tag: 并行多智能体编排的桌面级 ADE，自带订阅即可跑任意编码代理
zh.what: Orca 是一个面向编码代理的 ADE（Agent Development Environment），让你把 Codex、ClaudeCode、OpenCode、Pi 等代理并排运行，每个代理跑在独立的 git worktree 里并统一追踪。它支持桌面端、移动端伴侣 App 与远程运行时，用你自己的订阅即可驱动任意编码代理。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 编写的桌面应用为主体，包含 resources 图标与构建资源、docs 多语言 README（中/日/韩/西/法/葡）与功能演示 GIF、移动端伴侣 App（iOS/TestFlight/Android APK）以及远程运行时相关代码。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，基于 Electron 风格的跨平台桌面应用（macOS/Windows/Linux），配套 iOS/Android 移动端与远程运行时，MIT 许可，依赖各编码代理 CLI 与 git worktree 机制。
zh.hot: 本周新增 5362 star、总量约 6.95 万，冲上 GitHub Trending 周榜 TypeScript 第 14 名；多代理并行编排正是当下最热的开发范式，而 Orca 让用户用自己的订阅跑多个代理，切中成本与效率痛点。
uses: 同时使用多个编码代理、需要并行对比结果的开发者
希望用自有订阅而非额外付费来驱动代理的个人与团队
需要在手机上监控和跟进代理进度、随时发指令的工程师
想用 git worktree 隔离实验、再择优合并的工程团队

en.tag: A desktop ADE for orchestrating a fleet of parallel coding agents on your own subscription
en.what: Orca is an Agent Development Environment for running a fleet of coding agents in parallel. It runs Codex, ClaudeCode, OpenCode or Pi side-by-side, each in its own isolated git worktree, tracked in one place, and works on desktop, mobile companion app and remote runtime using your own subscription.
en.content: The repo centers on a TypeScript desktop app, with build resources and icons, multilingual docs (zh-CN, ja, ko, es, fr, pt) plus feature GIFs, a mobile companion app (iOS App Store, TestFlight, Android APK) and remote runtime code.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript as a cross-platform desktop app (macOS/Windows/Linux), paired with iOS/Android companions and a remote runtime, MIT-licensed, and relying on coding-agent CLIs plus git worktrees.
en.hot: It gained 5,362 stars this week to reach ~69.5k total, landing at #14 on GitHub Trending's weekly TypeScript chart. Parallel multi-agent orchestration is the hottest dev paradigm right now, and Orca's bring-your-own-subscription model hits both cost and efficiency pain points.
uses: Developers running multiple coding agents and comparing results in parallel
Individuals and teams wanting to drive agents with their own existing subscriptions
Engineers who need to monitor and steer agents from their phone on the go
Teams wanting isolated git worktree experiments and merging the winner

zh.tag: Cursor 官方插件规范与插件集合
zh.what: 这是 Cursor 官方维护的插件规范与插件仓库，定义了 agent 插件如何以独立目录加 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json 清单的形式组织。仓库同时收录了一批面向开发者工具、框架和 SaaS 产品的官方插件，覆盖代码审查、任务编排、学习记忆等场景。
zh.content: 仓库根目录下每个插件是一个独立目录，各自带有 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json 清单，README 用表格列出插件名、作者、分类与描述。已收录 teaching、continual-learning、cursor-team-kit、thermos、create-plugin、ralph-loop、orchestrate、pstack、advisor、grok-voice 等十余个插件。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，插件以清单文件加目录结构的形式分发，部分插件依赖 Cursor SDK 与 CLI 能力。整体是围绕 Cursor agent 生态的插件化扩展方案。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4683 star，总 star 达 7254，冲上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 3 名。Cursor 官方亲自下场定义插件规范，加上 agent 工具链正处风口，让开发者迅速涌入关注。
uses: Cursor 深度用户：想用官方插件扩展 agent 的代码审查、编排与学习能力
插件开发者：需要遵循官方规范脚手架并发布自己的 agent 插件
团队工程负责人：关注 CI、代码评审与本地自动化的内部工作流插件
AI 工具链研究者：想了解 agent 插件规范与生态的组织方式

en.tag: Cursor plugin spec and official plugin collection
en.what: This is Cursor's official plugin specification and plugin collection, defining how agent plugins are structured as standalone directories with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest. It also ships a set of official plugins for popular developer tools, frameworks, and SaaS products, covering code review, task orchestration, and learning memory.
en.content: Each plugin lives in its own directory at the repo root with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest, and the README tabulates name, author, category, and description. It already includes a dozen-plus plugins such as teaching, continual-learning, cursor-team-kit, thermos, create-plugin, ralph-loop, orchestrate, pstack, advisor, and grok-voice.
en.stack: The primary language is TypeScript, and plugins are distributed as manifest files plus directory structures, with some relying on the Cursor SDK and CLI capabilities. Overall it is a plugin-based extension scheme around the Cursor agent ecosystem.
en.hot: It gained 4,683 stars this month for a total of 7,254, reaching No. 3 on GitHub Trending's monthly chart. Cursor itself stepping in to define the plugin spec, amid the agent tooling boom, quickly drew developer attention.
uses: Heavy Cursor users: extend agent code review, orchestration, and learning via official plugins
Plugin developers: scaffold and publish their own agent plugins following the official spec
Team engineering leads: interested in internal workflow plugins for CI, code review, and local automation
AI tooling researchers: want to understand how agent plugin specs and ecosystems are organized

zh.tag: 阶跃星辰出品的终端 AI 编程代理，主打长任务自治与省 token
zh.what: Step Code 是一个运行在终端里的 AI 编程代理，能完成读代码、改代码、跑测试的完整任务闭环。它接入 Step（阶跃星辰）模型服务，支持 MCP、Agent Skills、插件与多智能体编排，并可用 /goal 把长任务交给它自主推进。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 实现 CLI 主体，包含安装脚本（install.sh / install.ps1）、Step 模型接入与登录流程、MCP/Agent Skills/插件体系、/goal 与 /cron 长任务调度，以及内置的 StepPage 静态站点发布插件。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，以 npm/CLI 形式分发，通过官方安装脚本下载并校验发布包；依赖 Step 平台 API 与 Step Plan 账号鉴权，兼容大部分 Claude Code 插件。
zh.hot: 作为国产大模型厂商阶跃星辰开源的终端编程代理，凭长任务自治、token 效率和一键发布静态站点等差异化能力登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 TypeScript 第 11 名，今日新增 25 star、总数 393，正处于快速爬升期。
uses: 习惯在终端里工作的开发者，希望用命令行完成编码、调试与交付全流程
需要把重构、批量修改等长耗时任务交给代理自主推进的工程团队
想低成本接入国产 Step 模型、又希望复用 Claude Code 插件生态的用户
需要快速把本地页面发布成可分享静态站点并做版本回滚的前端/独立开发者

en.tag: StepFun's terminal AI coding agent focused on long-horizon autonomy and token efficiency
en.what: Step Code is a terminal-based AI coding agent that handles the full loop of reading code, making edits, and running tests. It connects to Step (StepFun) models and supports MCP servers, Agent Skills, plugins, and multi-agent orchestration, with /goal delegating long-running tasks for autonomous execution.
en.content: The repo is a TypeScript CLI containing installer scripts (install.sh / install.ps1), Step model sign-in and provider access, an MCP/Agent Skills/plugin ecosystem, /goal and /cron long-task scheduling, plus the built-in StepPage static-site publishing plugin.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript and distributed as a CLI via official install scripts that download and checksum releases; it relies on the Step Platform API and Step Plan account auth, and is compatible with most Claude Code plugins.
en.hot: As an open-source terminal coding agent from Chinese model maker StepFun, it hit No.11 on GitHub Trending's daily TypeScript list thanks to long-horizon autonomy, token efficiency, and one-command static-site publishing, gaining 25 stars today for a total of 393 while still climbing fast.
uses: Developers who live in the terminal and want coding, debugging, and delivery in one CLI workflow
Engineering teams that need long-running refactors or bulk edits delegated to an autonomous agent
Users who want to use StepFun's Step models while reusing the Claude Code plugin ecosystem
Frontend or indie developers needing one-command static-site publishing with versioning and rollback

zh.tag: 把云基础设施与应用逻辑统一为类型安全的 Effect 程序
zh.what: Alchemy 提出「Infrastructure-as-Effects」，把云资源（存储桶、队列、Worker/Lambda、IAM 等）和应用逻辑写进同一个 Effect 程序里。它用一行绑定调用自动接好 IAM 策略、环境变量和类型化 SDK 客户端，部署时与运行时共用同一套代码，无需 YAML 或第二个运行时。
zh.content: 仓库包含 alchemy CLI 与核心库、可复用的 GitHub Action（部署 prod、PR 预览环境并自动销毁）、examples 示例目录，以及面向 AI 编码代理的 llms.txt 文档索引。

Engineers running API tests in CI via the CLI

zh.tag: 将遗留系统逆向为AI代理可执行规格的框架
zh.what: Reversa 是一个规格逆向工程框架，安装到遗留项目中后，会协调一组专门的 AI 代理分析现有代码，提取业务规则、流程、模块契约等隐含知识，并生成完整、可追溯的规格说明。这些规格不是给人看的文档，而是可供任何编码代理使用的可执行操作契约，帮助 AI 在演进系统时保持与现有行为一致。
zh.content: 仓库包含安装器、代理技能文件（复制到 .agents/skills/ 和 .claude/skills/）、引擎入口文件（如 CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md）、以及 .reversa/ 状态与配置目录，还提供 SHA-256 清单用于安全更新。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，通过 npx 安装，依赖 Node.js 环境，并自动检测 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 AI 引擎。

uses: 维护大型遗留系统的工程师，希望用 AI 代理安全地演进代码
需要为无文档的旧项目生成可执行规格的团队
使用 Claude Code、Codex 或 Cursor 等 AI 编码代理的开发者
进行逆向工程或系统现代化改造的技术负责人

en.tag: Reverse-engineer legacy systems into executable specs for AI agents
en.what: Reversa is a specification reverse-engineering framework that installs into legacy projects and coordinates a team of specialized AI agents to analyze existing code, extract implicit knowledge (business rules, flows, module contracts), and generate complete, traceable specifications. These are not human-readable docs but operational contracts that any coding agent can use to evolve the system with fidelity to what already exists.
en.content: The repo includes an installer, agent skill files (copied to .agents/skills/ and .claude/skills/), engine entry files (e.g., CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md), a .reversa/ directory for state and configuration, and a SHA-256 manifest for safe updates.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, installed via npx, requires Node.js, and auto-detects AI engines like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.
en.hot: It ranks 10th on GitHub Trending (JavaScript) with 1,633 stars and 7 new today, gaining attention for solving the pain point of AI agents lacking specs when working with legacy systems.

Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor
Tech leads doing reverse engineering or system modernization

en.tag: A full-featured Dockerized mail server suite, ready to use out of the box.

zh.tag: 洛雪音乐播放器的第三方音源脚本合集

en.tag: A collection of third-party music source scripts for the LX Music player
en.what: This repo gathers third-party music source scripts for the LX Music player (lx-music-desktop / lx-music-mobile), packaging various community source APIs into ready-to-import JS links. Users just paste a link into the player to expand the searchable and playable music library.

zh.tag: 30 天循序渐进掌握 JavaScript 的开源学习挑战
zh.what: 这是一个按天拆解的 JavaScript 学习挑战，从数据类型、条件、循环一路讲到 DOM、Promise 与闭包。作者鼓励按自己的节奏推进，即使花上百天也没关系。

en.tag: A 30-day step-by-step open-source challenge to learn JavaScript
en.what: This is a day-by-day JavaScript learning challenge, walking from data types, conditionals and loops all the way to DOM, Promises and closures. The author encourages learners to go at their own pace, even if it takes over 100 days.

zh.tag: 面向多种 AI 编程代理的规范驱动开发与上下文工程框架
zh.what: GSD Core 是一个轻量级的元提示与上下文工程框架，用规范驱动的五步循环（讨论、规划、执行、验证、交付）驱动 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理。它通过让繁重的调研、规划和执行在全新上下文的子代理中运行，解决上下文腐化导致的质量下降问题。

en.tag: A spec-driven development and context-engineering framework for AI coding agents
en.what: GSD Core is a lightweight meta-prompting and context-engineering framework that drives AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor through a disciplined five-step spec-driven loop: Discuss, Plan, Execute, Verify, Ship. It solves context rot by running heavy research, planning, and execution in fresh-context subagents while keeping the main session lean.
en.content: The repo contains the @opengsd/gsd-core npm package, an installer, agents/ and commands/ directories, multilingual READMEs (including Simplified Chinese), and docs covering explanations, how-tos, and tutorials.
en.stack: Written primarily in JavaScript and distributed as an npm package installed via npx, supporting runtimes such as Claude Code, OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, Kimi CLI, Kilo, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, and Windsurf.
en.hot: By directly tackling the pain point of context rot and supporting a dozen-plus AI coding tools, it has reached 9,829 stars with 28 added today, ranking 14th on GitHub Trending's daily JavaScript list.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor who want more controlled, spec-driven output
Teams managing large codebases worried about quality degradation from context rot in long sessions
Individuals or teams wanting a spec-driven Discuss-Plan-Execute-Verify-Ship loop to constrain AI agents
Engineers seeking a consistent workflow across multiple AI coding runtimes

zh.tag: 基于对象存储的 Rust 分布式图数据库
zh.what: HydraDB 是一个用 Rust 编写的对象存储原生分布式图数据库，将持久化图数据存放在 S3 兼容对象存储上，实现存储与计算完全分离。它支持快照一致的 OpenCypher 查询、GraphBLAS 遍历、Neo4j 兼容的 Bolt 连接以及 HTTPS 查询 API。
zh.content: 仓库包含数据节点（graph-node）与索引器（graph-indexer）两类计算角色、SlateDB 存储层、OpenCypher 查询引擎、GraphBLAS 遍历实现、Bolt/HTTP 接口，以及容器镜像、OpenCypher TCK 测试和在线基准测试配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 1.91+，依赖 SlateDB 做持久化、SuiteSparse GraphBLAS 做稀疏遍历，支持 S3 兼容对象存储、Neo4j Bolt 5.x 驱动与 HTTPS JSON/NDJSON API，采用 AGPL-3.0 许可。
zh.hot: 它以“对象存储上的图数据库”这一新颖架构切中云原生图计算痛点，今日新增 1344 star 冲上 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 1 名，总 star 达 5906，热度极高。
uses: 需要云原生、低成本图数据库的架构师与后端工程师
使用 Neo4j 生态、希望迁移到对象存储方案的团队
研究存储计算分离与分布式图查询的开发者

en.tag: A Rust distributed graph database built on object storage
en.what: HydraDB is an object-store-native distributed graph database written in Rust, keeping durable graph data on S3-compatible object storage with fully disaggregated storage and compute. It offers snapshot-consistent OpenCypher queries, GraphBLAS traversal, Neo4j-compatible Bolt connectivity, and an HTTPS query API.
en.content: The repo contains two compute roles (graph-node and graph-indexer), a SlateDB storage layer, an OpenCypher query engine, GraphBLAS traversal, Bolt/HTTP interfaces, plus container images, OpenCypher TCK tests, and live benchmark setup.
en.stack: Built in Rust 1.91+, it relies on SlateDB for durability and SuiteSparse GraphBLAS for sparse traversal, supports S3-compatible object storage, Neo4j Bolt 5.x drivers, and HTTPS JSON/NDJSON APIs, under AGPL-3.0.
en.hot: Its novel "graph database on object storage" architecture addresses cloud-native graph computing pain points, and with 1,344 stars added today it tops the GitHub Trending Rust daily chart, reaching 5,906 total stars.
uses: Architects and backend engineers needing a cloud-native, low-cost graph database
Teams using the Neo4j ecosystem looking to move to an object-storage approach

Applications building large knowledge graphs or relationship networks on S3

en.tag: A developer control plane to deploy, route, secure and observe A2A agents with one command

zh.tag: CS2 游戏内存偏移与接口转储工具

zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源代码、构建脚本、测试用例以及文档。主要模块包括内存读取、偏移解析和代码生成，输出文件可指定为 cs、hpp、json、rs、zig 等格式。

zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上获得 2368 颗星，今日新增 7 星，位列 Rust 日榜第 3 名。因其针对热门游戏 CS2 且功能实用，深受游戏逆向工程社区关注。
uses: 游戏逆向工程师 —— 用于分析 CS2 游戏内存结构，开发作弊或辅助工具。
安全研究人员 —— 研究游戏内存保护机制和反作弊系统。
Rust 开发者 —— 学习内存操作和跨平台开发技术。

en.tag: External offset/interface dumper for Counter-Strike 2
en.what: cs2-dumper is an external offset/interface dumper for Counter-Strike 2, supporting both Windows and Linux. It reads the game process memory to automatically generate offset and interface definition files in languages like C++, Rust, and Zig, aiding game hacking or reverse engineering.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, build scripts, tests, and documentation. Key modules include memory reading, offset parsing, and code generation, with output files customizable to formats like cs, hpp, json, rs, and zig.
en.stack: Built in Rust, it relies on the memflow library for cross-platform memory access and requires Rust compiler version 1.74.0 or newer. It supports extensibility via memflow connectors such as pcileech and kvm.
en.hot: The project has 2368 stars on GitHub, with 7 new stars today, ranking 3rd on the Rust daily trending list. Its focus on the popular game CS2 and practical utility make it highly popular in the game reverse engineering community.
uses: Game reverse engineers — for analyzing CS2 memory structures to develop cheats or tools.
Security researchers — for studying game memory protection and anti-cheat systems.
Rust developers — for learning memory manipulation and cross-platform development.
