zh.tag: 开源可组合支付基础设施，Rust 打造，支持多支付渠道智能路由
zh.what: Hyperswitch 是一个开源、可组合的支付平台，帮助商户连接多个支付、代付、反欺诈、保险库与令牌化服务商。它通过智能路由提升授权成功率并挽回收入，同时用成本可观测性降低支付处理费用，并以对账能力减少支付运营负担。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的支付核心服务、各支付渠道连接器、路由与成本可观测性模块、对账组件，以及 Docker 快速启动、云部署配置和完整文档。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，提供 SaaS 与自托管两种部署方式，符合 PCI 合规要求，依赖 Docker 等容器化工具，并集成多种支付服务商 API。
zh.hot: 作为 Juspay 出品的开源支付基础设施，它切中支付成本与授权率痛点，已获 43911 星，今日新增 161 星，位列 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 5。
uses: 支付团队与电商平台，需要统一接入多个支付服务商并优化路由
希望降低支付手续费、提升授权成功率的增长与财务团队
需要自托管、PCI 合规支付基础设施的企业架构师
关注 Rust 与开源支付系统的开发者与研究者

en.tag: Open-source composable payments infrastructure in Rust with smart routing across providers
en.what: Hyperswitch is an open-source, composable payments platform that connects businesses to multiple payment, payout, fraud, vault and tokenization providers. It uplifts authorization with intelligent routing and revenue recovery, reduces processing costs via cost observability, and cuts payment ops with reconciliation.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust-based payments core, provider connectors, routing and cost-observability modules, reconciliation components, plus Docker quickstart, cloud deployment configs and full documentation.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, offered as SaaS or self-hosted, PCI compliant, relying on Docker and container tooling while integrating many payment provider APIs.
en.hot: Backed by Juspay, it tackles payment cost and authorization-rate pain points, reaching 43,911 stars with 161 added today, ranking #5 on GitHub Trending (Rust) daily.
uses: Payment teams and e-commerce platforms needing unified multi-provider integration and routing
Growth and finance teams aiming to cut fees and boost authorization rates
Enterprise architects requiring self-hosted, PCI-compliant payment infrastructure
Developers and researchers interested in Rust and open-source payment systems

zh.tag: 本地优先的多设备编码代理控制平面
zh.what: Zeron 是一个面向 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Devin 等编码代理的原生控制平面。它默认在本地运行，每台设备上的小型引擎把会话存在本机，无需账号或联网即可使用，并可选开启多设备同步。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的引擎与守护进程、桌面侧边栏应用、落地页资源（apps/landing）、安装脚本以及架构与 Linux/Windows 参考文档。
zh.stack: 以 Rust 为主语言，提供 CLI（zeron status/update/daemon）、安装脚本与桌面应用；依赖本地守护进程与可选的同步账户体系。
zh.hot: 本周新增 394 星、总计 1823 星，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 周榜第 14 名；本地优先、多代理统一管控的定位正好切中编码代理爆发的痛点。
uses: 同时使用多个编码代理、希望统一管理会话的开发者
注重隐私、要求会话数据默认留在本地的团队
需要在一台常开机器上远程驱动其他设备代理的用户
想研究编码代理控制平面架构的 Rust 开发者

en.tag: A local-first control plane for coding agents across devices
en.what: Zeron is a native control plane for coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Devin. It runs locally by default, with each device storing sessions on-device and no account or network required, plus optional multi-device sync.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust engine and daemon, a desktop sidebar app, landing page assets under apps/landing, an install script, and architecture plus Linux/Windows reference docs.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, offering a CLI (zeron status/update/daemon), an install script, and a desktop app; it relies on a local daemon and an optional synced account system.
en.hot: It gained 394 stars this week for 1,823 total, ranking 14th on GitHub Trending's weekly Rust list; its local-first, multi-agent control positioning hits a real pain point as coding agents proliferate.
uses: Developers juggling multiple coding agents who want unified session management
Teams that prioritize privacy and want sessions to stay local by default
Users who need an always-on machine to drive agents on other devices remotely
Rust developers curious about coding-agent control plane architecture

zh.tag: 人类与 AI 代理共处一室的自托管协作工作区
zh.what: Buzz 是一个可自托管的协作平台，让人类和 AI 代理在同一个频道、画布、工作流和语音房间中一起工作。它基于 Nostr 中继，每条消息、反应、工作流步骤、代码审查和 git 事件都是同一日志中的签名事件，人类和代理拥有相同的身份模型与审计轨迹。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的中继与客户端代码、架构与愿景文档（ARCHITECTURE.md、VISION*.md）、发布说明以及界面截图，展示频道线程、代理协作等场景。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，基于 Nostr 协议构建事件日志，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证，依赖大量 Rust crate。
zh.hot: 凭借 34282 颗星和今日新增 171 星登上 GitHub Rust 日榜第 7 名，其“人类与代理同权协作”的独特定位和自托管中继模式吸引了大量关注。
uses: 希望让 AI 代理深度参与开发流程的工程团队
需要可审计、可自托管协作平台的隐私敏感组织
探索多代理编排与工作流自动化的开发者
对 Nostr 协议和事件日志架构感兴趣的技术人员

en.tag: A self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents share the same rooms
en.what: Buzz is a self-hostable collaboration platform where humans and AI agents work together in the same channels, canvases, workflows, and voice huddles. Built on a Nostr relay, every message, reaction, workflow step, review approval, and git event is a signed event in one log, giving humans and agents the same identity model and audit trail.
en.content: The repo contains Rust-based relay and client code, architecture and vision docs (ARCHITECTURE.md, VISION*.md), release notes, and UI screenshots showing channel threads and agent collaboration.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the Nostr protocol as an event log, licensed under Apache 2.0, and depends on a large number of Rust crates.
en.hot: With 34,282 stars and 171 added today, it ranks 7th on GitHub's Rust daily trending list, drawing attention for its unique 'humans and agents as peers' positioning and self-hosted relay model.
uses: Engineering teams wanting AI agents deeply involved in their dev workflow
Privacy-conscious organizations needing an auditable, self-hostable collaboration platform
Developers exploring multi-agent orchestration and workflow automation
Technologists interested in the Nostr protocol and event-log architecture

zh.tag: 基于 Tauri 的现代化跨平台代理客户端
zh.what: Clash Verge Rev 是 Clash Verge 的延续项目，一个基于 Tauri 的 Clash Meta GUI 客户端，为 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 提供定制化的代理体验。它内置 mihomo 内核，帮助用户便捷地管理和切换代理节点与规则。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 Tauri 后端（src-tauri）与前端界面，提供安装包、多语言 README 文档、预览截图以及配置管理、节点编辑、WebDav 同步等功能模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 与 Tauri 2 框架，内置 Clash.Meta(mihomo) 内核，前端界面支持自定义主题与 CSS 注入。
zh.hot: 凭借 14.6 万 star 和今日新增 466 的热度，它因跨平台、界面美观且功能强大而深受代理用户青睐，稳居 Rust 日榜第 16 名。
uses: 需要跨平台代理客户端的普通用户，追求简洁美观的图形界面
希望可视化编辑节点与规则的高级玩家
需要 TUN 模式或系统代理守卫的开发者与运维人员
想通过 WebDav 同步配置的多设备用户

en.tag: A modern cross-platform proxy client built on Tauri
en.what: Clash Verge Rev is a continuation of Clash Verge, a Clash Meta GUI client built on Tauri that delivers a tailored proxy experience on Windows, macOS, and Linux. It bundles the mihomo core to help users easily manage and switch proxy nodes and rules.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust-based Tauri backend (src-tauri) and a frontend UI, offering installers, multilingual README docs, preview screenshots, and feature modules for config management, node editing, and WebDav sync.
en.stack: Primarily built with Rust and the Tauri 2 framework, bundling the Clash.Meta (mihomo) core, with a frontend supporting custom themes and CSS injection.
en.hot: With 146k stars and 466 added today, it's favored by proxy users for being cross-platform, polished, and feature-rich, ranking 16th on the Rust daily trending list.
uses: Everyday users wanting a cross-platform proxy client with a clean GUI
Advanced users who need visual node and rule editing
Developers and ops staff needing TUN mode or system proxy guard
Multi-device users who want to sync configs via WebDav

zh.tag: 用系统无障碍树让 AI 代理可靠操作桌面应用
zh.what: Agent Desktop 让任意 AI 代理在桌面上可靠地操作电脑。它通过操作系统无障碍树读取任意应用真实的 UI 结构并执行操作，引用保持稳定、动作可安全重试，而不是靠像素猜测。
zh.content: 仓库包含原生 Rust CLI 单文件二进制、可被 Python/Swift/Go/Ruby/Node/C 加载的 C-ABI cdylib，以及 58 个命令（54 个可用）覆盖观察、交互、键鼠、通知、剪贴板、窗口管理与会话生命周期，另有架构文档和技能文档加载器。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写，无运行时依赖；通过 C-ABI cdylib 提供多语言绑定，发布到 npm，并作为 ClawHub / skills.sh 技能分发，采用 Apache-2.0 许可。
zh.hot: 上线不久即获 1646 星，今日新增 66 星并登上 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 9，说明「让代理真正操作桌面」这一刚需正被大量开发者关注。
uses: 构建桌面自动化代理的开发者，需要稳定可重试的 UI 操作能力
做 RPA 或跨应用工作流、又不想依赖像素坐标的工程团队
用 Python/Node/Go 等语言集成桌面控制能力的应用开发者
研究 computer-use 代理、关注 token 效率与可观测性的研究者

en.tag: Reliable desktop computer use for any agent via OS accessibility trees
en.what: Agent Desktop gives any agent reliable computer use on the desktop. Built in Rust, it reads any app's real UI structure through OS accessibility trees and operates it, keeping refs stable and actions safe to retry instead of guessing from pixels.
en.content: It ships a native Rust CLI single binary, a C-ABI cdylib loadable from Python/Swift/Go/Ruby/Node/C, and 58 command names (54 operational) covering observation, interaction, keyboard, mouse, notifications, clipboard, window management and session lifecycle, plus architecture docs and a bundled skills doc loader.
en.stack: Core is written in Rust with no runtime dependencies; it exposes multi-language bindings via a C-ABI cdylib, publishes to npm, and is distributed as a ClawHub / skills.sh skill under Apache-2.0.
en.hot: It has already reached 1,646 stars, gaining 66 today and ranking 9th on GitHub Trending's daily Rust list, showing strong developer demand for agents that can actually operate the desktop.
uses: Developers building desktop automation agents that need stable, retryable UI actions
Teams doing RPA or cross-app workflows without relying on pixel coordinates
App developers integrating desktop control from Python/Node/Go and other languages
Researchers studying computer-use agents, token efficiency and observability

zh.tag: 基于 GPUI 的 Rust 跨平台桌面 UI 组件库
zh.what: GPUI Kit 是一个用于构建高性能跨平台桌面应用的 Rust 框架，提供 60+ 生产级 UI 组件和完整的数据、布局、编辑能力。它基于 Zed 编辑器使用的 GPUI 构建，并支持 JavaScript 扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个子 crate：gpui-base（无样式行为、状态和基础设施）、gpui-shell（JavaScript 扩展）、gpui-component（完整样式化 UI 系统）。主 crate 重新导出所有层，应用只需依赖 gpui-kit 即可。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 GPUI（Zed 编辑器使用的 GPU 加速 UI 框架），支持 macOS、Windows、Linux，集成 Tree-sitter、LSP 等。
zh.hot: 凭借 13.9K stars 和日增 179 登顶 Rust 日榜，因为它是首个将 GPUI 从 Zed 中解耦并打包成通用组件库的项目，填补了 Rust 桌面 UI 生态的空白。
uses: Rust 开发者希望用 Rust 构建跨平台桌面应用，并追求高性能和原生体验。
需要数据表格、虚拟列表、代码编辑器等复杂组件的桌面应用开发场景。
希望复用 Zed 编辑器 UI 能力但不想直接依赖 Zed 的团队。
对 GPUI 感兴趣，想学习其架构或基于 gpui-base 自定义 UI 系统的开发者。

en.tag: Rust desktop UI component library built on GPUI for cross-platform apps
en.what: GPUI Kit is a Rust framework for building high-performance cross-platform desktop apps, offering 60+ production-ready UI components and full data, layout, and editing capabilities. It is built on GPUI, the UI framework used by Zed editor, and supports JavaScript extensions.
en.content: The repo contains three sub-crates: gpui-base (unstyled behavior, state, and infrastructure), gpui-shell (JavaScript extensions), and gpui-component (complete styled UI system). The main crate re-exports all layers, so apps only need to depend on gpui-kit.
en.stack: Built on Rust and GPUI (GPU-accelerated UI framework used by Zed editor), supports macOS, Windows, Linux, integrates Tree-sitter, LSP, etc.
en.hot: With 13.9K stars and +179 today, it tops the Rust daily chart as the first project to decouple GPUI from Zed and package it as a general-purpose component library, filling a gap in the Rust desktop UI ecosystem.
uses: Rust developers who want to build cross-platform desktop apps with high performance and native feel.
Desktop app development requiring complex components like data tables, virtual lists, and code editors.
Teams that want to reuse Zed's UI capabilities without depending on Zed directly.
Developers interested in GPUI, learning its architecture, or building custom UI systems on gpui-base.

zh.tag: 用 React 和 Solid 构建 GPU 原生应用，无需 Electron
zh.what: GPUIX 为 Zed 编辑器的 GPUI 框架提供 Node.js 和 React/Solid 绑定。它允许你用 TypeScript 编写 React 或 Solid 组件树，然后由 GPUI 通过 Metal、DirectX 或 Vulkan 进行 GPU 渲染，完全避开 Electron 和 WebView。
zh.content: 仓库包含 @gpuix/react 和 @gpuix/native 等包，以及一个示例应用。核心是适配层，将 React/Solid 的虚拟 DOM 映射到 GPUI 的原生控件和渲染管线。
zh.stack: 技术栈：Rust（GPUI 核心）、TypeScript、React/Solid、Bun 运行时。依赖 @gpuix/native 提供平台原生渲染器，需要与适配器版本严格匹配。
zh.hot: 项目今日新增 56 星，总星数 2307，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 11 名。它解决了 Electron 应用内存占用高的问题，同时保留 React 开发体验，因此备受关注。
uses: 希望用 React 构建高性能桌面应用的开发者 —— 无需学习 Rust 或处理 Electron 的臃肿。
对内存效率敏感、需要原生 GPU 渲染的桌面工具开发者 —— 适合仪表盘、邮件客户端等场景。
Zed 编辑器生态的贡献者 —— 想用熟悉的 Web 技术栈扩展 GPUI 应用。

en.tag: Build GPU-native apps with React and Solid, no Electron
en.what: GPUIX provides Node.js and React/Solid bindings for Zed's GPUI framework. It lets you write React or Solid component trees in TypeScript, which GPUI renders natively via Metal, DirectX, or Vulkan—no Electron or WebView involved.
en.content: The repo contains packages like @gpuix/react and @gpuix/native, plus an example app. The core is an adapter that maps React/Solid virtual DOM to GPUI's native widgets and rendering pipeline.
en.stack: Tech stack: Rust (GPUI core), TypeScript, React/Solid, Bun runtime. Depends on @gpuix/native for platform-native renderer, requiring exact version matching with the adapter.
en.hot: It gained 56 stars today, totaling 2,307, and ranked #11 on GitHub Trending (Rust). It addresses Electron's high memory usage while keeping the React developer experience, drawing significant attention.
uses: Developers wanting to build high-performance desktop apps with React — without learning Rust or dealing with Electron bloat.
Desktop tool developers sensitive to memory efficiency and needing native GPU rendering — ideal for dashboards, mail clients, etc.
Contributors to the Zed editor ecosystem — looking to extend GPUI apps with familiar web tech.

zh.tag: Rust 编写的极简安全 Python 解释器，专为运行 AI 生成代码而生
zh.what: Monty 是一个用 Rust 实现的安全 Python 沙箱，用来执行 LLM 生成的代码，避免容器沙箱带来的延迟、复杂度和成本。它提供 MIT 许可的开源版本，以及以 WebSocket 服务形式运行的商业版 Full Monty。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的解释器核心，并同时发布为 Python 包 pydantic-monty、npm 包 @pydantic/monty 和 crates.io 上的 monty crate，附有 CI、覆盖率与性能追踪配置。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写，支持 Python 3.14 语法，可通过 uv、npm 或 cargo 安装，并配有 WebSocket 服务端形态。
zh.hot: 凭借 8273 颗星和今日日榜 Rust 第 12 名，它切中了 AI 代码执行的安全与性能痛点——从运行池中启动沙箱不到 1ms，而传统沙箱服务约需 1500ms。
uses: 构建 AI 代理的团队，需要安全执行模型生成的 Python 代码
希望替代容器沙箱、降低延迟与成本的平台工程师
在 Python、JavaScript 或 Rust 项目中集成代码解释器的开发者
研究 LLM 代码执行安全与沙箱隔离的技术人员

en.tag: A minimal, secure Python interpreter in Rust, built to run AI-generated code
en.what: Monty is a secure Python sandbox written in Rust for executing LLM-generated code, avoiding the latency, complexity and cost of container-based sandboxes. It ships as the MIT-licensed OSS Monty package and the commercial Full Monty server that runs the same sandbox behind a WebSocket.
en.content: The repo holds the Rust interpreter core, published simultaneously as the pydantic-monty Python package, the @pydantic/monty npm package and the monty crate on crates.io, with CI, coverage and performance-tracking setup.
en.stack: Written in Rust targeting Python 3.14 semantics, installable via uv, npm or cargo, with an optional WebSocket server form.
en.hot: With 8,273 stars and the No.12 spot on GitHub's daily Rust trending, it hits the security-and-speed pain point of AI code execution: under 1ms from a warm pool versus roughly 1500ms for a sandbox service.
uses: Teams building AI agents that must safely run model-generated Python
Platform engineers replacing container sandboxes to cut latency and cost
Developers embedding a code interpreter in Python, JavaScript or Rust projects
Researchers studying secure execution and sandboxing of LLM code

zh.tag: 分布式 LLM 推理，聚合多机 GPU 为统一 OpenAI API
zh.what: Mesh LLM 将多台机器的 GPU 和内存池化，对外暴露一个兼容 OpenAI 的 API（默认 http://localhost:9337/v1）。它自动决定模型在本地运行、路由到对等节点，还是使用 Skippy 阶段拆分来运行单机放不下的大模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心节点程序、安装脚本（install.sh/install.ps1）、Homebrew 公式、Web 控制台界面以及文档（如 MESHES.md）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 开发，依赖 GGUF 模型格式，提供 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持 Linux、macOS（Apple Silicon）和 Windows（含 WSL2）。
zh.hot: 该项目今日登上 GitHub Trending（Rust 日榜第 13 名），共获得 3453 颗星，因其能低成本聚合闲置算力、私有化部署大模型而受到关注。
uses: 希望利用多台机器算力运行大模型的个人开发者或小团队
需要私有化部署 AI 代理和聊天服务的企业或组织
想要贡献闲置 GPU 算力加入公共网格的爱好者
研究分布式推理和模型拆分技术的工程师

en.tag: Distributed LLM inference pooling GPUs across machines into one OpenAI-compatible API
en.what: Mesh LLM pools GPUs and memory across machines and exposes the result as a single OpenAI-compatible API at http://localhost:9337/v1. It automatically decides whether a model runs locally, routes to a peer, or uses Skippy stage splits for models too large for one machine.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core node program, install scripts (install.sh/install.ps1), a Homebrew formula, a web console UI, and documentation (e.g., MESHES.md).
en.stack: Primarily built in Rust, relies on GGUF model format, provides an OpenAI-compatible API, and supports Linux, macOS (Apple Silicon), and Windows (including WSL2).
en.hot: It is trending on GitHub today (13th on the Rust daily list) with 3,453 stars, attracting attention for enabling low-cost pooling of idle compute and private LLM deployment.
uses: Individual developers or small teams wanting to run large models using compute from multiple machines
Enterprises or organizations needing private deployment of AI agents and chat services
Enthusiasts willing to contribute idle GPU compute to a public mesh
Engineers researching distributed inference and model splitting techniques

zh.tag: 多 AI IDE 账号统一管理与配额监控工具
zh.what: Cockpit Tools 是一款通用 AI IDE 账号管理工具，支持 Antigravity、Codex、GitHub Copilot、Windsurf、Kiro、Cursor、Gemini-cli、CodeBuddy 等十余种 AI 编程工具。它提供多账号一键切换、配额监控、自动唤醒和应用多开并行运行，帮助用户充分利用不同账号的资源。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的桌面应用源码，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux，内置 18 种语言界面，并集成多个 AI IDE 的账号管理模块与插件联动能力。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖各 AI IDE 的本地配置与 API 进行账号切换和配额读取，提供跨平台桌面应用。
zh.hot: 凭借对十余种主流 AI IDE 的统一账号管理能力，该项目已获得 18342 颗星，今日新增 33 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 Rust 分类第 14 名，反映出开发者对多账号资源管理的强烈需求。
uses: 同时使用多个 AI IDE 并需要频繁切换账号的开发者
希望监控各平台配额使用情况、避免资源浪费的用户
需要多开实例并行运行以提升效率的重度 AI 编程用户
使用 GitHub Copilot、Cursor 等工具并管理多个订阅账号的团队或个人

en.tag: Universal account manager for multiple AI IDEs with quota monitoring
en.what: Cockpit Tools is a universal account manager for AI IDEs, supporting Antigravity, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Kiro, Cursor, Gemini-cli, CodeBuddy and more. It offers one-click account switching, quota monitoring, wake-up automation, and multi-instance parallel running to help users maximize their account resources.
en.content: The repo contains the source code of a Rust-based desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux, with UI in 18 languages and integrated account management modules plus plugin linkage for multiple AI IDEs.
en.stack: Primarily built in Rust, it relies on local configs and APIs of various AI IDEs for account switching and quota reading, delivered as a cross-platform desktop app.
en.hot: With unified account management for over a dozen mainstream AI IDEs, the project has earned 18,342 stars, adding 33 today and ranking 14th on GitHub Trending's daily Rust list, reflecting strong developer demand for multi-account resource management.
uses: Developers who use multiple AI IDEs and need frequent account switching
Users who want to monitor quota usage across platforms and avoid waste
Heavy AI coding users who need multi-instance parallel running for efficiency
Teams or individuals managing multiple subscriptions for GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.

zh.tag: Rust 编写的极速 Python 包与项目管理器，旨在取代 pip、poetry 等工具
zh.what: uv 是一个用 Rust 编写的极速 Python 包和项目管理器，速度比 pip 快 10-100 倍。它集成了 pip、pip-tools、pipx、poetry、pyenv、twine、virtualenv 等工具的功能，提供统一的命令行界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 uv 源代码、文档、基准测试和安装脚本。主要目录包括 crates（Rust 源码）、docs（文档）、scripts（辅助脚本）和测试套件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Rust 生态中的异步运行时、包解析和缓存库。支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows，可通过 curl 或 pip 安装。
zh.hot: uv 因其极快的速度和替代多个 Python 工具的能力而广受欢迎，目前已获得超过 9 万颗星，今日新增 45 星，位列 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 15 名。
uses: Python 开发者：希望加速包安装和依赖管理，减少等待时间。
数据科学家：需要快速创建可复现的环境，管理复杂依赖。
DevOps 工程师：在 CI/CD 中集成 uv 以提升构建速度。
工具作者：利用 uv 的 pip 兼容接口和脚本运行功能简化工具分发。

en.tag: An extremely fast Python package and project manager written in Rust, aiming to replace pip, poetry, and more.
en.what: uv is an extremely fast Python package and project manager written in Rust, 10-100x faster than pip. It integrates the functionality of pip, pip-tools, pipx, poetry, pyenv, twine, virtualenv, and more into a single tool with a unified CLI.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code for uv, documentation, benchmarks, and installation scripts. Key directories include crates (Rust source), docs, scripts, and test suites.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging Rust ecosystem libraries for async runtime, package resolution, and caching. Supports macOS, Linux, and Windows, installable via curl or pip.
en.hot: uv is highly popular for its extreme speed and ability to replace multiple Python tools, with over 90k stars and 45 new stars today, ranking 15th on GitHub Trending (Rust) daily list.
uses: Python developers: looking to speed up package installation and dependency management.
Data scientists: needing to quickly create reproducible environments and manage complex dependencies.
DevOps engineers: integrating uv into CI/CD pipelines to improve build speed.
Tool authors: leveraging uv's pip-compatible interface and script running to simplify tool distribution.

zh.tag: 大规模运行 Agent 环境的分布式平台，支撑 Kimi K3 的智能体强化学习训练
zh.what: AgentENV（AENV）是一个用于大规模运行智能体环境的分布式平台，可在多台机器上调度海量 Firecracker 微虚拟机环境。它通过快照、分叉与内存超分等机制，为智能体强化学习训练提供高密度、低开销的沙箱执行能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的平台核心代码、部署与运维文档（含 PVM 部署指南）、CI 覆盖率工作流以及完整的在线文档站点（Stable/Dev 双版本）。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，基于 Firecracker 微虚拟机与 KVM，结合 overlaybd 按需加载 OCI 镜像，使用 ublk 提供高性能 I/O，快照可持久化到 S3 兼容对象存储或分布式文件系统。
zh.hot: 作为 Kimi K3 智能体强化学习训练的底层平台，它宣称在生产中支撑 150 万镜像、9.6 倍内存超分与 50ms 内启动，技术指标亮眼，今日登上 GitHub Rust 日榜第 16 名，累计 3539 星。
uses: 需要大规模并行沙箱环境进行智能体强化学习训练的 AI 研究团队
构建代码执行、浏览器操作等 Agent 工具链、追求高密度低成本沙箱的工程师
在 Kubernetes 之外自建微虚拟机调度与快照基础设施的平台开发者
关注 Firecracker、overlaybd、ublk 等云原生虚拟化技术的学习者

en.tag: A distributed platform for running agent environments at scale, powering agentic RL training for Kimi K3
en.what: AgentENV (AENV) is a distributed platform for running agent environments at scale, orchestrating massive numbers of Firecracker microVM environments across machines. Through snapshots, forking, and memory overcommit, it provides high-density, low-overhead sandbox execution for agentic RL training.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core platform code, deployment and operations docs (including a PVM deployment guide), CI coverage workflows, and a full online documentation site (Stable/Dev versions).
en.stack: Written in Rust, it builds on Firecracker microVMs and KVM, uses overlaybd for on-demand OCI image loading, ublk for high-performance I/O, and persists snapshots to S3-compatible object storage or a shared distributed filesystem.
en.hot: As the underlying platform for Kimi K3's agentic RL training, it claims production support for 1.5 million images, 9.6x memory overcommit, and sub-50ms startup; these striking numbers helped it reach No.16 on GitHub's daily Rust trending list with 3,539 stars.
uses: AI research teams needing large-scale parallel sandboxes for agentic RL training
Engineers building agent toolchains (code execution, browser automation) who want high-density, low-cost sandboxes
Platform developers building microVM scheduling and snapshot infrastructure beyond Kubernetes
Learners interested in cloud-native virtualization such as Firecracker, overlaybd, and ublk

zh.tag: 面向自主智能体的高密度安全沙箱运行时
zh.what: Agent Substrate 是一个默认安全的智能体执行运行时，能在标准容器运行时基础上以 10 倍密度运行数百万个沙箱。它把大量「actor」（如智能体应用）映射到少量就绪的「worker」上，利用智能体大部分时间空闲的特性实现重度多路复用，并支持 microVM、gVisor 等多种沙箱技术。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 Go 编写的核心系统，提供 actor 生命周期管理（创建/销毁、挂起/恢复）、实时调度到 worker 以及流量路由；还附带演示视频和集群复现指南，展示约 250 个有状态 actor 在 8 个物理 Pod 上的多路复用。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，底层依赖 Kubernetes 进行基础设施供给和 worker（Pod）生命周期管理，并集成 microVM、gVisor 等沙箱技术，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。
zh.hot: 今日新增 498 星、总星数 2606，登上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 4 名；其「10 倍密度、亚 500ms 恢复、每秒 500+ 挂起/恢复」的指标切中了智能体规模化运行的基础设施痛点。
uses: 需要大规模运行自主智能体、追求高密度与低延迟的 AI 基础设施团队
在 Kubernetes 上构建端到端智能体部署、希望统一调度与隔离的平台工程师
研究 RL 场景中智能体、推理与训练循环协同优化的研究人员
关注零信任内核与网络隔离、需要安全沙箱运行不可信代码的开发者

en.tag: A secure-by-default, high-density sandbox runtime for autonomous agents
en.what: Agent Substrate is a secure-by-default agent execution runtime engineered to run millions of sandboxes at 10x the density of standard container runtimes. It maps many 'actors' (agent-like applications) onto a smaller pool of ready 'workers', exploiting the fact that agents are idle most of the time to achieve heavy multiplexing, and supports multiple sandbox technologies including microVMs and gVisor.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based core system offering actor lifecycle management (create/destroy, suspend/resume), real-time assignment to workers, and traffic routing, plus a demo video and cluster walkthrough showing ~250 stateful actors multiplexed across 8 physical pods.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it builds on Kubernetes for infrastructure provisioning and worker (Pod) lifecycle management, integrates sandbox technologies like microVMs and gVisor, and is licensed under Apache 2.0.
en.hot: It gained 498 stars today (2,606 total) and ranked #4 on GitHub Trending's Go daily list; its metrics—10x density, sub-500ms resume, and 500+ suspend/resume activations per second—hit the infrastructure pain point of running agents at scale.
uses: AI infrastructure teams needing to run autonomous agents at scale with high density and low latency
Platform engineers building end-to-end agent deployments on Kubernetes who want unified scheduling and isolation
Researchers optimizing RL scenarios that span agentic, inference, and training cycles
Developers needing secure sandboxes with zero-trust kernel and network isolation for untrusted code

zh.tag: 跨工具自进化记忆层，让 AI 代理经验可复用
zh.what: Beacon 是一个面向 AI 编程代理的开源记忆层，能捕获 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、OpenCode 等 20 多种工具中的完整会话历史。它把有用的工作流、纠错记录和调试模式提炼成可复用知识，供未来的代理通过 MCP 或 Agent Skills 调用。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 语言实现，包含 CLI 工具、本地 JSONL 存储、会话回放与知识提取模块，并提供 Homebrew 安装、文档站点和 Discord 社区入口。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，采用本地优先的 JSONL 持久化，支持 MCP 与 Agent Skills 集成，可通过 Homebrew 安装，依赖较少。
zh.hot: 今日新增 269 星，总星数达 1510，登上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 3 名。它切中了多代理工具记忆碎片化的痛点，让跨工具经验不再随会话结束而丢失。
uses: 同时使用 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等多款 AI 编程工具的开发者
希望团队内代理经验可沉淀、可复用的工程团队
需要审计和回放代理会话以排查问题的研究者或运维人员
想为自研代理接入跨工具记忆能力的 AI 应用开发者

en.tag: Cross-harness self-improving memory layer for AI agents
en.what: Beacon is an open-source memory layer for AI coding agents that captures full session history across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, and 20+ other harnesses. It distills useful workflows, corrections, and debugging patterns into reusable knowledge that future agents can retrieve via MCP or Agent Skills.
en.content: The repo is implemented in Go and includes a CLI, local JSONL storage, session replay and knowledge extraction modules, plus Homebrew install, docs site, and Discord community links.
en.stack: Main language is Go, with local-first JSONL persistence, MCP and Agent Skills integration, Homebrew installation, and minimal dependencies.
en.hot: It gained 269 stars today, reaching 1,510 total, and ranked #3 on GitHub Trending (Go) daily. It addresses the pain of fragmented memory across agent tools, preventing experience from vanishing when a session ends.
uses: Developers using multiple AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex
Engineering teams wanting to accumulate and reuse agent experience
Researchers or operators needing to audit and replay agent sessions
AI app developers integrating cross-tool memory into custom agents

zh.tag: 比 LiteLLM 快 50 倍的企业级 AI 网关，统一接入 1000+ 模型
zh.what: Bifrost 是一个高性能 AI 网关，用单一 OpenAI 兼容 API 统一接入 OpenAI、Anthropic、AWS Bedrock、Google Vertex 等 23+ 供应商。它提供自动故障转移、负载均衡、语义缓存与护栏等企业级能力，号称比 LiteLLM 快 50 倍。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 编写的网关核心为主，附带内置 Web UI 用于可视化配置与实时监控，并提供 Go SDK、Docker 镜像、Postman 集合与完整文档。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，支持 npx 与 Docker 一键部署，兼容 OpenAI API 协议，并集成 Codecov、CodSpeed、Artifact Hub 等工程化工具链。
zh.hot: 凭借「比 LiteLLM 快 50 倍」的性能卖点和 5k RPS 下低于 100µs 的开销，它已收获 8331 颗星，今日新增 41 星并登上 Go 日榜第 4。
uses: 需要统一多模型供应商接入的 AI 应用后端团队
对延迟与吞吐敏感、追求高并发推理网关的工程团队
希望快速搭建带监控与护栏的企业级 AI 基础设施的运维人员

en.tag: Enterprise AI gateway 50x faster than LiteLLM, unifying 1000+ models
en.what: Bifrost is a high-performance AI gateway that unifies access to 23+ providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex and more) behind a single OpenAI-compatible API. It adds automatic failover, load balancing, semantic caching and guardrails, and claims to be 50x faster than LiteLLM.
en.content: The repo centers on a Go gateway core, plus a built-in web UI for visual configuration and real-time monitoring, along with a Go SDK, Docker images, a Postman collection and full docs.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, deployable via npx or Docker, OpenAI-API compatible, with Codecov, CodSpeed and Artifact Hub integrated into its toolchain.
en.hot: With its "50x faster than LiteLLM" pitch and <100µs overhead at 5k RPS, it has reached 8,331 stars, gaining 41 today and ranking #4 on the Go daily trending list.
uses: Backend teams needing unified multi-provider model access for AI apps
Engineering teams sensitive to latency and throughput at high concurrency
Ops teams wanting enterprise AI infra with monitoring and guardrails fast

zh.tag: 终端里的 Winamp 风格音乐播放器，支持海量流媒体与本地音乐
zh.what: cliamp 是一个在终端中运行的复古风格音乐播放器，灵感来自 Winamp。它不仅能播放本地音乐文件，还支持 YouTube、Spotify、SoundCloud、Bilibili、网易云音乐等众多流媒体平台，以及 Navidrome、Plex、Jellyfin 等媒体服务器。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的终端播放器主程序，支持频谱可视化、参数均衡器和播放列表管理。还提供了 Android 移动客户端和安装脚本、Homebrew、AUR、Nix 等多种安装方式。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，基于 Bubbletea 和 Lip Gloss 构建 TUI，Beep 处理音频，go-librespot 支持 Spotify。依赖 ALSA（Linux）和 FLAC、Vorbis 等编解码库。
zh.hot: 凭借复古 Winamp 情怀与强大的多平台流媒体支持，cliamp 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 4220 颗星，本月新增 1100 星，位列 Go 趋势月榜第 14 名。
uses: 终端爱好者与复古 UI 粉丝 —— 在命令行中享受 Winamp 风格的播放体验。
需要统一播放多平台音乐的用户 —— 一个播放器搞定本地、流媒体和媒体服务器。
开发者与运维人员 —— 在编码或工作时用终端听音乐，不离开工作流。
Android 用户 —— 通过 cliamp mobile 在手机上收听广播、播客和相同服务器内容。

en.tag: A retro terminal music player inspired by Winamp, supporting local files and many streaming services.
en.what: cliamp is a retro terminal music player inspired by Winamp. It plays local files and streams from YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, Bilibili, NetEase Cloud Music, and many other services, as well as media servers like Navidrome, Plex, and Jellyfin.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based terminal player with a spectrum visualizer, parametric EQ, and playlist manager. It also offers an Android mobile client and multiple installation methods including script, Homebrew, AUR, and Nix.
en.stack: Built in Go with Bubbletea and Lip Gloss for TUI, Beep for audio, and go-librespot for Spotify. Depends on ALSA (Linux) and codec libraries like FLAC and Vorbis.

Users needing unified playback across platforms — one player for local, streaming, and media servers.
Developers and sysadmins — listen to music in the terminal without leaving the workflow.
Android users — use cliamp mobile to listen to radio, podcasts, and the same servers on phones.

zh.tag: 为智能体系统打造的模型路由器，50ms 内把每个请求分发给最合适的模型

zh.content: 仓库以 Go 源码为主体，包含路由核心逻辑、模型选择策略与配置，并配有大幅品牌 Banner 和 README 使用说明。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，作为可自托管的服务/代理层运行，通过统一 endpoint 对接多家模型提供方。
zh.hot: 4471 颗星、今日新增 26，登上 GitHub Go 日榜第 8；在 LLM 成本高企的当下，'改一个 endpoint 省 40–70% 成本' 的卖点极具吸引力。

被 LLM 推理成本压得喘不过气、想降本又不想牺牲效果的团队

en.tag: Model router for agentic systems that dispatches every prompt to the right model in <50ms
en.what: weave-os/router is a model-routing layer for agentic systems that forwards each prompt to the most suitable model in under 50ms. It claims a single endpoint change can cut inference costs by 40–70% while preserving quality.
en.content: The repo is primarily Go source code containing the routing core, model-selection policies and configuration, plus a large branded banner and README usage docs.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, it runs as a self-hostable service/proxy layer that fronts multiple model providers behind one unified endpoint.
en.hot: With 4,471 stars and 26 added today, it ranks #8 on GitHub's daily Go trending list; the pitch of cutting LLM costs 40–70% via a single endpoint change is highly compelling amid rising inference bills.

zh.tag: 面向开发者的用量计费与变现基础设施，支持云端或自托管

en.tag: Usage-based pricing and billing infrastructure for developers, cloud or self-hosted
en.what: Flexprice is monetization infrastructure for AI-native and SaaS teams, supporting usage-based, credit-based, and hybrid pricing. It offers real-time usage metering and reporting, automatically computes pricing, applies prepaid or promotional credits, enforces feature limits, and generates invoices.

zh.tag: 用 Go 构建代理网络、突破网络限制的平台
zh.what: V2Ray 核心（Project V）是一套网络工具集，帮助用户搭建自己的计算机网络，通过多种协议对连接进行加密与转发，从而保护隐私并绕过网络封锁。它提供可配置的路由、传输与出站入站机制，是众多科学上网客户端与服务端的底层引擎。
zh.content: 仓库是 V2Ray 的核心实现，包含协议解析、路由、传输层、DNS、统计与 API 等模块，以及大量单元测试和 CI 配置；文档与新手教程托管在 v2fly.org 独立站点。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 gorilla/websocket、quic-go、go-proxyproto、cuckoofilter、starlark-go、protoreflect、netaddr 等库，测试用 miekg/dns 与 h12w/socks。
zh.hot: 作为老牌翻墙基础设施，V2Ray 拥有 34,622 颗星，今日仍新增 11 星并登上 Go 日榜第 18 名，说明在持续的网络审查环境下需求长期旺盛。
uses: 需要自建代理服务器以突破网络限制的技术用户
开发科学上网客户端或服务端的工程师
研究网络协议、加密传输与流量伪装的开发者
在受限网络环境中需要稳定加密通道的团队

en.tag: A Go platform for building proxies to bypass network restrictions
en.what: V2Ray Core (Project V) is a set of network tools that lets users build their own computer network, encrypting and forwarding connections through multiple protocols to protect privacy and bypass censorship. It offers configurable routing, transports, and inbound/outbound mechanisms, serving as the engine behind many proxy clients and servers.
en.content: The repo holds V2Ray's core implementation, with modules for protocol parsing, routing, transports, DNS, stats, and APIs, plus extensive unit tests and CI configs; docs and newcomer guides live on the separate v2fly.org site.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, it depends on gorilla/websocket, quic-go, go-proxyproto, cuckoofilter, starlark-go, protoreflect, and netaddr, with miekg/dns and h12w/socks for testing.
en.hot: As a veteran censorship-circumvention infrastructure, V2Ray has 34,622 stars and still gained 11 today, ranking 18th on the Go daily trending list, showing persistent demand under ongoing network censorship.
uses: Technical users who need to self-host proxy servers to bypass network restrictions
Engineers building proxy clients or servers for censorship circumvention
Developers studying network protocols, encrypted transports, and traffic obfuscation
Teams needing stable encrypted tunnels in restricted network environments

zh.tag: 可自托管、真正属于你的开源任务管理器
zh.what: Vikunja 是一款开源的任务与待办管理工具，支持自托管部署，让用户完全掌控自己的数据。它提供看板、列表、甘特图等多种视图，适用于个人和团队的项目与任务协作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、前端应用以及桌面端目录（desktop/），并配有完整的安装、开发、测试文档和 OpenAPI 接口文档。
zh.stack: 后端主要使用 Go 语言开发，前端为现代 JavaScript 框架，提供 Docker 镜像和 Swagger API 文档，依赖关系清晰。
zh.hot: 凭借 5501 颗星和今日新增 8 星，Vikunja 登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 Go 语言第 19 名，反映出用户对数据自主和开源任务管理方案的强烈需求。
uses: 希望完全掌控自己任务数据的个人用户，可自托管部署
需要开源、可定制任务管理方案的团队与组织
关注数据隐私、不愿依赖商业 SaaS 的开发者或企业
想要学习 Go 全栈项目架构与 API 设计的开发者

en.tag: The self-hostable, open-source task manager you actually own
en.what: Vikunja is an open-source task and to-do management tool that supports self-hosting, giving users full control over their data. It offers multiple views such as Kanban, list, and Gantt, suitable for personal and team task collaboration.
en.content: The repository contains a Go backend service, a frontend application, and a desktop directory (desktop/), along with comprehensive installation, development, testing docs, and OpenAPI documentation.
en.stack: The backend is primarily written in Go, with a modern JavaScript frontend, and it provides Docker images and Swagger API docs with clear dependencies.
en.hot: With 5,501 stars and 8 new stars today, Vikunja ranks 19th on GitHub Trending's daily Go list, reflecting strong demand for data autonomy and open-source task management.
uses: Individuals who want full control over their task data and prefer self-hosting
Teams and organizations seeking an open-source, customizable task management solution
Developers or companies concerned about data privacy and avoiding commercial SaaS
Developers interested in learning Go full-stack architecture and API design

zh.tag: 分布式系统关键数据的可靠键值存储
zh.what: etcd 是一个分布式可靠的键值存储，专为分布式系统中最关键的数据设计。它基于 Raft 共识算法实现高可用复制日志，提供简单、安全、快速、可靠的特性。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心服务端、etcdctl 命令行客户端、客户端库、文档以及健壮性测试套件等。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言编写，依赖 gRPC 作为用户 API，并采用 Raft 共识算法。
zh.hot: etcd 是 Kubernetes 等关键系统的核心依赖，拥有超过 5.2 万 star，今日新增 8 star，位列 Go 日榜第 20 名。
uses: 分布式系统开发者，用于存储关键配置和服务发现
Kubernetes 运维人员，管理集群状态数据
需要高可用键值存储的架构师

en.tag: Distributed reliable key-value store for critical data
en.what: etcd is a distributed reliable key-value store designed for the most critical data of a distributed system. It uses the Raft consensus algorithm to manage a highly-available replicated log, emphasizing simplicity, security, speed, and reliability.
en.content: The repository includes the core server, etcdctl command-line client, client libraries, documentation, and robustness testing suites.
en.stack: Written in Go, it uses gRPC for its user-facing API and employs the Raft consensus algorithm.
en.hot: etcd is a core dependency for critical systems like Kubernetes, with over 52k stars, gaining 8 stars today and ranking 20th on the Go daily trending list.
uses: Distributed system developers for critical configuration and service discovery
Kubernetes operators managing cluster state data
Architects needing highly-available key-value storage

zh.tag: 跨厂商 3D 高斯泼溅训练器：视频一键转 splat 与网格
zh.what: Spirula Studio 是一个自包含的 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）训练工具，能把原始照片或视频一路处理成 splat 模型和带纹理网格。它内置 SfM、AI 遮罩和视频抽帧，无需安装 Python/PyTorch 或单独的 COLMAP。
zh.content: 仓库以 C++ 源码为主，附带预编译的 Windows/Linux/macOS 发布包、示例画廊和在线 Web 查看器，并包含数据集创建、训练、网格化等模块。
zh.stack: 核心用 C++ 编写，通过 Vulkan 计算着色器实现跨厂商 GPU 支持，也提供 CUDA 路径；不依赖 Python/PyTorch，采用 GPLv3 许可。
zh.hot: 上线不久即获约 981 星、单日新增 257 星，登上 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 2，靠的是免配置、跨 GPU 和 8GB 显存训 10M 高斯的高效率。
uses: 3D 重建/NeRF 研究者与工程师，想快速从视频训练高斯泼溅模型
独立开发者或小团队，需要免 Python 环境、跨 NVIDIA/AMD/Intel/Apple GPU 的 3DGS 管线
VR/AR 与数字孪生从业者，处理 360° 或鱼眼相机数据并导出网格
内容创作者，希望把普通视频转成可交互的 3D 场景并在线展示

en.tag: Cross-vendor 3D Gaussian Splatting trainer: video to splat to mesh
en.what: Spirula Studio is a self-contained 3D Gaussian Splatting trainer that takes raw photos or video all the way to splat models and textured meshes. It bundles SfM, AI masking and video frame extraction, so no Python/PyTorch or separate COLMAP install is needed.
en.content: The repo is primarily C++ source code, with prebuilt Windows/Linux/macOS releases, a gallery, an online web viewer, and modules for dataset creation, training and meshing.
en.stack: Written in C++ with Vulkan compute shaders for cross-vendor GPU support and an optional CUDA path; it avoids Python/PyTorch and is GPLv3-licensed.
en.hot: It quickly reached ~981 stars with 257 added in a day, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending's C++ daily list, thanks to zero-config setup, cross-GPU support and training 10M Gaussians in 8GB VRAM.
uses: 3D reconstruction/NeRF researchers and engineers who want to train Gaussian Splatting models from video quickly
Indie developers or small teams needing a Python-free, cross-vendor (NVIDIA/AMD/Intel/Apple) 3DGS pipeline
VR/AR and digital-twin practitioners working with 360° or fisheye footage and exporting meshes
Content creators who want to turn ordinary video into interactive 3D scenes and showcase them online

zh.tag: 跨平台开源密码管理器，离线加密存储敏感信息
zh.what: KeePassXC 是 Windows 应用 KeePass Password Safe 的社区驱动跨平台移植版，用于安全地存储和管理用户名、密码、URL、附件与笔记等敏感信息。所有数据保存在本地加密的 KDBX 文件中，可放在任意位置，包括私有或公有云盘。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 桌面应用源码，涵盖核心数据库逻辑、GUI、密码生成器、TOTP、浏览器集成与自动输入等模块，并配有测试、CI 配置和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 与 Qt 框架开发，依赖 libgcrypt、Argon2、zlib 等加密与压缩库，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源密码管理器，它已积累 28739 颗星，本月新增 485 星并登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 C++ 第 17 名，反映出用户对本地优先、可审计安全工具的持续需求。
uses: 注重隐私、希望密码完全离线自管的个人用户
需要在 Windows/macOS/Linux 多平台同步使用同一密码库的用户
想审计或自行编译安全软件的开发者与安全爱好者
为团队或家庭搭建本地密码共享方案的技术人员

en.tag: Cross-platform open-source password manager with offline encrypted storage
en.what: KeePassXC is a community-driven, cross-platform port of the Windows KeePass Password Safe, built to securely store and manage sensitive data such as usernames, passwords, URLs, attachments, and notes. Everything lives in a local encrypted KDBX file that can be kept anywhere, including private or public cloud storage.
en.content: The repo holds the full C++ desktop application source, covering core database logic, GUI, password generator, TOTP, browser integration, and auto-type modules, along with tests, CI configs, and docs.
en.stack: Built mainly in C++ with the Qt framework, depending on libgcrypt, Argon2, zlib and other crypto/compression libraries, targeting Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source password manager, it has accumulated 28,739 stars with 485 added this month, ranking 17th on GitHub Trending's monthly C++ list, reflecting steady demand for local-first, auditable security tools.
uses: Privacy-conscious individuals who want fully offline, self-hosted password storage
Users who need the same password vault across Windows, macOS, and Linux
Developers and security enthusiasts who want to audit or self-compile security software
Technical users setting up local password sharing for teams or families

zh.tag: 任天堂 Switch 定制固件，实现自定义系统与虚拟 NAND
zh.what: Atmosphère 是一个针对任天堂 Switch 的开源定制固件项目，通过替换和修改系统各个组件（如引导加载器、TrustZone、系统模块等）来实现自定义功能。它允许用户运行自制软件、备份和虚拟化 NAND 等。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个组件：Fusée（第一阶段加载器）、Exosphère（自定义 TrustZone）、Thermosphère（emuNAND 支持）、Stratosphère（自定义系统模块）、Troposphère（应用程序级补丁），以及相关文档和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 libnx、devkitA64 工具链、FatFs、hekate 等开源项目。
zh.hot: 作为 Switch 破解社区的核心项目，Atmosphère 拥有近 2 万星标，今日新增 13 星，位列 C++ 日榜第二，持续受到关注。
uses: Switch 破解玩家：用于运行自制软件和备份游戏
安全研究人员：研究 Switch 系统安全与漏洞
自制软件开发者：基于 Atmosphère 开发自定义模块

en.tag: Custom firmware for Nintendo Switch enabling custom OS and emuNAND
en.what: Atmosphère is an open-source custom firmware for the Nintendo Switch that replaces and modifies various system components (such as bootloader, TrustZone, sysmodules) to enable custom features. It allows users to run homebrew, backup and virtualize NAND, and more.
en.content: The repository contains multiple components: Fusée (first-stage loader), Exosphère (custom TrustZone), Thermosphère (emuNAND support), Stratosphère (custom sysmodules), Troposphère (application-level patches), along with documentation and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on libnx, devkitA64 toolchain, FatFs, hekate, and other open-source projects.
en.hot: As a core project in the Switch hacking community, Atmosphère has nearly 20k stars, with 13 added today, ranking second on the C++ daily trending list, showing sustained interest.
uses: Switch hacking enthusiasts: to run homebrew and backup games
Security researchers: to study Switch system security and vulnerabilities
Homebrew developers: to build custom modules based on Atmosphère

zh.tag: 面向 GPU/CPU/ML 加速器的开源机器学习编译器
zh.what: XLA（Accelerated Linear Algebra）是一个开源机器学习编译器，可将 PyTorch、TensorFlow、JAX 等主流框架的模型编译优化，在不同硬件上高性能执行。它主要面向编译器开发者和希望接入新前端或硬件后端的集成者。
zh.content: 仓库包含编译器核心源码、文档（docs/ 下的贡献指南、开发者指南与图片资源）以及面向贡献者的构建与调试说明。普通用户无需克隆本仓库，直接通过各框架的 XLA 文档使用即可。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主语言，构建依赖 Bazel，并集成 LLVM/MLIR 等编译基础设施；支持 PyTorch、TensorFlow、JAX 等前端与多种硬件后端。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenXLA 生态的核心编译器，它是 JAX、TensorFlow 等高性能训练与推理的底层支撑，今日登上 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 5 名，累计约 4558 stars。
uses: 编译器与 ML 系统工程师，开发或调试 XLA 编译器本身
硬件厂商工程师，为新型 ML 加速器添加 XLA 后端支持
框架集成者，将 PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX 等前端接入 XLA
高性能训练/推理研究者，想理解或调优底层编译优化

en.tag: An open-source ML compiler for GPUs, CPUs, and ML accelerators
en.what: XLA (Accelerated Linear Algebra) is an open-source machine learning compiler that takes models from frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX and optimizes them for high-performance execution across GPUs, CPUs, and ML accelerators. It primarily targets compiler contributors and integrators adding new frontends or hardware backends.
en.content: The repo holds the compiler's core source, documentation (contributing and developer guides plus image assets under docs/), and build/debug instructions for contributors. Regular users don't need to clone it and can use XLA through each framework's documentation.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Bazel-based builds, integrating compiler infrastructure such as LLVM/MLIR; it supports frontends like PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX plus multiple hardware backends.
en.hot: As the core compiler of the OpenXLA ecosystem, it underpins high-performance training and inference for JAX, TensorFlow, and more; it hit #5 on GitHub Trending's daily C++ list with about 4,558 stars.
uses: Compiler and ML systems engineers developing or debugging XLA itself
Hardware vendor engineers adding XLA backend support for new ML accelerators
Framework integrators connecting frontends like PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX to XLA
Performance researchers who want to understand or tune low-level compilation optimizations

zh.tag: 面向游戏串流的超低延迟 GPU 帧内视频编解码器
zh.what: PyroWave 是一个仅做帧内编码的视频编解码器（实际相当于静态图像编解码器），专为极快的 GPU 编解码优化，1080p 编解码低于约 0.1 毫秒，4K 低于约 0.2 毫秒。它面向高码率（200+ mbit/s）的局域网以太网游戏串流场景，追求绝对最低延迟。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Vulkan 计算着色器实现、C API 头文件与共享库、CMake 构建脚本，以及 docs/bitstream.md 位流定义文档。
zh.stack: 完全用 Vulkan 计算着色器实现，主语言为 C++，依赖 Granite 图形框架，使用 CMake 与 Ninja 构建。
zh.hot: 它以 369 星、今日新增 20 星登上 GitHub C++ 日榜第 6，极致的亚毫秒级 GPU 编解码性能吸引了低延迟串流与图形开发者的关注。
uses: 游戏串流开发者，需要局域网以太网上的超低延迟视频传输
图形与 GPU 计算工程师，研究 Vulkan 计算着色器实现
视频编解码研究者，关注帧内编码与抗丢包方案
PyroFling 项目用户，需要集成的低延迟编解码组件

en.tag: An ultra-low-latency intra-only GPU video codec for game streaming
en.what: PyroWave is an intra-only video codec (practically a still-image codec) optimized for extremely fast GPU encode and decode, under ~0.1 ms at 1080p and ~0.2 ms at 4K. It targets high bit-rates (200+ mbit/s) for local-network Ethernet game streaming where absolute minimum latency matters more than bandwidth.
en.content: The repo contains a full Vulkan compute shader implementation, a C API header and shared library, CMake build scripts, and a bitstream definition in docs/bitstream.md.
en.stack: Implemented entirely in Vulkan compute shaders, primarily in C++, depending on the Granite framework and built with CMake and Ninja.
en.hot: With 369 stars and 20 added today, it ranks 6th on GitHub's daily C++ trending, drawing attention from low-latency streaming and graphics developers for its sub-millisecond GPU codec performance.
uses: Game streaming developers needing ultra-low-latency video over local Ethernet
Graphics and GPU compute engineers studying Vulkan compute shader implementations
Video codec researchers interested in intra-only coding and packet-loss resilience
PyroFling users needing an integrated low-latency codec component

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 的 JSON 解析与序列化事实标准库
zh.what: nlohmann/json 是一个为现代 C++（C++11 及以上）设计的 JSON 库，提供直观的语法来解析、生成和操作 JSON 数据。它让 JSON 在 C++ 中像使用 STL 容器一样自然，支持序列化、反序列化及与自定义类型的互转。
zh.content: 仓库包含单头文件 include/nlohmann/json.hpp、完整的文档站点（docs/）、测试套件、CMake 构建脚本以及大量示例和第三方集成配置。
zh.stack: 纯 C++11 实现，仅依赖标准库，无外部依赖；提供 CMake 集成，支持包管理器（如 vcpkg、Conan、Homebrew）安装。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 生态中最受欢迎的 JSON 库，已积累超过 5 万 star，今日新增 13 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 7 名，足见其持久影响力和广泛采用。
uses: C++ 开发者需要解析或生成 JSON 数据时
项目中需要轻量级、无依赖的 JSON 处理方案
希望以类似 STL 的语法操作 JSON 的团队
需要跨平台、高可移植性 JSON 库的嵌入式或桌面应用

en.tag: The de facto JSON library for modern C++
en.what: nlohmann/json is a JSON library for modern C++ (C++11 and later) that offers intuitive syntax for parsing, generating, and manipulating JSON. It makes JSON feel as natural as STL containers, supporting serialization, deserialization, and conversion to/from custom types.
en.content: The repository contains a single-header include/nlohmann/json.hpp, a full documentation site (docs/), test suites, CMake build scripts, and numerous examples and third-party integration configs.
en.stack: Pure C++11 implementation with only standard library dependencies; offers CMake integration and is available via package managers like vcpkg, Conan, and Homebrew.
en.hot: As the most popular JSON library in the C++ ecosystem, it has accumulated over 50k stars, with 13 new stars today and ranking 7th on the C++ daily trending list, demonstrating its lasting impact and widespread adoption.
uses: C++ developers who need to parse or generate JSON data
Projects requiring a lightweight, dependency-free JSON solution
Teams wanting STL-like syntax for JSON manipulation
Embedded or desktop applications needing a cross-platform, highly portable JSON library

zh.tag: 将Xbox 360游戏《神鬼寓言2》静态重编译到PC平台的开源项目
zh.what: Fable2Recomp 是一个静态重编译项目，旨在将 Xbox 360 游戏《神鬼寓言2》移植到 Windows 和 Linux 平台。它基于 ReXGlue 项目，通过静态重编译方法简化流程并修复反编译/重编译中的问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含构建脚本、配置文件（如 Fable-2_config.toml）以及用于代码生成的工具链，需要配合 ReXGlue SDK 使用。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 ReXGlue SDK、Clang 20、CMake、Ninja 和 vcpkg 等工具。
zh.hot: 作为经典游戏《神鬼寓言2》的移植项目，它吸引了大量粉丝关注，今日新增 23 星，总星数达 332，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 分类第 8 名。
uses: 游戏爱好者：希望在 PC 上重温《神鬼寓言2》的玩家
逆向工程与重编译技术研究者：学习静态重编译技术的开发者
开源贡献者：愿意帮助改进项目、提升画质和帧率的程序员

en.tag: An open-source project to statically recompile Fable 2 from Xbox 360 to PC
en.what: Fable2Recomp is a static recompilation project that aims to port the Xbox 360 game Fable 2 to Windows and Linux. It uses a static recompilation approach based on the ReXGlue project, streamlining the process and fixing issues that may arise during decompilation and recompilation.
en.content: The repository contains build scripts, configuration files (like Fable-2_config.toml), and toolchain for code generation, requiring the ReXGlue SDK.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with dependencies on ReXGlue SDK, Clang 20, CMake, Ninja, and vcpkg.
en.hot: As a porting project for the classic game Fable 2, it has attracted significant attention from fans, gaining 23 stars today and reaching 332 total stars, ranking 8th on GitHub Trending daily list for C++.
uses: Gaming enthusiasts: players who want to replay Fable 2 on PC
Reverse engineering and recompilation researchers: developers learning static recompilation techniques
Open-source contributors: programmers willing to help improve the project, enhance graphics and frame rates

zh.tag: 面向逆向工程师与程序员的现代十六进制编辑器
zh.what: ImHex 是一款功能强大的十六进制编辑器，专为逆向工程师、程序员以及深夜加班、在意眼睛舒适度的人设计。它不仅能查看和编辑二进制数据，还内置了模式语言、数据解析、字节补丁等高级能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 桌面应用源码、插件系统、内置模式语言与解析器、资源与本地化文件，以及构建脚本和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，基于 CMake 构建，依赖 GLFW、ImGui、Capstone、LLVM 等库，支持 Windows、Linux 与 macOS，并提供 Web 版本。
zh.hot: 凭借近 5.5 万颗星和持续活跃的社区，ImHex 已成为逆向工程领域的明星工具，今日再登 C++ 日榜第 9 名。
uses: 逆向工程师分析固件、可执行文件与未知二进制格式
程序员调试文件格式、协议数据与内存转储
安全研究员进行恶意软件分析与取证
任何需要强大十六进制编辑与数据解析能力的开发者

en.tag: A modern hex editor for reverse engineers, programmers and night owls
en.what: ImHex is a feature-rich hex editor built for reverse engineers, programmers, and anyone who values their retinas at 3 AM. Beyond viewing and editing binary data, it offers a pattern language, data parsing, patching and much more.
en.content: The repo contains the full C++ desktop app source, a plugin system, the built-in pattern language and parsers, resources, localization files, build scripts and docs.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++ with CMake, depending on GLFW, ImGui, Capstone, LLVM and more; it supports Windows, Linux, macOS and even a web build.
en.hot: With nearly 55k stars and an active community, ImHex has become a star tool in reverse engineering, ranking 9th on today's C++ trending list.
uses: Reverse engineers analyzing firmware, executables and unknown binary formats
Programmers debugging file formats, protocol data and memory dumps
Security researchers doing malware analysis and forensics
Any developer needing powerful hex editing and data parsing

zh.tag: 开源免费的跨平台乐谱制作与作曲软件
zh.what: MuseScore Studio 是一款开源免费的音乐记谱与作曲软件，采用所见即所得的方式在虚拟五线谱上输入音符。它支持乐谱播放、打印和导出 PDF，并提供 MusicXML、MIDI、MEI 等多种格式的导入导出。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 桌面应用源码、构建脚本、单元测试与 CI 配置，并通过 muse_framework 子模块复用底层框架，另附图标等资源文件。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主，使用 CMake 构建（macOS 上配合 Ninja 编译 Swift 组件），依赖 Qt 等跨平台库，并集成音序器与软件合成器。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源乐谱软件，它已积累约 1.5 万 star，今日小幅新增 3 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 10，说明其长期活跃的社区与持续维护仍受关注。
uses: 音乐学习者与教师，用于制谱、练习和教学演示
作曲人与编曲人，用于创作、播放和导出乐谱
开发者与贡献者，可基于 GPLv3 源码参与开发或二次分发

en.tag: Open-source, free cross-platform music notation and composition software
en.what: MuseScore Studio is an open-source, free music notation and composition application that lets users enter notes WYSIWYG-style on a virtual staff. It supports score playback, printing and PDF export, plus import/export of MusicXML, MIDI, MEI and more.
en.content: The repo holds the full C++ desktop application source, build scripts, unit tests and CI configs, reusing a shared foundation via the muse_framework submodule, plus assets such as icons.
en.stack: Primarily C++ built with CMake (Ninja on macOS for Swift components), relying on cross-platform libraries such as Qt, with an integrated sequencer and software synthesizer.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source notation tool, it has gathered about 15k stars; a small +3 today and a #10 spot on the C++ daily trending list reflect its enduringly active, well-maintained community.
uses: Music students and teachers for engraving, practice and classroom demos
Composers and arrangers for writing, playing back and exporting scores
Developers and contributors who can build on or redistribute the GPLv3 source

zh.tag: 乐鑫官方 ESP32 系列芯片的 Arduino 开发核心
zh.what: 这是乐鑫官方维护的 Arduino 核心库，让 ESP32 系列芯片可以直接用 Arduino IDE 和 Arduino API 进行开发。它把底层 ESP-IDF 的复杂能力封装成熟悉的 Arduino 接口，覆盖从入门到量产的各种场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心源码、各芯片变体定义、预编译库、示例代码、CI 测试工作流以及文档，并配有公开路线图和每月社区会议。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C/C++，构建于乐鑫 ESP-IDF 之上，依赖 Arduino IDE 或 arduino-cli 进行编译，并集成 GitHub Actions 做编译与运行时测试。
zh.hot: 作为 ESP32 生态的官方入口，它已积累 17428 颗星，是 C++ 日榜第 11 名；任何 ESP32 新芯片或新特性都会先在这里落地，因此长期保持热度。
uses: ESP32 开发者：用 Arduino 语法快速开发物联网与嵌入式项目
创客与电子爱好者：从入门到原型验证的首选开发环境
教育场景：高校与培训机构讲授嵌入式与物联网课程
产品团队：基于官方核心做量产固件与长期维护

en.tag: Espressif's official Arduino core for the ESP32 family of SoCs
en.what: This is Espressif's official Arduino core that lets ESP32 family chips be programmed with the Arduino IDE and Arduino API. It wraps the underlying ESP-IDF capabilities into familiar Arduino interfaces, covering everything from hobby projects to production.
en.content: The repo contains core sources, per-chip variant definitions, precompiled libraries, examples, CI test workflows and docs, plus a public roadmap and monthly community meetings.
en.stack: Primarily C/C++, built on top of Espressif's ESP-IDF, compiled via the Arduino IDE or arduino-cli, with GitHub Actions for compilation and runtime testing.
en.hot: As the official gateway to the ESP32 ecosystem, it has gathered 17,428 stars and ranks 11th on the C++ daily trending list; every new ESP32 chip or feature lands here first, keeping it consistently hot.
uses: ESP32 developers building IoT and embedded projects with Arduino syntax
Makers and hobbyists wanting a friendly entry point for prototyping
Educators teaching embedded systems and IoT courses
Product teams shipping and maintaining production firmware on the official core

zh.tag: NVIDIA 官方高性能 CUDA 线性代数模板库与 Python DSL
zh.what: CUTLASS 是 NVIDIA 官方维护的 CUDA C++ 模板抽象集合，用于在 GPU 上实现高性能矩阵乘法（GEMM）及相关线性代数计算。它把数据搬运与分层并行分解拆解为可复用的模块化组件，支持自定义 tiling、数据类型与算法策略。4.x 版本新增 Python 原生的 CUTLASS DSL（CuTe DSL），让开发者无需深厚 C++ 功底即可编写高性能 CUDA 内核。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 模板头文件库、CuTe 布局与张量抽象、大量示例（examples/）与测试，以及新增的 Python DSL 实现和文档、媒体示意图。
zh.stack: 核心为 C++/CUDA 模板元编程，依赖 CUDA Toolkit 与 CMake 构建；Python DSL 基于 Python 与 CuTe 概念，支持与深度学习框架原生集成。
zh.hot: 作为 NVIDIA 官方 GEMM 基石，它支撑着从 Volta 到 Blackwell 全架构的混合精度与低精度计算，累计 star 已破万（10487），今日再登 C++ 日榜第 12，是 GPU 高性能计算领域的长期刚需项目。
uses: GPU 性能工程师：手写或调优接近 cuBLAS 极限的 GEMM 内核
深度学习框架与算子开发者：为自定义算子接入高效张量核心实现
科研人员与学生：借助 Python DSL 低门槛学习并快速原型化 GPU 内核
量化与低精度推理团队：使用 NVFP4/MXFP 等块缩放数据类型做高效推理

en.tag: NVIDIA's official CUDA template library and Python DSLs for high-performance linear algebra
en.what: CUTLASS is NVIDIA's official collection of CUDA C++ template abstractions for implementing high-performance matrix multiplication (GEMM) and related linear algebra on GPUs. It decomposes data movement and hierarchical parallelization into reusable, modular components tunable via custom tiling, data types, and algorithmic policy. Version 4.x adds CUTLASS DSLs, Python-native interfaces (starting with CuTe DSL) for writing high-performance CUDA kernels without deep C++ expertise.
en.content: The repo contains the C++ template header library, CuTe layout/tensor abstractions, extensive examples and tests, plus the new Python DSL implementation, docs, and media diagrams.
en.stack: Core is C++/CUDA template metaprogramming built with CUDA Toolkit and CMake; the Python DSL builds on Python and CuTe concepts with native deep-learning framework integration.
en.hot: As NVIDIA's official GEMM foundation, it powers mixed- and low-precision compute across Volta through Blackwell; with 10,487 stars and a #12 spot on today's C++ trending list, it remains a long-term staple of GPU HPC.
uses: GPU performance engineers hand-tuning GEMM kernels near cuBLAS limits
DL framework and operator developers integrating efficient tensor-core kernels
Researchers and students prototyping GPU kernels via the low-barrier Python DSL
Quantization and low-precision inference teams using NVFP4/MXFP block-scaled types

zh.tag: ESP32 开发板固件启动器与 OTA 管理工具
zh.what: 这是一个面向 M5Stack、Lilygo、SeeedStudio、Waveshare、CYD、Marauder 等 ESP32 设备的固件启动器。它让用户无需 USB 线即可从在线仓库、WebUI 或 SD 卡安装和切换固件，并管理设备分区与文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Launcher 的 C++ 源码、各设备对应的预编译 .bin 固件、安装用的 Flasher 网页工具，以及 OTA、SD 卡管理、WebUI、配置、分区管理等模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 与 ESP-IDF/Arduino 框架开发，依赖 ESP32 的 OTA、SPIFFS、SD 卡和 Wi-Fi 能力，并提供网页 Flasher 与 WebUI 交互界面。
zh.hot: 它解决了 ESP32 玩家频繁刷写和切换固件的痛点，支持众多热门开发板，已获得 2155 颗星，今日新增 6 星并登上 GitHub C++ 日榜第 13 名。
uses: ESP32 开发板玩家，需要快速安装和切换不同固件
M5Stack、Lilygo、CYD 等设备用户，想无线管理固件和文件
嵌入式开发者，需要 OTA 更新、分区管理和 SD 卡操作

en.tag: Firmware launcher and OTA manager for ESP32 boards
en.what: A firmware launcher for ESP32 devices such as M5Stack, Lilygo, SeeedStudio, Waveshare, CYD, and Marauder. It lets users install and switch firmware from online repositories, a WebUI, or an SD card without a USB cable, while managing partitions and files.
en.content: The repo contains the C++ source for Launcher, prebuilt .bin firmware for various devices, a web-based Flasher tool, and modules for OTA, SD card management, WebUI, configuration, and partition management.
en.stack: Primarily built with C++ on the ESP-IDF/Arduino framework, leveraging ESP32 OTA, SPIFFS, SD card, and Wi-Fi capabilities, with a web Flasher and WebUI for interaction.
en.hot: It solves the pain of frequently flashing and switching firmware for ESP32 hobbyists and supports many popular boards, earning 2,155 stars, with 6 added today and ranking 13th on GitHub's C++ daily trending list.
uses: ESP32 board hobbyists who need to quickly install and switch firmware
Users of M5Stack, Lilygo, CYD and similar devices wanting wireless firmware and file management
Embedded developers needing OTA updates, partition management, and SD card operations

zh.tag: 基于 Qt 与 sing-box 的跨平台 GUI 代理客户端
zh.what: Throne 是一款跨平台桌面代理工具，通过图形界面管理 sing-box 与 Xray 内核，帮助用户配置和使用多种代理协议。它支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，可开箱即用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Qt 桌面应用源码、Linux CLI 安装脚本、RPM 仓库配置以及文档站点，提供便携 ZIP 和安装包发布。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 与 Qt 框架开发，集成 sing-box、Xray-core、SQLite、YAML 解析、QR 码识别等库。
zh.hot: 作为已归档 Nekoray 的活跃继任者，Throne 以丰富协议支持和跨平台体验获得 7251 颗星，今日新增 18 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 14 名。
uses: 需要图形界面管理代理的普通桌面用户
在 Windows/Linux/macOS 间切换的跨平台用户
需要多协议订阅与链式代理的高级玩家
希望从 Nekoray 迁移的现有用户

en.tag: Qt-based cross-platform GUI proxy client powered by sing-box
en.what: Throne is a cross-platform desktop proxy utility that manages sing-box and Xray cores through a GUI, letting users configure and use various proxy protocols. It runs out of the box on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.content: The repo contains the Qt desktop app source, a Linux CLI installer script, RPM repository setup, and documentation site, with portable ZIP and installer releases.
en.stack: Built in C++ with the Qt framework, integrating sing-box, Xray-core, SQLite, YAML parsing, QR code recognition, and more.
en.hot: As an active successor to the archived Nekoray, Throne has earned 7,251 stars for its rich protocol support and cross-platform experience, adding 18 stars today and ranking 14th on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Everyday desktop users who want a GUI to manage proxies
Cross-platform users switching between Windows, Linux, and macOS
Advanced users needing multi-protocol subscriptions and chained outbounds
Existing Nekoray users looking to migrate

zh.tag: 让 Windows/Linux 上的 AirPods 拥有接近苹果生态的桌面体验
zh.what: AirPodsDesktop 是一个用 C++ 编写的桌面增强程序，为 Windows（Linux 版本开发中）补上 AirPods 官方缺失的功能。它能在通知区域显示电量、自动检测入耳并控制媒体播放，还提供低延迟音频模式和带动画的设备弹窗。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Source 源码目录、Docs 构建文档、Assets 预览动图与多语言 README（英/简中/繁中），并配有 GitHub Actions 的 Windows 构建流程。
zh.stack: 主语言 C++，基于 Qt 6.8.3 构建界面，辅以 spdlog 日志、cxxopts 命令行解析和 cpr 网络请求库，采用 GPLv3 许可。
zh.hot: AirPods 在 Windows 上体验割裂是长期痛点，这类刚需工具稀缺，项目已积累 3442 颗星并登上 C++ 日榜第 15 名。
uses: 在 Windows 台式机或笔记本上使用 AirPods 的用户，想要电量显示与入耳检测
需要低延迟音频模式的游戏或影音用户
希望为开源项目贡献翻译或修复 bug 的 C++/Qt 开发者
关注跨平台蓝牙音频体验、想参考实现思路的技术爱好者

en.tag: Bring an Apple-like AirPods experience to Windows and Linux desktops
en.what: AirPodsDesktop is a C++ desktop utility that fills in the AirPods features missing on Windows (with Linux support in progress). It shows battery levels in the notification area, auto-detects ear placement to control media playback, and adds a low-latency audio mode plus animated device popups.
en.content: The repo contains the Source code tree, Docs build instructions, Assets preview GIFs, and READMEs in English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, plus a GitHub Actions Windows build workflow.
en.stack: Written in C++ with a Qt 6.8.3 UI, using spdlog for logging, cxxopts for CLI parsing and cpr for HTTP, released under GPLv3.
en.hot: AirPods on Windows have long been a fragmented experience and few tools address it, so the project has gathered 3,442 stars and ranks 15th on the daily C++ trending list.
uses: Windows desktop or laptop users with AirPods who want battery display and ear detection
Gamers or media watchers who need a low-latency audio mode
C++/Qt developers looking to contribute translations or bug fixes
Tech enthusiasts curious about cross-platform Bluetooth audio implementations

zh.tag: Google 官方 C++ 测试与模拟框架
zh.what: GoogleTest 是 Google 的 C++ 测试框架，用于编写和运行单元测试。它支持自动测试发现、丰富的断言、死亡测试、参数化测试等，并集成了 GoogleMock 用于模拟对象。
zh.content: 仓库包含 GoogleTest 和 GoogleMock 的源码、文档、示例以及构建配置。文档托管在 GitHub Pages 上，提供用户指南和入门教程。
zh.stack: 基于 C++，要求 C++17 或更高版本（1.18.x 分支）。计划依赖 Abseil 库。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方测试框架，拥有近 3.9 万 Star，是 C++ 社区的事实标准，持续维护并发布新版本。
uses: C++ 开发者编写单元测试，确保代码质量
需要模拟对象进行依赖隔离的测试场景
在 CI/CD 流程中集成自动化测试
学习 xUnit 测试框架设计的最佳实践

en.tag: Google's official C++ testing and mocking framework
en.what: GoogleTest is Google's C++ testing framework for writing and running unit tests. It supports automatic test discovery, rich assertions, death tests, parameterized tests, and integrates GoogleMock for mocking.
en.content: The repository contains source code, documentation, examples, and build configuration for GoogleTest and GoogleMock. Docs are hosted on GitHub Pages with user guide and primer.
en.stack: Built on C++, requires C++17 or later (1.18.x branch). Plans to depend on Abseil.
en.hot: As Google's official testing framework, it has nearly 39k stars, is the de facto standard in C++ community, and is actively maintained with new releases.
uses: C++ developers writing unit tests to ensure code quality
Scenarios requiring mocking objects for dependency isolation
Integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Learning best practices of xUnit test framework design

zh.tag: AMD ROCm 系统级项目超级仓库，统一开发与 CI
zh.what: 这是 AMD ROCm 生态的系统级项目超级仓库，把原本分散的多个 ROCm 系统组件合并到单一仓库中，以简化开发、持续集成与整合流程。首批项目聚焦于构建 PyTorch 所需的底层依赖。
zh.content: 仓库以子目录形式收纳 amdsmi、aqlprofile、clr、hip、hipfile、rocdecode、rocjpeg、rocm-core、rocminfo、rocm-smi-lib、rocprofiler 等众多组件，并附有迁移状态与 CI 健康度表格。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主，涉及 HIP、ROCm 运行时与性能分析工具链，依赖 CMake 构建系统与 GitHub Actions 做 CI。
zh.hot: 作为 AMD 官方整合 ROCm 系统组件的超级仓库，它关系到 PyTorch 在 AMD 平台上的构建，今日登上 GitHub C++ 日榜第 17 名，累计 510 星。
uses: AMD GPU 开发者，需要构建或调试 ROCm 底层组件
在 AMD 平台上编译 PyTorch 等框架的工程师
关注 ROCm 性能分析与系统工具链的研究人员

en.tag: AMD's ROCm systems super-repo unifying development and CI
en.what: This is AMD's ROCm systems super-repo, consolidating multiple ROCm system projects into a single repository to streamline development, CI, and integration. The first batch of projects focuses on the requirements for building PyTorch.
en.content: It houses components such as amdsmi, aqlprofile, clr, hip, hipfile, rocdecode, rocjpeg, rocm-core, rocminfo, rocm-smi-lib, and rocprofiler as subdirectories, along with a migration-status and CI-health table.
en.stack: Primarily C++, covering HIP, ROCm runtime, and profiling toolchains, built with CMake and CI via GitHub Actions.
en.hot: As AMD's official super-repo consolidating ROCm system components, it matters for building PyTorch on AMD hardware, landing at #17 on GitHub's daily C++ trending with 510 stars.
uses: AMD GPU developers building or debugging ROCm low-level components
Engineers compiling PyTorch and similar frameworks on AMD platforms
Researchers tracking ROCm profiling and system toolchains

zh.tag: 阿里内部验证的混合架构 AI 代码审查 CLI 工具
zh.what: Open Code Review 是阿里巴巴内部孵化并开源的 AI 代码审查命令行工具，采用确定性流水线加 LLM Agent 的混合架构。它能在代码行级别给出精确评论，并内置 NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL 注入等多语言规则集。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 编写，提供 CLI 主程序、内置规则集与 Agent 集成配置，并附带官网、多语言 README 与 npm 包发布脚本。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，通过 npm 包 @alibaba-group/open-code-review 分发，兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 接口，并支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent。
zh.hot: 背靠阿里内部两年、数万开发者与数百万缺陷的实战验证，加上 22734 星、今日新增 264 星并登上 Go 日榜第 11 名，关注度持续攀升。
uses: 希望把 AI 代码审查接入 CI/CD 的工程团队
使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent 的开发者
需要 NPE、线程安全、SQL 注入等规则检查的 Go/多语言项目
想借鉴混合架构与规则集设计的 AI 工具开发者

en.tag: Alibaba's battle-tested hybrid-architecture AI code review CLI
en.what: Open Code Review is an open-sourced AI code review CLI incubated inside Alibaba, combining deterministic pipelines with an LLM Agent. It produces precise line-level comments and ships with a built-in multi-language ruleset covering NPE, thread-safety, XSS and SQL injection.
en.content: Written in Go, the repo contains the CLI, built-in rule sets and agent integration configs, plus a website, multilingual READMEs and npm publishing setup.
en.stack: Primary language is Go, distributed via the npm package @alibaba-group/open-code-review, compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, and integrates with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
en.hot: Backed by two years of internal Alibaba use by tens of thousands of developers and millions of defects found, it has reached 22,734 stars with 264 added today, ranking 11th on the Go daily trending list.
uses: Engineering teams wanting AI code review in CI/CD
Developers using Claude Code, Codex or Cursor agents
Go and multi-language projects needing NPE, thread-safety and SQL injection checks
AI tool builders studying hybrid architecture and ruleset design

zh.tag: 终端里的智能体编程助手，用自然语言写代码
zh.what: Claude Code 是 Anthropic 推出的智能体编程工具，常驻终端，能理解你的代码库。它通过自然语言指令执行日常任务、解释复杂代码并处理 git 工作流，帮助开发者更快编码。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含安装脚本、插件目录（提供自定义命令与智能体扩展）以及演示动图，官方文档托管在外部站点。
zh.stack: 核心以 TypeScript 编写，要求 Node.js 18+，支持 curl、Homebrew、WinGet、PowerShell 等多种安装方式（npm 已弃用）。
zh.hot: 作为 Anthropic 官方出品的智能体编程工具，它已积累 145,507 颗星，今日再增 165 星并登上日榜第 11 名，持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: 希望用自然语言加速日常编码与重构的开发者
需要在终端内处理 git 工作流和代码解释的工程师
想通过插件扩展自定义命令与智能体的进阶用户

en.tag: An agentic coding tool living in your terminal, coding via natural language
en.what: Claude Code is Anthropic's agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal and understands your codebase. It executes routine tasks, explains complex code, and handles git workflows through natural language commands, helping developers code faster.
en.content: The repo mainly contains install scripts, a plugins directory (offering custom commands and agent extensions), and a demo GIF, with official docs hosted externally.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, it requires Node.js 18+ and supports multiple install methods like curl, Homebrew, WinGet, and PowerShell (npm is deprecated).
en.hot: As Anthropic's official agentic coding tool, it has amassed 145,507 stars, gaining 165 more today and ranking 11th on the daily trending list, drawing steady developer attention.
uses: Developers who want to speed up daily coding and refactoring with natural language
Engineers handling git workflows and code explanations inside the terminal
Advanced users extending custom commands and agents via plugins

zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理打造的性能优化与安全增强系统
zh.what: ECC 是一个代理工具链（harness）优化系统，为 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理提供技能、直觉、记忆、安全与研究优先的开发能力。它通过统一的配置与插件机制，增强代理在复杂任务中的表现与可控性。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 JavaScript 库、CLI 工具、GitHub App（ecc-tools）、文档（多语言 README）以及示例配置，支持通过 npm 包（ecc-universal）集成。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js，依赖 npm 生态，提供 CLI 与 GitHub App 集成，支持多代理框架（Claude Code、Codex 等）。
zh.hot: 凭借 24.4 万 Star 和今日新增 235 星，ECC 成为 AI 代理工具链领域的明星项目，其跨代理兼容性和性能优化特性吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: AI 编码代理用户：希望增强 Claude Code、Codex 等代理的记忆、安全与技能，提升开发效率。
团队与组织：需要统一管理多个 AI 代理的配置、权限与安全策略，确保合规与可控。
开发者工具链爱好者：对代理性能优化、插件机制和 GitHub App 集成感兴趣，可扩展自定义功能。

en.tag: Performance optimization and security enhancement system for AI coding agents like Claude Code
en.what: ECC is an agent harness optimization system that provides skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development capabilities for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and Cursor. It enhances agent performance and control through unified configuration and plugin mechanisms.
en.content: The repository includes core JavaScript libraries, CLI tools, a GitHub App (ecc-tools), multi-language documentation, and example configurations, integrable via the npm package (ecc-universal).
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, leveraging the npm ecosystem, offering CLI and GitHub App integration, compatible with multiple agent frameworks (Claude Code, Codex, etc.).
en.hot: With 244k stars and 235 new stars today, ECC has become a star project in the AI agent toolchain space, attracting developers with its cross-agent compatibility and performance optimization features.
uses: AI coding agent users: Enhance memory, security, and skills for agents like Claude Code and Codex to boost development productivity.
Teams and organizations: Need unified management of configurations, permissions, and security policies across multiple AI agents for compliance and control.
Developer toolchain enthusiasts: Interested in agent performance optimization, plugin mechanisms, and GitHub App integration for custom extensions.

zh.tag: 把文档变成可查询RAG、自主推理Agent和自维护Wiki的LLM知识平台
zh.what: WeKnora是腾讯开源的LLM知识平台，将原始文档转化为可查询的RAG、自主推理的Agent和自维护的Wiki。它支持多源数据导入、树状文件夹视图、块编辑与版本回滚，并提供交互式知识图谱。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、架构文档、API参考、开发者指南，以及多语言README（中英日韩）。核心功能包括RAG快速问答、ReAct Agent、Wiki模式、知识图谱、多源导入（飞书、Notion、语雀、RSS等）和网站嵌入组件。
zh.stack: 主语言为Go，基于LLM能力构建，涉及RAG、ReAct Agent、MCP工具集成、向量检索等技术。支持多种文档格式和外部服务（如飞书、Notion、RSS）。
zh.hot: 上线后迅速获得2万+星标，今日新增105星，位列GitHub Go语言日榜第5。其将文档自动转化为可交互知识图谱和自维护Wiki的能力，解决了企业知识管理的痛点，备受开发者关注。
uses: 企业知识库建设：将内部文档自动整理为可查询的RAG和自维护Wiki，提升员工检索效率。
智能客服与问答系统：利用RAG快速问答能力，构建基于私有知识的对话机器人。
复杂任务自动化：通过ReAct Agent编排检索、工具调用和网络搜索，完成多步骤分析。
个人知识管理：导入个人文档，生成知识图谱和Wiki，辅助学习和研究。

en.tag: Open-source LLM knowledge platform turning documents into queryable RAG, autonomous agent, and self-maintaining Wiki
en.what: WeKnora is an open-source LLM knowledge platform from Tencent that transforms raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki. It supports multi-source ingestion, tree-structured folder views, chunk editing with revision history, and an interactive knowledge graph.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, architecture docs, API reference, developer guide, and multi-language READMEs (EN, CN, JA, KO). Key features include RAG-based Q&A, ReAct Agent, Wiki mode, knowledge graph, multi-source ingestion (Feishu, Notion, Yuque, RSS, etc.), and website embed widgets.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built on LLM capabilities, incorporating RAG, ReAct Agent, MCP tool integration, and vector retrieval. Supports various document formats and external services like Feishu, Notion, and RSS.
en.hot: Quickly gained over 20k stars with 105 new stars today, ranking #5 on GitHub Go daily trending. Its ability to auto-convert documents into interactive knowledge graphs and self-maintaining wikis addresses enterprise knowledge management pain points, drawing significant developer attention.
uses: Enterprise knowledge base: Automatically organize internal documents into queryable RAG and self-maintaining Wiki to boost employee retrieval efficiency.
Intelligent customer service and Q&A systems: Leverage RAG-based quick Q&A to build chatbots grounded in private knowledge.
Complex task automation: Use ReAct Agent to orchestrate retrieval, tool calls, and web search for multi-step analysis.
Personal knowledge management: Import personal documents to generate knowledge graphs and wikis for learning and research.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编程代理提供生产级工程技能包
zh.what: 这是一套面向 AI 编程代理的工程技能库，把资深工程师的工作流、质量门禁和最佳实践编码成可复用的技能。它覆盖从需求定义到上线的完整开发生命周期，让代理在每个阶段都遵循一致的标准。
zh.content: 仓库以技能包形式组织，包含 25 个技能和 9 个斜杠命令（如 /spec、/plan、/build、/test、/review、/ship），每个命令会自动激活对应技能。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，通过开放的 skills CLI（npx skills add）安装，可接入 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Copilot、Cline 等 70 多个代理。
zh.hot: 凭借 Addy Osmani 的影响力与 AI 编程代理热潮，项目已获 94,344 颗星，今日新增 354 星，位列 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第 3 名。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理的开发者，希望代理遵循统一工程规范
团队想为 AI 辅助开发引入质量门禁与标准化工作流
个人开发者需要从需求到上线的结构化开发流程模板
对 AI 代理技能包设计感兴趣、想学习或二次开发的人

en.tag: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents
en.what: A collection of engineering skills that encode the workflows, quality gates, and best practices senior engineers use, packaged so AI coding agents follow them consistently. It spans the full development lifecycle from defining requirements to shipping to production.
en.content: The repo is organized as skill packages, offering 25 skills and 9 slash commands (e.g. /spec, /plan, /build, /test, /review, /ship), each automatically activating the relevant skills.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, installed via the open skills CLI (npx skills add) and compatible with 70+ agents including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, and Cline.
en.hot: Backed by Addy Osmani's reputation and the AI coding agent boom, it has reached 94,344 stars with 354 added today, ranking #3 on GitHub Trending (JavaScript) daily.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor who want consistent engineering standards
Teams looking to add quality gates and standardized workflows to AI-assisted development
Individual developers wanting a structured spec-to-ship development process
Anyone curious about designing AI agent skill packages or wanting to extend them

zh.tag: 面向知识工作者的 Claude 插件集，按职能定制 AI 工作流
zh.what: 这是 Anthropic 开源的一套 Claude 插件，旨在将 Claude 转变为特定角色、团队和公司的专家。每个插件捆绑了技能、连接器、斜杠命令和子代理，覆盖销售、产品、营销、法律等 11 种职能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 11 个职能插件目录（如 productivity、sales、customer-support 等），每个目录内有技能定义、连接器配置、斜杠命令和子代理。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，依赖 Claude Cowork 和 Claude Code 平台，并集成 Slack、Notion、Jira 等第三方连接器。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 110 星，总星数达 24287，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 7 名，反映出知识工作者对 AI 提效工具的强烈需求。
uses: 知识工作者：通过插件快速获得角色专属的 AI 助手，提升日常工作效率。
团队负责人：定制插件以统一团队工作流程和术语，确保输出一致性。
企业开发者：基于开源插件进行二次开发，集成内部工具和数据源。
Claude 用户：利用现成插件扩展 Claude 功能，无需从零构建。

en.tag: Claude plugins for knowledge workers, customizing AI workflows by job function
en.what: Anthropic open-sources a set of Claude plugins designed to turn Claude into a specialist for your role, team, and company. Each plugin bundles skills, connectors, slash commands, and sub-agents for specific job functions like sales, product, marketing, legal, and more.
en.content: The repo contains 11 job-function plugin directories (e.g., productivity, sales, customer-support), each with skill definitions, connector configurations, slash commands, and sub-agents.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, it relies on Claude Cowork and Claude Code platforms, and integrates third-party connectors like Slack, Notion, and Jira.
en.hot: With 110 stars added today and a total of 24,287 stars, it ranks 7th on GitHub Trending daily, reflecting strong demand for AI productivity tools among knowledge workers.
uses: Knowledge workers: get role-specific AI assistance to boost daily productivity.
Team leads: customize plugins to unify workflows and terminology for consistent output.
Enterprise developers: extend open-source plugins to integrate internal tools and data.
Claude users: leverage ready-made plugins to expand Claude's capabilities without building from scratch.

zh.tag: 腾讯云开源的自托管多用户多智能体 AI 助手
zh.what: Octop 是腾讯云开源的自托管 AI 助手，主打多用户与多智能体并行协作，可为团队、家庭和个人搭建独立又协同的智能环境。它完全运行在本地，隐私不外泄，单进程启动即可用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 3.12+ 的完整实现，提供 Web 控制台、CLI 与 IM 集成，并有专家库、Connectors（OAuth + MCP）和 ACP 等扩展模块，附中英文 README 与路线图。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.12+，采用 Ruff 代码风格，通过 PyPI 分发，支持 HTTP/SSE/WebSocket 接口，并集成 MCP、OAuth 与 ACP 协议。
zh.hot: 上线即冲上 GitHub Trending Python 日榜第 6，累计约 2950 star、单日新增 396，腾讯云背书加上自托管多智能体定位正好切中隐私与协作需求。
uses: 注重数据隐私、希望本地自托管 AI 助手的团队与个人
需要多用户共享、多智能体协作的家庭或小型组织
想通过飞书、钉钉、QQ、Discord、企业微信等 IM 接入 AI 的用户
希望用专家库、Connectors 与 ACP 扩展 IDE 工作流的开发者

en.tag: Tencent Cloud's self-hosted multi-user, multi-agent AI assistant
en.what: Octop is an open-source, self-hosted AI assistant from Tencent Cloud built around multi-user and multi-agent parallelism, creating an intelligent environment that is both independent and collaborative for teams, families, and individuals. It runs entirely on your own machine, so privacy is never compromised, and a single process brings up the whole stack.
en.content: The repo ships a full Python 3.12+ implementation with a web console, CLI and IM integrations, plus extension modules such as an expert library, Connectors (OAuth + MCP) and ACP, along with bilingual READMEs and a roadmap.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.12+, styled with Ruff and distributed via PyPI, it exposes HTTP/SSE/WebSocket interfaces and integrates MCP, OAuth and ACP protocols.
en.hot: It hit No.6 on GitHub Trending's Python daily list with roughly 2,950 stars and 396 gained in a single day, as Tencent Cloud's backing plus a self-hosted multi-agent angle taps straight into privacy and collaboration needs.
uses: Teams and individuals who value privacy and want a self-hosted AI assistant
Families or small organizations needing multi-user sharing and multi-agent collaboration
Users who want AI access via Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, Discord or WeCom
Developers extending IDE workflows with the expert library, Connectors and ACP

zh.tag: 纯 C 零依赖的 MoE 推理引擎，把磁盘、内存、显存当作统一层级，让你在自有硬件上跑 744B 到 2.8T 的前沿 MoE 大模型。
zh.what: Colibrì 是一个用纯 C 编写、无引擎依赖的推理引擎，通过把存储、内存和显存统一成一套「AI 内存多级分层」，让消费级和异构硬件也能运行 744B 到 2.8T 参数的前沿 MoE 模型。它把专家权重按需从磁盘流式加载，用极小的常驻内存换取巨大的模型规模。
zh.content: 仓库提供每个模型家族一个 C 文件的核心实现，以及统一的 `coli chat` / `coli serve` / `coli web` 前端；还包含 Web 仪表盘、Brio 模式、Brain 页面与 Profiling 等工具，并附有官网、Discord 和多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主语言为 C，强调零引擎依赖，自行处理模型格式、内存层级、存储 I/O、放置调度、内核、推测解码以及 CPU/GPU 重叠执行。
zh.hot: 本周新增 5565 star、总数 36869，冲上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 3 名；在「大模型必须靠稀缺硬件」的痛点下，它用纯 C 和磁盘流式专家把 744B 级模型塞进消费级设备，话题性和实用性都很强。
uses: 想在自有消费级或异构硬件上本地运行前沿 MoE 大模型的开发者与研究者
对推理系统、内存分层、存储 I/O 与调度优化感兴趣的系统工程师
希望以可复现实验方式探索激进推理优化思路的研究平台用户
需要低成本、可自托管大模型推理方案的个人或小团队

en.tag: A pure-C, zero-dependency MoE inference engine that treats disk, RAM and VRAM as one hierarchy, letting you run 744B–2.8T frontier MoE models on hardware you already own.
en.what: Colibrì is a pure-C, dependency-free inference engine that runs frontier MoE models of 744B to 2.8T parameters on consumer and heterogeneous hardware by treating storage, RAM and VRAM as a single AI memory multitiering hierarchy. It streams experts from disk on demand, trading a tiny resident footprint for an immense model size.
en.content: The repo ships a one-C-file core per model family plus a unified `coli chat` / `coli serve` / `coli web` front end; it also includes a web dashboard, Brio mode, a Brain page and profiling tools, along with a website, Discord and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Written in C with zero engine dependencies, it handles model formats, memory hierarchy, storage I/O, placement, scheduling, kernels, speculation and CPU/GPU overlap itself.
