需要眼动追踪、自适应扳机等高级功能的开发者
研究 VR 驱动修改与逆向工程的爱好者

en.tag: Unofficial driver/app mod that improves the PSVR2 experience on PC
en.what: An unofficial modification of Sony's official PlayStation VR2 PC driver/app, aiming to improve the PSVR2 experience on Windows and Linux. It adds features the official driver lacks, such as eye tracking, adaptive triggers, headset vibration, SteamVR passthrough and Linux support.
en.content: The repo is mainly C++ source code, including driver/runtime modifications, a developer-facing API library, plus wiki docs for installation and jailbreaking.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, it builds on the official PSVR2 driver and SteamVR runtime; some features require the Ignition project and a jailbroken headset.
en.hot: The official PSVR2 PC driver is limited, so demand for eye tracking, Linux support and other enhancements is strong; the project gained 21 stars this week for 729 total, ranking 17th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: PSVR2 owners who want a better PC experience
VR users who want to use PSVR2 on Linux
Developers needing eye tracking, adaptive triggers and other advanced features
Enthusiasts studying VR driver modification and reverse engineering

zh.tag: 回合制末世生存游戏，程序生成世界的硬核求生模拟
zh.what: 《Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead》是一款回合制末世生存游戏。玩家要在严酷、持久、程序生成的废土中搜刮残骸求生，对抗僵尸、巨虫、杀人机器人乃至更诡异致命的怪物，也要提防同样觊觎你物资的幸存者。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整游戏源码（src/）、JSON 化的物品/怪物/配方等数据（data/）、多套贴图与截图、文档（doc/）以及各平台打包与编译说明。
zh.stack: 主语言为 C++，采用 ncurses 与 SDL 两套前端；数据与内容大量以 JSON 定义，便于社区扩展，构建依赖 CMake 等常见工具链。
zh.hot: 作为运营十余年的开源硬核生存游戏，它已积累 13,235 颗星，本周再增 76 星并登上 C++ 周榜第 18 名，靠持续更新与活跃社区长盛不衰。
uses: 喜欢硬核生存、Roguelike 与深度模拟的玩家
想研究大型 C++ 开源游戏架构与 JSON 数据驱动设计的开发者
希望参与开源游戏内容创作、翻译或模组制作的贡献者
在 Linux/BSD 终端或桌面环境下寻找可长期游玩单机游戏的用户

en.tag: A turn-based post-apocalyptic survival game with a procedurally generated world
en.what: Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead is a turn-based survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Players scavenge the remnants of a dead civilization for food, gear, or a fueled vehicle, fighting or fleeing zombies, giant insects, killer robots, and other survivors who want what you have.
en.content: The repo holds the full game source (src/), JSON-driven data for items, monsters, and recipes (data/), multiple tilesets and screenshots, documentation (doc/), plus packaging and build instructions for many platforms.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++ with both ncurses and SDL frontends; much of the content is defined in JSON for easy community modding, built via CMake and standard toolchains.
en.hot: A decade-plus open-source hardcore survival game, it has amassed 13,235 stars, adding 76 this week to rank 18th on the C++ trending list, sustained by constant updates and an active community.
uses: Players who love hardcore survival, roguelikes, and deep simulation
Developers studying large-scale C++ open-source game architecture and JSON-driven design
Contributors wanting to add content, translations, or mods to an open-source game
Users on Linux/BSD terminals or desktops seeking a long-term single-player game

zh.tag: 浏览器里的实时全球态势感知模拟器
zh.what: 这是一个在浏览器中运行的间谍卫星模拟器，但数据是真实的。它在一个逼真的3D地球上实时展示飞机、船舶、卫星、地震、交通和公共摄像头等公开信号，并支持语音控制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的Web应用源码，包括3D地球渲染、实时数据图层、语音控制AI代理、以及清晰的标注（如模拟与实时区分）。
zh.stack: 主要使用JavaScript，可能涉及Three.js或类似3D库、WebSocket实时数据、语音识别API等。
zh.hot: 该项目在GitHub Trending日榜排名第一，今日新增近2000星，因其独特的'真实数据间谍卫星'概念和病毒式传播的YouTube系列而迅速走红。
uses: 对开源情报、地理空间数据可视化感兴趣的开发者或研究者。
希望体验实时全球动态（航班、船舶、卫星等）的科技爱好者。
教育场景中用于演示实时数据源和3D可视化技术。

en.tag: A real-time global situational awareness simulator in your browser
en.what: A spy-satellite simulator in your browser with real data. It visualizes live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras on a photorealistic 3D globe, with hands-free voice control.
en.content: The repo contains the full web app source code, including 3D globe rendering, live data layers, a voice-controlled AI agent, and clear labeling of simulated vs. live feeds.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, likely using Three.js or similar 3D libraries, WebSocket for real-time data, and speech recognition APIs.
en.hot: Ranked #1 on GitHub Trending daily with ~2,000 stars added today, it went viral due to its unique 'real-data spy satellite' concept and the popular YouTube series behind it.
uses: Developers or researchers interested in open-source intelligence and geospatial data visualization.
Tech enthusiasts who want to experience real-time global dynamics (flights, ships, satellites, etc.).
Educational settings for demonstrating real-time data sources and 3D visualization techniques.

zh.tag: AI 代理技能，一键生成可验证的交互式系统架构图
zh.what: Archify 是一个 AI 代理技能，可将代码库或系统描述转化为精美的交互式系统地图。它支持五种图表类型、四种预设、明暗主题和内置品牌标识，并能生成自包含的 HTML 文件，方便演示和分享。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、文档、示例和生成器代码，支持通过 npx 命令安装到 Raven、Cursor、Claude Code 等代理。提供项目页面、场景指南和画廊，展示不同用例。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML，使用 TypeScript 生成确定性校验的 JSON IR，并输出 HTML、PNG、SVG、WebM 等格式。依赖 npx 进行安装，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 18k+ 星标和日增千星的势头，Archify 满足了开发者对可视化架构文档的迫切需求，尤其在 AI 辅助开发场景下，能快速生成可验证的图表，提升代码审查和沟通效率。
uses: 开发者希望在代码审查前快速生成架构对比图，确保变更可验证。
技术写作者或架构师需要为系统设计生成交互式演示文档，便于向团队或客户展示。
AI 代理用户希望将代码库映射为可视化图表，以便更直观地理解系统结构和数据流。

en.tag: Agent skill that turns codebases into beautiful, verifiable interactive architecture diagrams
en.what: Archify is an agent skill that transforms a codebase or system description into a polished, interactive system map. It supports five diagram types, four presets, dark/light themes, and built-in brand marks, producing self-contained HTML files for easy presentation and sharing.
en.content: The repository contains skill definitions, documentation, examples, and generator code, installable via npx into agents like Raven, Cursor, and Claude Code. It includes a project page, scenario guide, and gallery showcasing various use cases.
en.stack: Primarily HTML-based, using TypeScript to generate deterministically checked JSON IR, outputting HTML, PNG, SVG, WebM, and more. Installed via npx, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 18k+ stars and a daily gain of 1k, Archify addresses the urgent need for visual architecture documentation, especially in AI-assisted development, enabling quick generation of verifiable diagrams that boost code review and communication efficiency.
uses: Developers who want to quickly generate architecture comparison diagrams before code review to ensure changes are verifiable.
Technical writers or architects needing interactive presentation documents for system designs to share with teams or clients.
AI agent users who want to map codebases into visual diagrams for better understanding of system structure and data flow.

zh.tag: 一键开启沉浸式多智能体课堂
zh.what: OpenMAIC 是一个开源的多智能体交互式课堂平台，让用户通过点击即可获得沉浸式的多智能体学习体验。它模拟真实课堂环境，由多个 AI 智能体扮演不同角色（如教师、学生），进行互动教学。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端界面（Next.js/React）、后端逻辑（LangGraph 编排）、智能体配置、部署模板（Vercel）、文档和社区资源。支持 OpenClaw 集成和 Lemonade 本地 AI。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Next.js 16、React 19、LangGraph 1.1 构建，支持多种 LLM 提供商（如 OpenAI、Anthropic）的 API 密钥配置。
zh.hot: 凭借创新的多智能体教学理念和极简的一键部署体验，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，24 小时内新增 907 星，总星数突破 2.2 万，位列 Trending 日榜第 5。
uses: 教育工作者：快速搭建 AI 驱动的互动课堂，探索新型教学模式。
AI 开发者：研究多智能体协作与交互，参考其架构和实现。
学习者：通过沉浸式多智能体对话，获得个性化学习体验。
开源爱好者：部署和定制自己的智能体课堂，参与社区贡献。

en.tag: One-click immersive multi-agent learning classroom
en.what: OpenMAIC is an open-source multi-agent interactive classroom platform that provides an immersive learning experience with one click. It simulates a real classroom where multiple AI agents play different roles (e.g., teacher, students) to conduct interactive teaching.
en.content: The repo includes frontend UI (Next.js/React), backend logic (LangGraph orchestration), agent configurations, deployment templates (Vercel), documentation, and community resources. Supports OpenClaw integration and Lemonade local AI.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, using Next.js 16, React 19, LangGraph 1.1, and supports multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) via API keys.
en.hot: Its innovative multi-agent teaching concept and one-click deployment experience have made it viral on GitHub, gaining 907 stars in 24 hours, surpassing 22k total stars, and ranking #5 on the daily trending list.
uses: Educators: Quickly set up AI-driven interactive classrooms to explore new teaching models.
AI developers: Study multi-agent collaboration and interaction, referencing its architecture and implementation.
Learners: Gain personalized learning experiences through immersive multi-agent dialogues.
Open-source enthusiasts: Deploy and customize their own agent classroom, contributing to the community.

zh.tag: 本地优先的全能语音工作室
zh.what: VoiceStudio 是一个开源的、完全本地运行的语音工具集，提供类似 ElevenLabs 的功能，包括声音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、听写、转录和有声书制作，支持 646 种语言。无需账户、API 密钥或订阅，所有处理都在用户自己的硬件上完成。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的应用代码、文档、安装指南、架构说明和 API 文档，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 及 Docker。集成了 16 种 TTS 引擎和 11 种 ASR 引擎，提供图形界面和命令行工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，依赖多种开源 TTS/ASR 引擎（如 Coqui、Whisper 等），支持跨平台桌面环境与 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 作为本地优先的 ElevenLabs 替代品，VoiceStudio 在隐私和成本敏感的用户中迅速走红，单日新增 1672 星，总星数达 16279，反映出对自主语音处理工具的高需求。
uses: 内容创作者：需要为视频配音或制作多语言音频，但不想依赖云服务。
隐私敏感用户：希望语音数据完全留在本地，避免上传到第三方。
开发者：需要集成语音克隆或转录功能的 API，且要求离线运行。
语言学习者：利用 646 种语言支持进行听力练习或生成自定义语音内容。

en.tag: Fully-local voice studio: clone, dub, transcribe & more
en.what: VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully-local voice toolkit offering ElevenLabs-like features: voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation across 646 languages. No account, API key, or subscription required—everything runs on your own hardware.
en.content: The repository includes full application code, docs, installation guides, architecture, and API docs, supporting macOS, Windows, Linux, and Docker. It integrates 16 TTS engines and 11 ASR engines, offering both GUI and CLI tools.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, leveraging various open-source TTS/ASR engines (e.g., Coqui, Whisper), with cross-platform desktop support and Docker deployment.
en.hot: As a local-first ElevenLabs alternative, VoiceStudio is gaining rapid traction among privacy- and cost-conscious users, adding 1,672 stars in a day to reach 16,279 total, reflecting high demand for self-hosted voice tools.
uses: Content creators needing video dubbing or multilingual audio without cloud dependency.
Privacy-conscious users who want voice data to stay entirely on-device.
Developers seeking offline APIs for voice cloning or transcription integration.
Language learners leveraging 646-language support for listening practice or custom audio.

zh.tag: 让编程 Agent 先给答案、别绕弯子的输出规范技能
zh.what: 这是一个给编程助手（coding agent）用的输出风格技能，强制它先给行动、再给解释，用编号步骤代替长篇铺垫。它不改变模型能力，只改变回答的组织方式，让结果像给 ADHD 用户看的一样直接。
zh.content: 仓库核心是 skills/i-have-adhd/SKILL.md 里的 10 条规则，外加 INSTALL.md 安装说明、AGENTS.md 给 agent 的指引，以及多语言 README 和 logo。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主语言，本质是 Markdown 技能文件，通过 Claude 插件市场（claude plugin marketplace）安装，可 fork 后自行改规则。
zh.hot: 它精准戳中「AI 回答又长又绕」的痛点，用极简规则给出可感知的前后对比，今日新增 4650 star、总数 34632，直接冲上 GitHub 日榜第一。
uses: 每天被 AI 长回复淹没、只想快速拿到下一步操作的开发者
用 Claude 等 coding agent 写代码、希望输出更紧凑的团队
想自定义 agent 输出规范、愿意 fork 改 SKILL.md 的进阶用户

en.tag: A skill that stops your coding agent from burying the answer
en.what: It's an output-style skill for coding agents that forces action-first answers with numbered steps instead of long preambles. It doesn't change model capability, only how responses are organized, making them ADHD-friendly and to the point.
en.content: The core is a 10-rule SKILL.md under skills/i-have-adhd/, plus INSTALL.md, an AGENTS.md for agents, multilingual READMEs, and a logo.
en.stack: Python is the listed language, but it's essentially a Markdown skill file installed via the Claude plugin marketplace and forkable for custom rules.
en.hot: It nails the pain of bloated AI answers with a simple rule set and a clear before/after demo, gaining 4,650 stars today to 34,632 total and hitting #1 on GitHub Trending.
uses: Developers drowning in long AI replies who just want the next action
Teams using coding agents like Claude who want tighter, more actionable output
Advanced users who want to fork and customize the SKILL.md rules

zh.tag: 为消费级硬件自动挑选并运行本地大模型的推理引擎
zh.what: Magnitude 是一款面向消费级硬件的开源推理引擎，会先分析你的机器配置，推荐最合适的模型，然后自动下载、调优并运行。它支持 Apple Silicon、NVIDIA、AMD，甚至纯 CPU，并能让现有 AI 代理一键接入。
zh.content: 仓库提供桌面应用（含内置 magnitude CLI），包含模型发现、硬件分析、连接管理等功能模块，以及品牌资源和文档链接。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，依赖本地推理运行时与硬件探测库，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 多平台。
zh.hot: 本月新增 3303 星，总星数达 4771，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 12 名，反映出开发者对本地、私密、免 token 成本 AI 运行的强烈需求。
uses: 想在本地跑大模型但不确定硬件能跑什么的普通用户
注重隐私、希望离线使用 AI 代理的开发者
需要为团队统一部署本地推理环境的工程师
想低成本试验多种开源模型的 AI 爱好者

en.tag: An inference engine that auto-picks and runs the best local models for your hardware
en.what: Magnitude is an open source inference engine optimized for consumer hardware. It profiles your machine, recommends the best models for it, then downloads, tunes, and runs them, with one-click connection to the agent you already use.
en.content: The repo ships a desktop app (bundling the magnitude CLI) with modules for model discovery, hardware profiling, and agent connections, plus brand assets and docs links.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, relying on local inference runtimes and hardware-probing libraries, with cross-platform support for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.hot: It gained 3,303 stars this month for a total of 4,771, ranking 12th on GitHub Trending monthly, reflecting strong demand for local, private, token-free AI inference.
uses: Everyday users who want to run LLMs locally but don't know what their hardware can handle
Developers who value privacy and want offline AI agents
Engineers needing a unified local inference setup for their team
AI enthusiasts experimenting with open models on a budget

zh.tag: 用 Apple 虚拟化框架在 Mac 上启动虚拟 iPhone 的命令行工具
zh.what: vphone-cli 是一个 Swift 编写的命令行工具，借助 Apple 的 Virtualization.framework 和 PCC 研究用虚拟机基础设施，在 Apple Silicon Mac 上创建并启动虚拟 iPhone。它把下载固件、打补丁、DFU 恢复、安装自定义固件到首次开机整合成一条命令。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 主程序、跨平台编译的 guest 守护进程 vphoned、工具链安装与构建脚本（scripts/setup_tools.sh、build.sh），以及多语言 README 和演示截图。
zh.stack: 基于 Swift 与 Apple Virtualization.framework，依赖 Xcode/iOS SDK，并需要 python@3.13、aria2、openssl@3、ldid-procursus、keystone、libusb、ipsw 等通过 Homebrew 安装的工具。
zh.hot: 本月新增 6183 star，总 star 近 1.4 万，冲上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 12 名；在 Mac 上跑虚拟 iPhone 并支持越狱固件变体，对 iOS 安全研究和逆向社区极具吸引力。
uses: iOS 安全研究者，用于在隔离虚拟机中分析系统与固件
逆向工程师，需要可复现的越狱 iPhone 环境
开发者在 Mac 上测试 iOS 应用与设备行为
对 Apple 虚拟化与 PCC 基础设施感兴趣的技术爱好者

en.tag: CLI tool that boots a virtual iPhone on Mac via Apple's Virtualization.framework
en.what: vphone-cli is a Swift command-line tool that creates and boots a virtual iPhone on Apple Silicon Macs using Apple's Virtualization.framework and PCC research VM infrastructure. It bundles firmware download, patching, DFU restore, custom firmware install and first boot into a single command.
en.content: The repo ships the CLI app, a cross-compiled guest daemon called vphoned, toolchain setup and build scripts (scripts/setup_tools.sh, build.sh), plus multilingual READMEs and a demo screenshot.
en.stack: Built on Swift and Apple's Virtualization.framework, requiring Xcode/iOS SDK and Homebrew tools such as python@3.13, aria2, openssl@3, ldid-procursus, keystone, libusb and ipsw.
en.hot: It gained 6,183 stars this month for a total near 14k, ranking 12th on GitHub Trending monthly; running a virtual iPhone on Mac with jailbreak firmware variants strongly appeals to iOS security and reverse-engineering communities.
uses: iOS security researchers analyzing systems and firmware in isolated VMs
Reverse engineers needing a reproducible jailbroken iPhone environment
Developers testing iOS apps and device behavior on a Mac
Enthusiasts curious about Apple virtualization and PCC infrastructure

zh.tag: 让 AI 编码代理写出地道现代 Go 代码的官方规范集
zh.what: 这是 JetBrains 官方维护的一套指南，专门提供给 AI 编码代理使用，帮助它们生成符合现代 Go 习惯的代码。它会自动读取项目 go.mod 中的 Go 版本，只使用该版本及之前可用的语言特性和标准库，并优先选择新式写法而非旧模式。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 Markdown 指南文档，核心是 FEATURES.md，按 Go 1.0 到 1.27 逐版本列出可用特性与示例；同时提供 Junie、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等代理的安装说明，以及一个通过 go install 安装的小型 CLI。
zh.stack: 内容以 Go 语言特性与标准库演进为主，配套工具是 Go 编写的 CLI，要求 Go 1.25 及以上工具链，并支持 GOTOOLCHAIN=auto 自动切换。
zh.hot: AI 编码代理普遍生成过时 Go 代码，这套官方规范直接解决训练数据滞后和频率偏差两大痛点，本月新增 2858 星、总星 3700，冲上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 12 名。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 或 Junie 写 Go 的开发者，希望代理输出更现代的代码
维护大型 Go 项目、想统一代码风格并减少后期 modernize 修复成本的团队
研究 AI 代理提示词工程与代码生成质量提升的技术人员

en.tag: Official guidelines that teach AI coding agents to write modern Go
en.what: This is an official JetBrains-maintained guideline set for AI coding agents, helping them generate idiomatic modern Go code. It detects the project's Go version from go.mod, uses only features available up to that version, and prefers modern idioms over older patterns.
en.content: The repo is mainly Markdown guidance, centered on FEATURES.md listing features and examples from Go 1.0 through 1.27; it also includes setup instructions for Junie, Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, plus a small CLI installed via go install.
en.stack: It focuses on Go language and standard library evolution, with a Go-based CLI requiring Go 1.25+ and supporting GOTOOLCHAIN=auto for automatic toolchain switching.
en.hot: AI coding agents commonly produce outdated Go; these official guidelines directly address training-data lag and frequency bias, gaining 2,858 stars this month (3,700 total) and ranking #12 on GitHub Trending monthly.
uses: Go developers using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Junie who want agents to output more modern code
Teams maintaining large Go projects wanting consistent style and less later modernize cleanup
Engineers researching prompt engineering and code-generation quality for AI agents

zh.tag: 为专业 AI 编程代理打造的安全验证技能注册表
zh.what: 这是一个面向 AI 编程代理的技能注册表，提供经过验证、测试且安全的能力包，用于扩展 Antigravity、Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等工具。它针对市面上超过 13% 的技能存在严重漏洞的问题，主打安全可信。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能包集合、MCP 服务器实现、文档站点以及贡献指南，以 TypeScript 编写的 CLI 和库形式发布到 npm。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript（100%）和 Node.js（>=22），使用 Nx Cloud 进行构建，采用 semantic-release 管理版本，并发布为 npm 包 @tech-leads-club/agent-skills。
zh.hot: 项目今日新增 265 星，总星数达 5658，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 4 名，反映出开发者对 AI 代理技能安全性的高度关注。
uses: AI 编程代理用户，希望安全地扩展 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具的能力
开发团队，需要为内部 AI 代理引入经过验证的技能包
安全工程师，关注 AI 技能供应链漏洞并寻求可信来源
技能贡献者，想要发布和维护经过审核的代理技能

en.tag: The secure, validated skill registry for professional AI coding agents
en.what: This is a skill registry for AI coding agents, offering verified, tested, and safe capability packages to extend tools like Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot. It addresses the fact that over 13% of marketplace skills contain critical vulnerabilities, focusing on security and trust.
en.content: The repo contains a collection of skill packages, an MCP server implementation, documentation site, and contribution guidelines, published to npm as a TypeScript CLI and library.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript (100%) and Node.js (>=22), using Nx Cloud for builds, semantic-release for versioning, and published as the npm package @tech-leads-club/agent-skills.
en.hot: It gained 265 stars today, reaching 5,658 total and ranking 4th on GitHub Trending daily, reflecting strong developer interest in the security of AI agent skills.
uses: AI coding agent users who want to safely extend tools like Claude Code and Cursor
Development teams needing verified skill packages for internal AI agents
Security engineers concerned about AI skill supply chain vulnerabilities and seeking trusted sources
Skill contributors who want to publish and maintain vetted agent skills

zh.tag: Google 时序预测基础模型，支持多变量与协变量
zh.what: TimesFM 是 Google Research 开发的预训练时序基础模型，用于时间序列预测。它采用 decoder-only 架构，在大量时序数据上预训练，能够进行零样本预测。最新 3.0 版本支持原生多变量预测和协变量，并在多个基准上排名第一。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型源码、预训练权重（Hugging Face）、示例和文档。代码结构分版本管理，最新 3.0 在根目录，旧版本归档在 v1 子目录。
zh.stack: 基于 PyTorch 实现，依赖 Hugging Face Transformers 等。提供 pip 包安装，支持 Python。
zh.hot: 近期发布 3.0 版本，带来多变量预测和协变量支持，在三大基准上排名第一，引发社区关注。今日新增 1618 star，总星标超 3 万。
uses: 时间序列预测研究者：用于零样本预测和模型对比实验
数据科学家：快速进行多变量预测，无需大量训练数据
企业应用开发者：集成到 BigQuery ML 或 Vertex AI 进行规模化预测

en.tag: Google's pretrained time-series foundation model for forecasting, with multivariate & covariate support
en.what: TimesFM is a pretrained time-series foundation model by Google Research for time-series forecasting. It uses a decoder-only architecture pretrained on diverse time-series data, enabling zero-shot forecasting. The latest 3.0 version natively supports multivariate forecasting and covariates, ranking #1 on multiple benchmarks.
en.content: The repo contains model source code, pretrained weights (on Hugging Face), examples, and docs. Code is organized by version; latest 3.0 is at root, older versions archived under v1.
en.stack: Implemented in PyTorch, leveraging Hugging Face Transformers. Installable via pip, Python-based.
en.hot: The recent 3.0 release with native multivariate forecasting and covariates, achieving #1 on three major benchmarks, has sparked interest. Gained 1,618 stars today, total over 30k.
uses: Time-series researchers: for zero-shot forecasting and model benchmarking
Data scientists: for quick multivariate forecasting without extensive training data
Enterprise developers: integrating with BigQuery ML or Vertex AI for scalable forecasting

zh.tag: 2小时从零训练64M超小语言模型，全流程开源教程
zh.what: MiniMind 是一个从零开始训练超小语言模型（64M参数）的开源项目，仅需3块钱成本和2小时即可在单张消费级GPU上完成训练。项目覆盖从数据清洗、预训练到SFT、RLHF、Agentic RL等完整链路，并扩展了视觉、多模态等变体。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的训练代码、模型结构定义、数据预处理脚本、训练教程和多个模型变体（如MiniMind-V、MiniMind-O）。所有核心算法均用PyTorch原生实现，不依赖高层封装库。
zh.stack: 基于Python和PyTorch，从零实现Transformer、MoE、LoRA、DPO、PPO等算法，不依赖transformers/trl等库。
zh.hot: 以极低成本（3元/2小时）训练LLM的颠覆性理念，加上全流程开源和教程性质，吸引了大量希望深入理解LLM的开发者。56k星标和日增近500星，说明其精准切中了个人开发者复现大模型的需求。
uses: LLM初学者：通过从零实现和训练，深入理解大模型内部机制，而非仅使用现成库。
个人开发者/研究者：在消费级GPU上快速实验预训练、微调、RLHF等全流程。
教育场景：作为高校或培训机构的AI课程实战项目，低成本复现前沿技术。
对模型压缩和高效训练感兴趣者：探索64M小模型的性能边界和扩展方向。

en.tag: Train a 64M LLM from scratch in 2h with full pipeline, open-source tutorial
en.what: MiniMind is an open-source project to train a tiny 64M-parameter LLM from scratch, costing only $0.4 and 2 hours on a single consumer GPU. It covers the full pipeline from data cleaning, pretraining to SFT, RLHF, Agentic RL, and extends to vision and multimodal variants.
en.content: The repo contains full training code, model architecture definitions, data preprocessing scripts, tutorials, and several model variants (e.g., MiniMind-V, MiniMind-O). All core algorithms are implemented natively in PyTorch without high-level wrappers.
en.stack: Built with Python and PyTorch, implementing Transformer, MoE, LoRA, DPO, PPO from scratch, without relying on libraries like transformers/trl.
en.hot: The disruptive idea of training an LLM for just $0.4 and 2 hours, combined with full open-source pipeline and tutorial nature, attracts developers eager to understand LLMs deeply. With 56k stars and ~500 daily additions, it hits the need for personal reproduction of LLMs.
uses: LLM beginners: gain deep understanding of LLM internals by implementing and training from scratch, not just using off-the-shelf libraries.
Individual developers/researchers: quickly experiment with pretraining, fine-tuning, RLHF on consumer GPUs.
Educational settings: as a hands-on project for AI courses, reproducing cutting-edge techniques at low cost.
Those interested in model compression and efficient training: explore the performance limits of 64M small models.

zh.tag: 开源自托管 AI 销售 CRM，原生 AI 代理接管 WhatsApp 聊天
zh.what: DeskcommCRM 是一个开源的 AI 销售操作系统，把能接待、筛选并促成成交的 AI 代理直接嵌进 CRM，通过 WhatsApp（WAHA）与客户对话。它是 Kommo、Octadesk、Intercom 的开源替代品，数据自持、无月费、无功能锁。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Next.js 应用主体、WAHA 的 WhatsApp 集成、Supabase 数据库与认证、多租户与 LGPD 合规逻辑，以及 hostgator-setup-kit 一键部署脚本和架构/路线图文档。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 TypeScript（strict）+ Next.js 16，后端依赖 Supabase（Postgres、Auth、Storage），WhatsApp 通道使用 WAHA，支持 MCP、多租户与自托管部署。
zh.hot: 上线不久即冲到 GitHub Trending 日榜第 4，今日新增 152 star、总数 1347，说明拉美市场对「开源 + WhatsApp 原生 AI 销售」的需求被长期压抑。
uses: 通过 WhatsApp 成交的中小企业与销售团队，想摆脱 Kommo/Octadesk 的月费与功能锁定
需要数据主权与 LGPD 合规、希望把 CRM 跑在自己 VPS 上的巴西及拉美公司
想给现有销售流程加 AI 代理、并接入 MCP 生态的开发者与集成商
寻找 Intercom 开源替代、重视自托管与多租户能力的 SaaS 团队

en.tag: Open-source self-hosted AI sales CRM with native AI agents on WhatsApp
en.what: DeskcommCRM is an open-source AI sales OS that embeds AI agents capable of greeting, qualifying and closing deals directly inside a CRM, conversing with customers over WhatsApp (WAHA). It positions itself as the open alternative to Kommo, Octadesk and Intercom, with self-owned data, no monthly fees and no locked features.
en.content: The repo contains the Next.js app, WhatsApp integration via WAHA, Supabase database and auth, multi-tenant and LGPD compliance logic, plus a hostgator-setup-kit one-command deploy script and architecture/roadmap docs.
en.stack: Built with strict TypeScript and Next.js 16, backed by Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage), using WAHA for the WhatsApp channel, with MCP support, multi-tenancy and self-hosted deployment.
en.hot: It hit #4 on GitHub Trending with 152 stars added today and 1,347 total, showing pent-up demand in LATAM for an open-source, WhatsApp-native AI sales tool.
uses: SMBs and sales teams closing deals on WhatsApp who want to escape Kommo/Octadesk monthly fees and locked features
Brazilian and LATAM companies needing data sovereignty and LGPD compliance by running the CRM on their own VPS
Developers and integrators adding AI agents to existing sales flows and plugging into the MCP ecosystem
SaaS teams seeking an open-source Intercom alternative with self-hosting and multi-tenancy

zh.tag: DHH 打造的精致现代 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Omarchy 是一个由 DHH（Ruby on Rails 创始人）打造的 Linux 发行版，注重美观、现代和明确的观点。它提供了一套完整的桌面环境，包括终端、编辑器、AI 工具等，并配有详尽的用户手册。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 manual/ 目录，内含 51 篇 Markdown 格式的手册章节，涵盖入门、导航、应用、配置等主题。此外还有安装脚本和配置文件，用于构建和定制系统。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Shell 脚本进行系统配置和安装，依赖 Linux 生态中的各种开源工具（如 Neovim、终端模拟器等）。手册使用 Markdown 编写，并托管在 learn.omacom.io。
zh.hot: 凭借 DHH 的知名度和对美观、现代体验的强调，Omarchy 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 6475 星，总星数达 34824，登上趋势榜第三。
uses: 喜欢 DHH 风格、追求开箱即用且美观的 Linux 桌面用户
希望从 Mac/Windows 迁移到 Linux 并希望有完整指南的用户
对 Linux 发行版定制和配置感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: A beautiful, modern & opinionated Linux distro by DHH
en.what: Omarchy is a Linux distribution created by DHH (creator of Ruby on Rails), focusing on beauty, modernity, and strong opinions. It provides a complete desktop environment including terminal, editor, AI tools, and comes with an extensive user manual.
en.content: The repository contains a manual/ directory with 51 Markdown chapters covering topics like getting started, navigation, applications, and configuration. It also includes installation scripts and configuration files for building and customizing the system.
en.stack: Primarily uses Shell scripts for system configuration and installation, relying on various open-source tools from the Linux ecosystem (e.g., Neovim, terminal emulators). The manual is written in Markdown and hosted on learn.omacom.io.
en.hot: Thanks to DHH's fame and the emphasis on beautiful, modern experience, Omarchy quickly gained popularity on GitHub, adding 6,475 stars this week to reach 34,824 total, ranking #3 on the trending list.
uses: Linux desktop users who appreciate DHH's style and want a beautiful, out-of-the-box experience
Users migrating from Mac/Windows to Linux who want a comprehensive guide
Developers interested in customizing and configuring a Linux distribution

zh.tag: 开源企业级业务管理平台，集 ERP、CRM、HRM、ATS 与项目管理于一体
zh.what: Ever Gauzy 是一个面向协作、按需和共享经济的开源业务管理平台，提供企业资源规划（ERP）、客户关系管理（CRM）、人力资源管理（HRM）、招聘跟踪（ATS）以及工作与项目管理（PM）等核心功能。它旨在帮助企业在一个统一的系统中管理财务、销售、库存、员工和项目等关键业务流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台源代码，主要使用 TypeScript 编写，提供无头 API、仪表盘、时间跟踪、员工管理、招聘、销售管道、会计发票等模块。还包括详细的文档和部署指南，支持 Gitpod 在线开发。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 TypeScript 为主，基于 Node.js 和 NestJS 构建后端，前端可能使用 Angular 或 React，数据库支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL 等，并采用 AGPL v3 许可证。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 191 颗星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 2 名，总星数达 5084，表明其作为开源 ERP/CRM 替代方案正受到广泛关注。
uses: 中小企业寻求开源 ERP/CRM 解决方案以降低软件成本
开发团队需要可定制、可扩展的业务管理平台进行二次开发
人力资源和招聘团队希望集成 ATS 和员工管理功能
项目管理和咨询公司需要时间跟踪与项目协作工具

en.tag: Open business management platform combining ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS and project management
en.what: Ever Gauzy is an open business management platform for collaborative, on-demand and sharing economies, offering Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Human Resource Management (HRM), Applicant Tracking System (ATS), and Work and Project Management (PM). It aims to help businesses manage key processes like finance, sales, inventory, employees, and projects in one unified system.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform source code, primarily written in TypeScript, offering headless APIs, dashboards, time tracking, employee management, ATS, sales pipelines, accounting/invoicing modules, and more. It also includes detailed documentation and deployment guides, with Gitpod support for online development.
en.stack: The tech stack is primarily TypeScript, with a Node.js and NestJS backend, possibly Angular or React frontend, and support for databases like PostgreSQL and MySQL, under the AGPL v3 license.
en.hot: The project gained 191 stars today, ranking 2nd on GitHub Trending daily list, with a total of 5,084 stars, indicating growing attention as an open-source ERP/CRM alternative.
uses: Small and medium businesses seeking open-source ERP/CRM solutions to reduce software costs
Development teams needing a customizable and extensible business management platform for secondary development
HR and recruitment teams looking to integrate ATS and employee management features
Project management and consulting firms requiring time tracking and project collaboration tools

zh.tag: 把任意 AI 代理变成科学家的技能库，覆盖生物、化学、医学等 163 个技能
zh.what: 这是一个开源的科学 Agent 技能库，提供 163 个即用型技能和 100+ 科学数据库，覆盖生物学、化学、医学和药物发现。它兼容 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 代理，并遵循开放的 Agent Skills 标准，让任何 AI 代理都能执行科学任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、测试用例、文档和示例，以及一个可选的本地 AI 协同科学家工具 K-Dense BYOK。技能以标准格式组织，便于集成和扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Agent Skills 标准，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 3.47 万星标和 17.5 万科学家用户，它填补了 AI 代理在科学领域应用的空白，成为最受欢迎的科学技能库。
uses: 科研人员：快速让 AI 代理执行文献分析、实验设计等任务。
开发者：为 AI 代理集成科学技能，构建垂直领域应用。
教育者：在教学中使用 AI 辅助科学探索，提升学生参与度。

en.tag: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist with 163 validated skills and 100+ scientific databases.
en.what: An open-source library of scientific Agent Skills, offering 163 ready-to-use skills and 100+ scientific databases across biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. It works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and other AI agents, following the open Agent Skills standard, enabling any agent to perform scientific tasks.
en.content: The repo contains skill definitions, tests, documentation, examples, and an optional local AI co-scientist tool K-Dense BYOK. Skills are organized in a standard format for easy integration and extension.
en.stack: Primarily Python-based, relying on the Agent Skills standard, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 34.7k stars and 175k+ scientist users, it fills a gap in AI agent applications for science, becoming the most popular scientific skills library.
uses: Researchers: quickly enable AI agents to perform literature analysis, experiment design, etc.
Developers: integrate scientific skills into AI agents to build domain-specific applications.
Educators: use AI-assisted scientific exploration in teaching to boost student engagement.

zh.tag: 全自动去除语言模型审查的优化工具
zh.what: Heretic 是一个无需昂贵后训练即可移除 Transformer 语言模型审查（安全对齐）的工具。它结合方向消融（abliteration）与基于 TPE 的参数优化器，自动寻找高质量消融参数，同时最小化拒绝次数和与原始模型的 KL 散度，从而保留模型智能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 实现、命令行界面、自动优化流程、支持多种模型架构（稠密、MoE、混合如 Qwen3.5），并提供示例配置和基准测试结果。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch、Transformers、Optuna（TPE 优化器）等，实现方向消融和参数优化。
zh.hot: 2.87 万星标，日增 150，登上日榜第 6。它让非专家也能一键去除模型审查，且效果媲美人工调优，引发广泛关注。
uses: AI 研究人员和开发者，希望快速去除模型审查而不损失性能。
对模型安全对齐机制感兴趣，想探索方向消融技术的实践者。
需要定制模型行为、去除内容限制的普通用户，无需深入理解内部原理。

en.tag: Fully automatic censorship removal for language models via TPE-based optimization
en.what: Heretic is a tool that removes censorship (safety alignment) from transformer-based language models without expensive post-training. It combines directional ablation (abliteration) with a TPE-based parameter optimizer to automatically find high-quality parameters that minimize refusals and KL divergence from the original model, preserving intelligence.
en.content: The repository contains a full Python implementation, CLI, automatic optimization pipeline, support for dense, MoE, and hybrid models (e.g., Qwen3.5), along with example configs and benchmark results.
en.stack: Built with Python, leveraging PyTorch, Transformers, and Optuna for TPE-based optimization, implementing directional ablation.
en.hot: With 28.7k stars and +150 daily, ranking #6 on the daily trend, it enables non-experts to decensor models with one command, rivaling manual abliteration, sparking wide interest.
uses: AI researchers and developers seeking to remove model censorship quickly without performance loss.
Practitioners interested in safety alignment mechanisms and directional ablation techniques.
General users who need to customize model behavior or remove content restrictions without deep technical knowledge.

zh.tag: 截图秒变前端代码的AI工具
zh.what: 这是一个利用AI将截图、设计稿、Figma设计甚至屏幕录制转换为干净、可运行的前端代码（如HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue）的工具。用户只需上传图片或录制视频，即可获得对应的功能原型或代码实现。
zh.content: 仓库包含React/Vite前端和FastAPI后端，支持多种技术栈（HTML+Tailwind、React+Tailwind、Vue+Tailwind等），并集成多个AI模型（如Gemini、GPT、Claude）用于代码生成和图像处理。
zh.stack: 主要使用Python（FastAPI）作为后端，前端采用React/Vite，依赖OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini等AI模型API，以及Replicate用于图像生成和编辑。
zh.hot: 凭借75.5K星标和今日新增326星，该工具因其直观的“截图转代码”功能而广受欢迎，大幅降低了前端开发门槛，尤其适合快速原型制作。
uses: 前端开发者快速将设计稿或截图转化为可用的HTML/CSS/React代码
产品经理或设计师验证UI概念，无需手动编写代码
教育场景中教学前端开发，通过示例直观展示代码生成

en.tag: Turn screenshots into clean frontend code with AI
en.what: This is a tool that uses AI to convert screenshots, mockups, Figma designs, and even screen recordings into clean, functional frontend code (e.g., HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue). Users upload an image or recording and get a working prototype or code implementation.
en.content: The repo includes a React/Vite frontend and a FastAPI backend, supporting multiple stacks (HTML+Tailwind, React+Tailwind, Vue+Tailwind, etc.) and integrating several AI models (e.g., Gemini, GPT, Claude) for code generation and image processing.
en.stack: Primarily Python (FastAPI) backend with React/Vite frontend, relying on AI model APIs from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Replicate for image generation/editing.
en.hot: With 75.5K stars and +326 today, this tool is popular for its intuitive 'screenshot-to-code' capability, significantly lowering the barrier for frontend development, especially for rapid prototyping.
uses: Frontend developers quickly convert design mockups or screenshots into usable HTML/CSS/React code
Product managers or designers validate UI concepts without manually writing code
Educational settings for teaching frontend development by visually demonstrating code generation

zh.tag: 抖音批量下载工具，去水印，支持视频、图集、合集与音乐
zh.what: 这是一个抖音内容批量下载工具，支持单条链接下载和作者主页批量抓取，可保存视频、图集、合集、收藏夹以及原声音乐。内置进度显示、失败重试、SQLite 去重和下载完整性校验，并提供浏览器回退方案应对反爬。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 脚本为主体，包含中英文 README、命令行入口与配置示例，另有基于同一后端的桌面 GUI「Douzy」截图与 Releases 构建，覆盖抖音、TikTok、YouTube 三个平台的工作区。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，依赖 requests 等 HTTP 库与 SQLite 做去重记录，并通过浏览器回退机制处理登录与风控；桌面端为同一后端的 GUI 封装。
zh.hot: 抖音内容存档需求旺盛，加上去水印与批量下载的实用定位，项目已积累 11363 颗星，今日新增 452 星并冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 17 名。
uses: 需要批量备份自己或他人抖音作品的普通用户
做短视频素材收集与二次创作的内容创作者
研究爬虫、反爬与浏览器回退方案的技术学习者
希望本地归档抖音收藏、喜欢与合集的重度用户

en.tag: A practical Douyin batch downloader with watermark removal for videos, galleries, collections and music
en.what: This is a practical Douyin downloader that handles both single-item and profile batch downloads, saving videos, image-notes, collections, favorites and original music. It ships with progress display, retries, SQLite deduplication, download integrity checks and a browser fallback for anti-bot scenarios.

Heavy Douyin users archiving favorites, likes and collections locally

en.what: An MCP server that gives AI agents and LLMs a unified interface for mobile automation across iOS and Android, without needing platform-specific expertise. It drives emulators, simulators, and real devices via structured accessibility snapshots or screenshot-based coordinate taps.

AI agent developers: add mobile operation capabilities to agent frameworks for multi-step user journeys

Cloud device testers: run the same tools against real iOS/Android devices in the cloud via Mobile Next Cloud

zh.tag: TypeScript 优先的 schema 校验库，静态类型推断
zh.what: Zod 是一个 TypeScript 优先的数据校验库，通过定义 schema 来解析并验证数据，返回强类型的结果。它让运行时校验与编译期类型推断合二为一，避免手写重复的类型定义。

zh.hot: 作为 TS 生态最流行的校验方案，Zod 已获 44k+ star，本月再增 547，持续稳居 GitHub Trending TypeScript 月榜第 15 名。
uses: 前端/全栈 TypeScript 开发者，用于表单与 API 数据校验
Node.js 后端工程师，校验请求体、环境变量与配置

en.what: Zod is a TypeScript-first validation library that parses and validates data against a defined schema, returning a strongly typed result. It unifies runtime validation with compile-time type inference, eliminating duplicated type definitions.

en.stack: Written in pure TypeScript with zero external dependencies, runs in Node.js and all modern browsers, with a ~2kb gzipped core bundle.

Node.js backend engineers validating request bodies, env vars and configs
Teams needing JSON Schema or OpenAPI generation from schemas
Projects wanting runtime validation and static types from a single definition

zh.tag: 无虚拟 DOM 的细粒度响应式前端框架
zh.what: Solid 是一个用于构建用户界面的声明式 JavaScript 库，它不使用虚拟 DOM，而是把模板编译成真实 DOM 节点，并通过细粒度响应式更新。状态变化时，只有依赖该状态的代码会重新执行。
zh.content: 仓库是 Solid 核心库的 monorepo，包含 solid-js 运行时、solid-js/web 渲染器、服务端渲染与测试等子包，并配有官网、API 文档和在线 Playground。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，基于 JSX 编译与响应式原语（createSignal 等），通过 npm 发布 solid-js 包，并接入 GitHub Actions 与 Coveralls 做 CI 和覆盖率。
zh.hot: 作为 React 的轻量高性能替代方案，Solid 长期受到前端社区关注，已积累 36074 颗星，本月新增 220 颗，位列 GitHub Trending TypeScript 月榜第 16 名。
uses: 追求极致运行时性能、想避开虚拟 DOM 开销的前端开发者
熟悉 React/JSX 但希望更细粒度响应式更新的团队
需要轻量框架构建交互式 Web 应用或组件的工程师
关注前端框架设计、想学习响应式编译原理的技术爱好者

en.tag: A declarative, efficient JS library with no virtual DOM and fine-grained reactivity
en.what: Solid is a declarative JavaScript library for building user interfaces that skips the virtual DOM, compiling templates into real DOM nodes updated by fine-grained reactions. When a piece of state changes, only the code depending on it reruns.
en.content: The repo is the monorepo for Solid's core, containing the solid-js runtime, the solid-js/web renderer, SSR and testing subpackages, plus links to the website, API docs and an online playground.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript, it relies on JSX compilation and reactive primitives like createSignal, ships as the solid-js npm package, and uses GitHub Actions and Coveralls for CI and coverage.
en.hot: As a lightweight, high-performance alternative to React, Solid has long drawn frontend community attention, reaching 36,074 stars with 220 added this month, ranking 16th on GitHub Trending's monthly TypeScript list.
uses: Frontend developers chasing top runtime performance and avoiding virtual DOM overhead
Teams familiar with React/JSX that want finer-grained reactive updates
Engineers building interactive web apps or components with a lightweight framework
Framework enthusiasts curious about reactive compilation design

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理像最懒的高级工程师一样写最少代码
zh.what: Ponytail 是一个 JavaScript 库/技能包，注入到 AI 代理中，使其倾向于生成极简代码，避免过度工程。它通过内置的“懒人”提示和规则，让代理在实现功能时优先使用浏览器原生能力或现有依赖，从而大幅减少代码量、成本和延迟。

zh.stack: 主要语言是 JavaScript，通过 npm 分发，兼容多种 AI 代理（如 Claude Code）。依赖较少，核心是提示词工程。
zh.hot: 11 万星且日增近千，因为直击 AI 编程痛点：过度工程。它用幽默的“懒人”形象，承诺减少代码量、成本和延迟，且保持安全，引发开发者共鸣。
uses: AI 编程工具使用者：希望减少 AI 生成的冗余代码，提升代码质量。
团队技术负责人：想降低维护成本，让 AI 代理产出更简洁的代码。
对提示工程感兴趣者：学习如何通过提示词约束 AI 行为。

en.tag: Makes your AI agent write minimal code like a lazy senior dev
en.what: Ponytail is a JavaScript library/skill pack that injects a 'lazy senior dev' mindset into AI agents, pushing them to write minimal code and avoid over-engineering. It uses built-in prompts and rules to make agents prefer native browser features or existing dependencies, cutting code volume, cost, and latency.
en.content: The repo contains the core library, CLI tools, benchmark scripts, and docs. The core is a set of prompts and rules injected into agents, supporting 20+ agents; benchmarks show code reduction (mean 54%, up to 94%) on real repos.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, distributed via npm, compatible with 20+ AI agents (e.g., Claude Code). Minimal dependencies, core is prompt engineering.
en.hot: 111k stars with ~1k daily, because it hits the pain point of AI coding: over-engineering. With a humorous 'lazy dev' persona, it promises less code, lower cost, and faster execution while staying safe, resonating with developers.
uses: AI coding tool users: want to reduce redundant code and improve code quality.
Tech leads: aim to lower maintenance costs and get cleaner code from AI agents.
Prompt engineering enthusiasts: learn how to constrain AI behavior via prompts.

zh.tag: 为AI代理打造的隐身无头浏览器，绕过反爬检测

zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript 和 Node.js，核心引擎是 Camoufox（Firefox 的 C++ 级补丁），通过 REST API 暴露功能。依赖 npm 生态，支持跨平台运行。
zh.hot: 在 AI 代理需要访问真实网页但常被反爬拦截的背景下，该仓库提供了有效的解决方案，今日新增 117 星，总星数达 9236，登上 JavaScript 趋势榜第六。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要让代理访问受保护网站（如搜索、社交媒体）时，可集成此浏览器绕过检测。
数据采集工程师：用于爬取 Cloudflare 保护的网站，替代易被识别的无头浏览器。
自动化测试人员：作为 Puppeteer/Playwright 的替代，进行需要真实浏览器指纹的测试。

en.tag: Stealth headless browser for AI agents, bypassing bot detection
en.what: camofox-browser is an anti-detection browser server for AI agents, built on Camoufox (a Firefox fork). It bypasses Cloudflare and bot detection via C++-level fingerprint spoofing, and offers a REST API for agents, serving as a drop-in replacement for Puppeteer/Playwright.
en.content: The repository contains a full browser server implementation with REST API, element refs, session isolation, cookie import, file upload, proxy support, and more. It includes startup scripts and an npm package for easy integration.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript and Node.js, powered by Camoufox (a C++-patched Firefox fork), exposing functionality via REST API. Leverages npm ecosystem and runs cross-platform.
en.hot: With AI agents needing to browse real websites but often blocked by anti-bot measures, this repo offers a working solution, gaining 117 stars today and reaching 9236 total, ranking #6 on the JavaScript trending list.
uses: AI agent developers: integrate this browser to access protected sites (e.g., search, social media) while bypassing detection.
Data scraping engineers: use it to crawl Cloudflare-protected websites, replacing easily fingerprintable headless browsers.
Automation testers: as a drop-in replacement for Puppeteer/Playwright for tests requiring real browser fingerprints.
Personal AI assistant projects: like jo, needing a stable, low-memory browser backend.

zh.tag: 隐私优先的跨平台语音转文字听写应用
zh.what: OpenWhispr 是一款开源的语音转文字听写应用，支持本地离线模型（如 Whisper、NVIDIA Parakeet）和云端模型（自带密钥），确保音频数据不离开设备。它提供热键唤起、光标处插入文本、会议转录和笔记功能，是 WisprFlow 和 Granola 的免费替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，覆盖 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 平台，提供安装包（DMG、EXE、AppImage 等）。项目包含前端界面、语音引擎集成、系统托盘、热键监听等模块，并配有文档和 API 参考。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，可能基于 Electron 或类似框架构建跨平台桌面应用。语音识别依赖本地引擎（如 Whisper、NVIDIA Parakeet）和 ONNX Runtime，支持云端 API 集成。
zh.hot: 凭借隐私优先和跨平台特性，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获近 6000 星，今日新增 50 星，位列 JavaScript 日榜第五。作为商业产品的开源替代，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 需要高效语音输入的文字工作者，如记者、作家、程序员，可用热键快速听写。
注重隐私的用户，希望在本地完成语音转文字，避免音频上传云端。
经常开会的人士，利用会议转录功能自动生成笔记和行动项。
开发者或技术爱好者，可自定义模型或集成自有 API 密钥。

en.tag: Privacy-first cross-platform voice-to-text dictation app
en.what: OpenWhispr is an open-source voice-to-text dictation app supporting local offline models (e.g., Whisper, NVIDIA Parakeet) and cloud models (bring your own key), ensuring audio data never leaves the device. It offers hotkey activation, text insertion at cursor, meeting transcription, and note-taking, serving as a free alternative to WisprFlow and Granola.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the desktop app, covering macOS, Windows, and Linux, with installers (DMG, EXE, AppImage, etc.). It includes frontend UI, speech engine integration, system tray, hotkey listener, and is accompanied by docs and API reference.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, likely built with Electron or similar cross-platform framework. Speech recognition relies on local engines (e.g., Whisper, NVIDIA Parakeet) and ONNX Runtime, with cloud API integration.
en.hot: Rapidly gaining popularity on GitHub due to privacy-first and cross-platform features, amassing nearly 6k stars with 50 new stars today, ranking 5th on the JavaScript daily trending. As an open-source alternative to commercial products, it attracts significant attention.
uses: For writers, journalists, and programmers who need efficient voice input with hotkey dictation.
For privacy-conscious users who want on-device speech-to-text without uploading audio to the cloud.
For frequent meeting attendees who use transcription to auto-generate notes and action items.
For developers and tech enthusiasts who can customize models or integrate their own API keys.

zh.tag: 免费领取高颜值 .is-a.dev 子域名的开源注册服务
zh.what: is-a.dev 是一个面向开发者的免费子域名服务，任何人都可以为自己搭建的个人网站、博客或项目申请一个简洁好看的 .is-a.dev 子域名。申请者通过向仓库提交 Pull Request 来登记自己的 DNS 记录，合并后几分钟内即可生效。

预算有限但希望拥有专业感网址的学生与开源爱好者

想学习 DNS 记录与 GitHub PR 协作流程的新手

en.tag: A free service giving developers a sweet-looking .is-a.dev subdomain
en.what: is-a.dev is a free subdomain service that lets any developer claim a clean, sweet-looking .is-a.dev subdomain for their personal site, blog, or project. You register by opening a pull request with your DNS records, and they go live within minutes of being merged.

uses: Indie developers wanting a clean domain for a personal homepage, blog, or portfolio
Students and open-source hobbyists who want a professional-looking URL on a budget

Beginners learning DNS records and the GitHub PR workflow

zh.hot: htmx 因其极简的编程模型而广受欢迎，让开发者无需编写复杂 JavaScript 即可实现现代交互。尽管今日新增 star 不多（32），但总星数已接近 5 万，反映出其在开发者社区中的持续热度。
uses: 后端开发者希望用简单方式增强 HTML 页面交互，而不想写大量前端 JS
全栈开发者寻求轻量级替代 React/Vue 的方案，用于快速原型或小型项目
喜欢 HATEOAS 和超媒体理念的开发者，希望构建符合 REST 架构的 Web 应用

en.tag: A lightweight library that lets you use AJAX, CSS Transitions, WebSockets and Server Sent Events directly in HTML with attributes
en.what: htmx is a lightweight, dependency-free JavaScript library that allows you to use AJAX, CSS Transitions, WebSockets and Server Sent Events directly in HTML using attributes like hx-post and hx-swap. It aims to simplify building modern user interfaces by extending HTML's hypertext capabilities, enabling dynamic interactions without writing much JavaScript.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of htmx, documentation website, examples, extensions (like ws, sse), and contribution guidelines. The core is a ~14k min.gz'd JavaScript file that can be installed via CDN or npm.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript with no external dependencies. Development dependencies include Node.js and npm for local development and testing.
en.hot: htmx is popular for its minimalist programming model, allowing developers to implement modern interactions without writing complex JavaScript. Although today's new stars are modest (32), the total star count is approaching 50k, reflecting its sustained popularity in the developer community.
uses: Backend developers who want to enhance HTML page interactions in a simple way without writing lots of frontend JS
Full-stack developers seeking a lightweight alternative to React/Vue for quick prototypes or small projects
Developers who embrace HATEOAS and hypermedia principles to build RESTful web applications

zh.tag: Facebook 出品的高性能 CSS-in-JS 样式系统
zh.what: StyleX 是 Facebook 开源的 JavaScript 样式库，用于为大型用户界面定义和优化样式。它通过编译期处理把样式声明转换为原子化 CSS，兼顾开发体验与运行时性能。
zh.content: 这是一个 monorepo，包含核心包 @stylexjs/stylex，以及 babel-plugin、postcss-plugin、rollup-plugin、eslint-plugin、cli、benchmarks 和文档等配套包。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/TypeScript，依赖 Babel、PostCSS、Rollup 等构建工具链，使用 Yarn workspace 管理多包开发。
zh.hot: 作为 Meta 内部大规模验证后开源的方案，它解决了 CSS-in-JS 的运行时开销痛点，本月新增 592 star，总 star 已破万，位列 JavaScript 月榜第 13。
uses: 需要构建大型、可维护前端设计系统的团队
对运行时性能敏感的 React 应用开发者
希望从传统 CSS-in-JS 迁移到编译期方案的工程师
关注原子化 CSS 与类型安全样式的研究者

en.tag: Facebook's high-performance CSS-in-JS styling system
en.what: StyleX is Facebook's open-source JavaScript styling library for defining and optimizing styles for ambitious user interfaces. It compiles style declarations into atomic CSS at build time, balancing developer experience with runtime performance.
en.content: It's a monorepo containing the core @stylexjs/stylex package plus babel-plugin, postcss-plugin, rollup-plugin, eslint-plugin, cli, benchmarks, and docs packages.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/TypeScript with Babel, PostCSS, and Rollup tooling, managed as a Yarn workspace monorepo.
en.hot: Open-sourced after large-scale internal use at Meta, it tackles the runtime overhead of CSS-in-JS; it gained 592 stars this month, surpassing 10k total and ranking 13th on the JavaScript monthly trending list.
uses: Teams building large, maintainable front-end design systems
React developers sensitive to runtime performance
Engineers migrating from traditional CSS-in-JS to a compile-time approach
Researchers interested in atomic CSS and type-safe styling

zh.tag: 让 AI 写作更像人：检测并改写 AI 腔的智能体技能
zh.what: 这是一个可移植的 AI 代理技能，用于审计和重写内容，去除常见的 AI 写作模式（如“Certainly!”、空洞的修饰语等）。它支持重写、检测和原地编辑三种模式，并可选语音风格（casual/professional 等），兼容 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex 等主流代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个可安装的 skill 定义（SKILL.md）、检测引擎（JavaScript 实现）、演示 GIF 和文档。核心是一个规则驱动的检测器，可标记 13 类 AI 写作模式，并执行多轮重写以彻底清除残留。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，采用规则/模式匹配而非机器学习，轻量且可嵌入任何 agentskills.io 兼容的代理。无外部依赖，MIT 许可。
zh.hot: 3,598 星且单日新增 133，登上 JavaScript 趋势榜第 8。AI 生成内容泛滥，开发者急需让输出“去 AI 味”的工具，而它恰好以 agent skill 形式即插即用。
uses: 内容创作者：用 Claude Code 等代理批量改写文章，去除 AI 腔，提升可读性。
开发者：在 CI 或本地用 Detect 模式审计 AI 生成的文档/提交信息，避免机械感。
团队：统一内容风格，通过 voice profile 定制专业、轻松或温暖等语气。
AI 代理开发者：集成此 skill 到自定义代理，增强文本后处理能力。

en.tag: Audit & rewrite AI-sounding text into natural prose, as a portable agent skill
en.what: A portable skill for AI agents that audits and rewrites content to remove common AI writing patterns ('AI-isms'). It offers three modes—rewrite, detect, and edit-in-place—plus optional voice profiles, and works with agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Codex.
en.content: The repo contains a portable skill definition (SKILL.md), a JavaScript-based detection engine, a demo GIF, and docs. The core is a rule-driven detector that flags 13 categories of AI patterns and performs multi-pass rewriting to catch leftovers.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, using rule/pattern matching rather than ML, so it's lightweight and embeddable in any agentskills.io-compatible agent. No external dependencies, MIT licensed.
en.hot: With 3,598 stars and +133 today, it hit #8 on the JavaScript trending list. As AI-generated content floods the web, developers crave tools to make output sound human, and this skill plugs directly into their favorite agents.
uses: Content creators: use with Claude Code to rewrite articles in bulk, removing AI-isms for better readability.
Developers: run Detect mode in CI or locally to audit AI-generated docs/commit messages for robotic tone.
Teams: standardize content tone via voice profiles (casual, professional, warm, etc.).
Agent builders: integrate this skill into custom agents to enhance text post-processing.

zh.tag: 基于 WebGL2/WebGPU 的开源浏览器 3D 游戏引擎
zh.what: PlayCanvas Engine 是一个开源游戏引擎，用于在任意浏览器和设备上创建交互式 3D 应用、游戏与可视化内容。它同时支持 WebGL2、WebGPU、WebXR 和 glTF，让开发者无需插件即可发布跨平台 3D 体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含引擎核心源码（渲染、实体组件系统、物理、动画、资源加载等模块）、示例代码、用户手册与 API 参考文档，并提供中、英、日、韩多语言 README。
zh.stack: 以 JavaScript 编写，可通过 npm 安装（npm install playcanvas），核心依赖 WebGL2/WebGPU 图形 API，并集成 glTF 资源格式与 WebXR 支持。
zh.hot: 凭借 16847 颗星和本月新增 371 星登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 月榜第 15 名，反映出 Web 端 3D 与 WebGPU 生态持续升温，开发者对轻量、免插件的浏览器游戏引擎需求旺盛。
uses: Web 前端与全栈开发者，希望在浏览器中快速构建 3D 游戏或交互应用
游戏与可视化团队，需要免插件、跨设备的 3D 发布方案
AR/VR 开发者，利用 WebXR 打造沉浸式网页体验
教育或产品演示场景，用 3D 交互提升内容表现力

en.tag: Open-source browser 3D game engine built on WebGL2 and WebGPU
en.what: PlayCanvas Engine is an open-source game engine for building interactive 3D apps, games and visualizations that run in any browser on any device. It supports WebGL2, WebGPU, WebXR and glTF, letting developers ship cross-platform 3D experiences without plugins.
en.content: The repo contains the engine's core source (rendering, entity-component system, physics, animation, asset loading), examples, user manual and API reference, plus READMEs in English, Chinese, Japanese and Korean.
en.stack: Written in JavaScript and installable via npm (npm install playcanvas), it relies on WebGL2/WebGPU graphics APIs and integrates glTF asset support and WebXR.
en.hot: With 16,847 stars and 371 added this month, it ranks 15th on GitHub Trending's JavaScript monthly list, reflecting growing demand for lightweight, plugin-free browser game engines amid the WebGPU and web 3D boom.
uses: Web front-end and full-stack developers who want to build 3D games or interactive apps in the browser
Game and visualization teams needing a plugin-free, cross-device 3D publishing solution
AR/VR developers building immersive web experiences with WebXR
Education or product demo scenarios that use 3D interaction to enhance engagement

zh.tag: 自托管监控工具，界面美观，功能强大
zh.what: Uptime Kuma 是一个易于使用的自托管监控工具，用于监控 HTTP(s)、TCP、Ping、DNS 等服务的在线状态。它提供美观、响应式的界面，并支持多种通知方式，如 Telegram、Discord 等。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的监控工具源代码，包括前端界面（Vue.js）、后端服务（Node.js）、Docker 部署配置，以及多语言翻译文件和通知组件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，前端基于 Vue.js，后端使用 Node.js，支持 Docker 部署，并集成了多种通知服务。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 9 万 star，因其自托管、开源免费且功能丰富而广受欢迎，今日新增 51 星，持续活跃。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队自建监控服务，无需依赖第三方平台
需要监控多个网站或 API 并希望自定义通知方式的用户
对数据隐私敏感，希望数据完全掌握在自己手中的用户

en.tag: A fancy self-hosted monitoring tool with a beautiful UI
en.what: Uptime Kuma is an easy-to-use self-hosted monitoring tool for tracking the uptime of HTTP(s), TCP, Ping, DNS, and other services. It features a fancy, reactive UI and supports notifications via Telegram, Discord, and 90+ other services.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the monitoring tool, including the frontend UI (Vue.js), backend service (Node.js), Docker deployment configs, and translation files and notification components.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, with a Vue.js frontend and Node.js backend, Docker deployment support, and integration with numerous notification services.
en.hot: With over 90k stars, it's popular for being self-hosted, open-source, and feature-rich, gaining 51 stars today and remaining highly active.
uses: Individual developers or small teams who want to self-host monitoring without third-party dependencies
Users who need to monitor multiple websites or APIs and want customizable notifications
Users who are privacy-conscious and want full control over their data

zh.tag: 英国 GCHQ 出品的浏览器端网络数据处理瑞士军刀
zh.what: CyberChef 是一个纯浏览器运行的网络数据处理工具，把编码、加密、压缩、哈希、解析等数百种操作组合成可视化「配方」流水线。用户无需编写代码，即可对文本、十六进制、二进制数据做复杂的转换与分析。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心操作库（src/core/operations）、Web 前端界面、Node.js API、CLI 以及完整的测试与构建脚本，可 Docker 部署或从源码构建。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，依赖 Node.js v24 构建，前端基于 Web 技术，提供 Docker 镜像和 npm 包，遵循 Apache 2.0 许可。
zh.hot: 作为 GCHQ 开源的经典安全工具，它凭借 35,944 颗星和本月 331 新增星，持续吸引安全分析师和开发者，位列 JavaScript 月榜第 18 名。
uses: 网络安全分析师用于快速解码、解密和取证分析
CTF 参赛者处理编码、加密和隐写挑战
开发人员调试数据格式与协议解析问题
非技术用户通过可视化界面完成复杂数据转换

en.tag: GCHQ's browser-based Cyber Swiss Army Knife for data manipulation
en.what: CyberChef is a browser-based tool that chains hundreds of cyber operations—encoding, encryption, compression, hashing, parsing—into visual 'recipes'. Users can perform complex data transformations and analysis on text, hex, or binary without writing code.
en.content: The repo contains the core operation library (src/core/operations), the web frontend, a Node.js API, a CLI, plus full test and build scripts, deployable via Docker or from source.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, built with Node.js v24, frontend uses web technologies, ships as a Docker image and npm package under Apache 2.0.
en.hot: As a classic open-source security tool from GCHQ, it holds 35,944 stars with 331 added this month, continuously attracting security analysts and developers, ranking 18th on the JavaScript monthly trending list.
uses: Security analysts for quick decoding, decryption, and forensic analysis
CTF players tackling encoding, encryption, and steganography challenges
Developers debugging data formats and protocol parsing
Non-technical users performing complex data transformations via a visual interface

zh.tag: 用 Rust 写的本地优先罗技 Options+ 替代品
zh.what: OpenLogi 是一个开源的罗技外设配置工具，通过 HID++ 协议直接与设备通信，支持按键重映射、DPI 调节和 SmartShift 等功能。它无需罗技账号，不收集遥测数据，所有配置以本地 TOML 文件保存，强调隐私和本地优先。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个组件：OpenLogi GUI（GPUI 桌面应用，提供交互式鼠标图示、按键动作选择器、DPI 预设、SmartShift、RGB 键盘灯效、按应用配置文件等）、OpenLogi agent（后台服务，负责输入钩子和设备 I/O）以及相关的文档和配置示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，GUI 基于 GPUI（Zed 编辑器所用的框架），通过 HID++ 协议与罗技设备通信，支持 Logi Bolt、Unifying 接收器、蓝牙直连和 USB 连接。
zh.hot: 作为罗技官方 Options+ 的开源替代品，它解决了用户对官方软件臃肿、遥测和账号要求的痛点，在 Rust 社区和追求隐私的用户中迅速走红，GitHub 星标已超 8600，今日新增 115。
uses: 罗技外设用户：希望摆脱官方 Options+ 的臃肿和遥测，获得本地优先的配置体验
Rust 开发者：对 GPUI 桌面应用开发或 HID++ 协议实现感兴趣的开发者
隐私倡导者：拒绝账号绑定和数据收集，偏好开源软件的用户

en.tag: A native, local-first Logitech Options+ alternative in Rust
en.what: OpenLogi is an open-source Logitech peripheral configuration tool that communicates directly with devices via HID++, supporting button remapping, DPI adjustment, and SmartShift. It requires no Logitech account, collects no telemetry, and stores all configuration in local TOML files, emphasizing privacy and local-first principles.
en.content: The repository contains three components: OpenLogi GUI (a GPUI desktop app with interactive mouse diagram, per-button action picker, DPI presets, SmartShift, RGB keyboard lighting, per-application profiles), OpenLogi agent (background service owning input hook and device I/O), plus documentation and config examples.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, the GUI is built with GPUI (the framework used by Zed editor), communicates with Logitech devices via HID++ protocol, supporting Logi Bolt, Unifying receivers, Bluetooth-direct, and USB connections.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Logitech's official Options+, it addresses user pain points with bloat, telemetry, and account requirements, quickly gaining popularity in the Rust community and among privacy-conscious users, with over 8.6k stars and 115 added today.
uses: Logitech peripheral users who want a local-first config experience without bloat and telemetry
Rust developers interested in GPUI desktop app development or HID++ protocol implementation
Privacy advocates who reject account requirements and data collection, preferring open-source software

zh.tag: 一条命令为你的硬件找到最合适的 LLM 模型
zh.what: llmfit 是一个终端工具，能根据你的系统 RAM、CPU 和 GPU 自动检测硬件，并为数百个模型和提供商评分，告诉你哪些模型能在你的机器上流畅运行。它提供交互式 TUI 和经典 CLI 两种模式，支持多 GPU、MoE 架构、动态量化选择、速度估算以及本地运行时提供商（如 Ollama、llama.cpp 等）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、TUI 和 CLI 实现、基准测试指南（docs/benchmarking.md）、TUI 指南（docs/tui.md），以及用于演示的 demo.gif 和图标资源。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和模型推理后端（Ollama、llama.cpp、MLX 等），通过 crates.io 分发。
zh.hot: 星标数达 32k，今日新增近 200，因其解决了本地 LLM 选型的痛点，且新版本支持基准测试并贡献结果，让用户获得真实硬件上的实测数据，迅速走红。
uses: 本地 LLM 爱好者：快速找到适合自己电脑配置的模型，避免下载后跑不动的尴尬。
开发者：在开发环境中评估不同模型的性能，优化推理速度和资源占用。
硬件评测者：通过基准测试功能，分享自己机器上的实测数据，帮助社区完善模型适配信息。

en.tag: One command to find the right LLM for your hardware
en.what: llmfit is a terminal tool that detects your hardware and scores hundreds of models across quality, speed, fit, and context dimensions, telling you which ones will run well on your machine. It features an interactive TUI and classic CLI mode, supporting multi-GPU setups, MoE architectures, dynamic quantization, speed estimation, and local runtime providers like Ollama and llama.cpp.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, TUI and CLI implementations, benchmarking guide (docs/benchmarking.md), TUI guide (docs/tui.md), plus demo.gif and icon assets.
en.stack: Built with Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and model inference backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, etc.), distributed via crates.io.
en.hot: With 32k stars and ~200 new today, it solves the pain point of choosing the right local LLM, and the new benchmarking feature lets users contribute real measured data, driving its popularity.
uses: Local LLM enthusiasts: quickly find models that fit your hardware, avoiding downloads that won't run.
Developers: evaluate model performance in dev environments to optimize inference speed and resource usage.
Hardware reviewers: use benchmarking to share real measured data and improve community model-fit information.

zh.tag: 开源版 Loom：快速录屏、本地剪辑与可自托管分享
zh.what: Cap 是一个开源的屏幕录制与视频分享工具，定位为 Loom 的替代品。它支持录制屏幕、摄像头和麦克风，提供即时分享链接与本地精修编辑，并可自托管或接入自有 S3 存储，让团队完全掌控数据。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面端应用（基于 Tauri）、Web 仪表盘与后端服务，提供 Instant 与 Studio 两种录制模式，以及评论、转录、分析、团队工作区和自定义域名等功能。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，桌面端使用 Tauri 框架，前端为 Web 应用，支持 S3 兼容存储与自托管部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 22,346 颗星与本月新增 1,552 星登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Rust 第 21 名，反映出开发者对开源、可自托管录屏协作工具的强烈需求。
uses: 需要快速录制产品演示、Bug 报告或异步站会的开发与产品团队
希望摆脱 Loom 订阅、要求数据自主可控并支持自托管的企业
需要为教程、设计评审或客户更新制作精修视频的内容创作者
关注开源 Rust/Tauri 桌面应用架构的开发者与贡献者

en.tag: Open source Loom alternative: fast screen recording, local editing, self-hostable sharing
en.what: Cap is an open source screen recording and video sharing tool positioned as a Loom alternative. It captures screen, camera, and microphone, offers instant share links plus polished local editing, and can be self-hosted or backed by your own S3 storage so teams fully own their data.
en.content: The repo contains a desktop app built on Tauri, a web dashboard, and backend services, offering Instant and Studio recording modes plus comments, transcripts, analytics, team workspaces, and custom domains.
en.stack: Primary language is Rust, with the desktop app built on Tauri, a web frontend, and support for S3-compatible storage and self-hosted deployment.
en.hot: With 22,346 stars and 1,552 added this month, it ranks 21st on GitHub Trending's monthly Rust list, reflecting strong demand for an open source, self-hostable screen recording and collaboration tool.
uses: Dev and product teams needing fast product demos, bug reports, or async standups
Enterprises wanting to leave Loom and keep data self-hosted and under control
Content creators polishing tutorials, design reviews, or client update videos
Developers interested in the open source Rust/Tauri desktop app architecture

zh.tag: 为无服务器计算打造的安全高速 microVM 虚拟化技术
zh.what: Firecracker 是 AWS 开源的轻量级虚拟化技术，用 microVM 运行容器与函数工作负载。它把硬件虚拟化的安全隔离性与容器的速度、灵活性结合起来，专为多租户无服务器场景设计。
zh.content: 核心是一个基于 Linux KVM 的虚拟机监控器（VMM），采用极简设计，剔除多余设备与 guest 功能以缩小内存占用和攻击面；仓库还包含构建工具链、快速入门与生产主机配置文档。
zh.stack: 主要用 Rust 编写，依赖 Linux KVM 与 Unix/Linux 主机环境，可通过 Docker 开发容器和 bash 脚本构建。
zh.hot: 作为 AWS Lambda 与 Fargate 的底层虚拟化引擎，Firecracker 是云原生安全隔离的事实标准之一，本月新增 707 star、总数达 36739，稳居 Rust 月榜第 12 名。
uses: 云平台与无服务器服务商：需要安全多租户隔离的容器/函数运行环境
容器运行时开发者：如 Kata Containers、Flintlock 等集成 microVM 隔离
基础设施与安全工程师：评估轻量虚拟化的启动速度、内存开销与攻击面
学习虚拟化与 KVM 的 Rust 开发者：研究生产级 VMM 实现

en.tag: Secure and fast microVMs for serverless computing
en.what: Firecracker is an open-source virtualization technology from AWS that runs container and function workloads inside lightweight microVMs. It combines the security and isolation of hardware virtualization with the speed and flexibility of containers, purpose-built for multi-tenant serverless services.
en.content: At its core is a minimalist KVM-based virtual machine monitor (VMM) that strips out unnecessary devices and guest-facing features to cut memory footprint and attack surface; the repo also ships a build toolchain, quickstart guide, and production host setup docs.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it relies on Linux KVM and a Unix/Linux host, and can be built via a Docker dev container and bash scripts.
en.hot: As the virtualization engine behind AWS Lambda and Fargate, Firecracker is a de facto standard for secure cloud-native isolation, gaining 707 stars this month for a total of 36,739 and ranking 12th on the monthly Rust trending list.
uses: Cloud and serverless providers needing secure multi-tenant isolation for containers and functions
Container runtime developers integrating microVM isolation, such as Kata Containers and Flintlock
Infrastructure and security engineers evaluating lightweight virtualization for boot speed, memory overhead, and attack surface

Mobile users who want to check a personalized feed on the go

zh.tag: Cloudflare Tunnel 官方命令行客户端，安全连接内网服务
zh.what: cloudflared 是 Cloudflare Tunnel 的守护进程和命令行客户端，它在 Cloudflare 网络与你的源站之间建立加密隧道，将外部请求代理到内部服务，无需在防火墙上开放端口。它还支持通过隧道访问 TCP 服务（如 SSH、RDP），并可与 WARP 客户端配合使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 cloudflared 的 Go 源代码、构建脚本、测试以及文档链接。主要功能分为隧道管理（cloudflared tunnel）和访问受保护服务（cloudflared access）。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Cloudflare 的 quic-go 等库，支持多种平台（Linux、macOS、Windows）和包格式（二进制、Docker、Debian、RPM、Homebrew）。
zh.hot: 作为 Cloudflare 官方隧道客户端，它解决了内网服务安全暴露的痛点，本月新增 446 stars，总 stars 达 15683，位列 GitHub Trending 月榜（Go）第 20 名。
uses: 运维工程师：安全地将内部 Web 服务发布到公网，无需开放防火墙端口
开发者：通过隧道远程访问家庭或办公室的 SSH、RDP 等 TCP 服务
企业 IT：结合 Cloudflare Zero Trust 实现私有应用的零信任访问

en.tag: Official CLI client for Cloudflare Tunnel, securely connecting private services
en.what: cloudflared is the daemon and command-line client for Cloudflare Tunnel, creating a secure tunnel between Cloudflare's network and your origin to proxy traffic without opening firewall ports. It also supports accessing TCP services (e.g., SSH, RDP) through tunnels and integrates with the WARP client.
en.content: The repository contains the Go source code for cloudflared, build scripts, tests, and documentation links. Main functionalities are divided into tunnel management (cloudflared tunnel) and accessing protected services (cloudflared access).
en.stack: Developed in Go, it depends on Cloudflare's quic-go and other libraries, supporting multiple platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows) and package formats (binary, Docker, Debian, RPM, Homebrew).

Developers: remotely access SSH, RDP, and other TCP services at home or office via tunnels
Enterprise IT: implement zero-trust access to private applications with Cloudflare Zero Trust

zh.tag: 自托管网页文件管理器，功能强大且免费

团队协作：利用用户管理和分享功能，实现文件的安全共享与协作。
开发者：作为自托管文件管理解决方案，可集成到现有系统中，支持多种认证方式。
运维人员：通过 Docker 快速部署，提供轻量级文件访问入口。

en.tag: Powerful free self-hosted web file manager
en.what: FileBrowser Quantum is a self-hosted web-based file manager that allows users to easily access and manage files through a browser. It offers a modern responsive interface with advanced features for user management, access control, sharing, file preview, and editing.

zh.tag: 轻量级服务器监控平台，支持 Docker 统计、历史数据与告警
zh.what: Beszel 是一个轻量级的服务器监控平台，提供 Docker 统计、历史数据和告警功能。它拥有友好的 Web 界面，配置简单，开箱即用，并支持自动备份、多用户、OAuth 认证和 API 访问。
zh.content: 仓库包含两个主要组件：hub（基于 PocketBase 的 Web 应用，提供仪表盘）和 agent（运行在被监控系统上，收集指标）。支持 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、负载、温度等指标，并提供截图和文档。

en.tag: Lightweight server monitoring with Docker stats, history, and alerts
en.what: Beszel is a lightweight server monitoring platform that includes Docker statistics, historical data, and alert functions. en.content: The repository contains two main components: the hub (a PocketBase-based web app providing a dashboard) and the agent (runs on monitored systems, collects metrics). It supports metrics like CPU, memory, disk, network, load, temperature, and includes screenshots and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, the hub is built on PocketBase, and the agent runs independently. Supports Docker/Podman, deployable via Docker images, uses SQLite for data storage.
en.hot: It has gained popularity on GitHub due to its lightweight nature, ease of use, and rich features (like Docker stats, alerts, multi-user). It gained 282 stars this week, reaching 24,566 total, ranking 9th on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: Individual developers or small teams needing lightweight server monitoring without heavyweight solutions
Users running multiple Docker containers who want to track resource usage history per container

zh.tag: 开源 Linux 服务器管理面板，兼 AI 管理平台

zh.tag: 通用代理平台，一站式网络代理工具箱

希望用单一内核替代多款代理客户端的进阶玩家

en.tag: The universal proxy platform for all-in-one network proxying
en.what: sing-box is a universal proxy platform written in Go that unifies multiple proxy protocols, routing rules, and inbound/outbound capabilities into a single core. It works as both client and server, covering everything from personal circumvention to self-hosted node distribution.
en.content: The repo is mainly Go source code with protocol implementations, config parsing, a routing engine, and multi-platform build scripts, with docs hosted at sing-box.sagernet.org.
en.stack: Primarily Go with a modular protocol abstraction and JSON configuration, minimal dependencies, cross-compilable to Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, and iOS.
en.hot: As a next-gen proxy core, its unified config and active maintenance have earned 38,092 stars, adding 1,147 this month and ranking 17th on the Go monthly trending list.
uses: Self-hosted node users who need to manage multiple proxy protocols in one place
Advanced users wanting a single core to replace several proxy clients
Network enthusiasts deploying transparent proxies on routers or servers
Developers interested in proxy core internals for integration or forks

zh.tag: 支持 S3、POSIX 与 Iceberg 的分布式存储系统，单机可扛数十亿文件

zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，提供 Docker 镜像、Helm Chart 与 Maven 客户端；支持 S3 API、POSIX 挂载、Iceberg 表格式以及云存储分层缓存。
zh.hot: 34,651 颗星、本月新增 628，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Go 第 20 名；在对象存储与湖仓一体需求上升的背景下，其 O(1) 磁盘访问和横向扩展能力持续吸引关注。

为海量小文件、图片、视频等场景寻找高吞吐存储后端的开发者
希望用同一套存储同时支撑文件系统与 Iceberg 湖仓的数据平台团队
在 Kubernetes 上部署有状态存储、关注水平扩展与云分层缓存的架构师

en.tag: Distributed storage for S3, POSIX and Iceberg tables, scaling to billions of files

Developers needing a high-throughput storage backend for massive small files, images or videos
Data platform teams wanting one storage layer for both file systems and Iceberg lakehouse tables
Architects deploying stateful storage on Kubernetes with horizontal scaling and cloud tiering in mind

zh.tag: 本地化光伏充电与家庭能源管理系统

en.tag: Local solar charging and home energy management system

For library authors implementing or extending C++20/23 formatting, or adding formatting support for custom types

zh.tag: 把整个项目文件夹变成可查询知识图谱的 AI 技能
zh.what: 给 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手用的 skill：输入 /graphify，它就把整个项目（代码、SQL schema、文档、PDF、图片、视频）映射成一张可查询的知识图谱，代替 grep 翻文件。代码解析走 tree-sitter AST —— 确定性、不用 LLM、完全本地；文档类内容才走模型做语义处理。不是向量索引，是真图谱，每条边标注 EXTRACTED（直接读到）还是 INFERRED（推断出来）。
zh.content: 以 CLI 形式分发（PyPI 包 graphifyy，uv tool install 或 pipx 安装），仓库含 docs/（30 多种语言 README 翻译）和交互式 graph.html 可视化产物；默认分支 v8，迭代很快。
zh.stack: Python + tree-sitter 代码解析，产出力导向 HTML 图；挂到各家 CLI 助手上当 skill 用。
zh.hot: 它用知识图谱补足纯向量检索的局限，直接回应团队构建上下文型 AI 助手时遇到的 RAG 难题。
uses: 接手中大型老项目的开发者 —— 一条命令生成知识图谱，快速搞清代码结构
AI 重度用户 —— 给 agent 换图谱上下文，替代检索不准的向量 RAG
技术文档团队 —— 把文档 / PDF / 图纸一起纳入可查询图谱

en.tag: An AI skill that turns a whole project folder into a queryable knowledge graph
en.what: A skill for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more: type /graphify and your entire project — code, SQL schemas, docs, PDFs, images, videos — is mapped into a queryable knowledge graph, replacing grep-and-scroll. Code parsing uses tree-sitter AST: deterministic, no LLM, fully local; only document content goes through a model. Not a vector index — a real graph, with every edge labeled EXTRACTED (read directly) or INFERRED.
en.content: Distributed as a CLI (PyPI package graphifyy, install via uv tool install or pipx); the repo holds docs/ (README translations in 30+ languages) and interactive graph.html visualizations; default branch v8, iterating fast.
en.stack: Python + tree-sitter, outputting force-directed HTML graphs; hooks into each CLI assistant as a skill.
en.hot: Its knowledge-graph alternative to vector-only retrieval speaks directly to limitations teams encounter when building contextual AI assistants.
uses: Developers inheriting large legacy projects — one command maps the codebase into a knowledge graph
Heavy AI users — swap vector RAG for graph context that retrieves the right thing
Docs teams — fold docs, PDFs and diagrams into one queryable graph

en.tag: An AI personal tutor from HKU: a lifelong, personalized learning workspace
